article.articleHeadline: [i-point] 노을, 우간다에 말라리아·혈액분석 진단장비 공급
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [i-point] Noeul supplies malaria and blood-analysis diagnostic equipment to Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-27, AI-based diagnostic company Noeul signed a five-year agreement to supply Uganda with 100 units of its malaria-focused miLab MAL and blood-analysis miLab BCM diagnostic devices, via a Ugandan medical device distributor. The distributor, a key partner with Uganda’s Ministry of Health, will oversee supply, technical support, and integration to strengthen the national health system. Building on validation in high-burden malaria countries such as Nigeria, Benin, and Ghana, Noeul plans gradual expansion into East Africa alongside local manufacturers and institutions. The deal underscores Noeul’s ability to offer affordable, clinically effective diagnostics in LMIC markets, aiming to improve early malaria detection and basic blood analysis for assessing immune status amid Uganda’s malaria crisis. Uganda reports over 10 million malaria cases annually per WHO, with centralized care and workforce gaps complicating timely diagnosis; the miLab solutions are expected to boost diagnostic accessibility and efficiency.

triage.headline_ja: [i-point] ノエル、ウガンダにマラリア・血液分析診断装置を供給
triage.triage_reason: マラリア診断装置の商業供給契約に関するニュースであり、新規の疾病発生・流行イベントではない。医療介入による予防的取り組みであり、公衆衛生上の危機や異常事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダへの診断装置供給契約の発表であり、マラリア流行事象そのものではない。ガーナ・ベニン・ナイジェリアは装置の検証地域として言及されているが、これらの国での新規イベント発生を示すものではない。対象国はガーナのみ該当するが、本記事はシグナルトリアージの対象外（商業ニュース）。

article.articleHeadline: Pune to deploy night squads for filariasis surveillance
article.articleSummary: Pune district health department will send out special night squads to begin active surveillance for lymphatic filariasis (LF) amid concerns of a silent spread in Pune, Maharashtra. Pune has reported 44 LF cases since January 2026, largely among migrants, and is not part of Maharashtra’s routine filariasis surveillance network, which covers 18 endemic districts. The night squads will operate year-round, beginning next month, focusing on high-risk clusters and collecting blood samples at night when microfilariae are present to enable early detection. Lymphatic filariasis is a mosquito-borne disease caused by parasitic worms, primarily Wuchereria bancrofti, transmitted by infected Culex mosquitoes; infection is often acquired in childhood and silently damages the lymphatic system. Severe symptoms such as lymphoedema, elephantiasis, and scrotal swelling appear later, potentially causing disability. Absence of active surveillance raises local transmission risk given the disease’s long incubation (5–15 years) and Pune’s high migrant population and rapid urbanisation.

triage.headline_ja: プネーがフィラリア症監視のための夜間特別班の配置を開始
triage.triage_reason: リンパ系フィラリア症は公衆衛生上の慢性感染症であり、プネーで2026年1月以来44例の報告があるが、国際的拡大リスクや貿易制限リスクは低い。ただし、積極的監視体制の欠落と遺伝的感染リスク、移民人口の増加が懸念要因であり、情報の充実度を踏まえ経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: リンパ系フィラリア症は蚊媒介の寄生虫性疾患であり、長い潜伏期（5～15年）と無症状期間を特徴とする。プネーでの積極的監視体制の欠落と移民人口の増加により、局所的な持続的伝播リスクが存在する。WPRO基準では異常性（平常時監視対象外の地域での検出）、長期曝露、流行性の観点で該当するが、IHR基準には該当せず、また国際的な緊急対応の必要性も認められない。政府による対応の強化（夜間班の配置）が示唆されているため、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mùa mưa bão đến gần, cảnh báo về bệnh Whitmore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon season is approaching: warning about Whitmore's disease.
article.articleSummary: Whitmore’s disease (melioidosis), caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is highlighted by Hanoi CDC ahead of the monsoon season as cases and deaths rise in parts of Southeast Asia. The bacterium thrives in soil, mud and contaminated water; infection occurs via skin wounds, inhalation, or ingestion. No vaccine exists. The disease ranges from prolonged fever, fatigue, cough and chest pain to skin infections, abscesses, headache, weight loss, and progressive septicemia with multi-organ failure; untreated mortality is 10–50% or higher. Early diagnosis is challenging due to nonspecific symptoms. High-risk groups include diabetics, liver/kidney disease, chronic lung disease, immunocompromised individuals, and people exposed to soil or dirty water; risk increases after rain and flooding. Vietnamese cases include a 35-year-old man from Nghệ An Province who worked in Thailand, with Burkholderia pseudomallei bacteremia confirmed; treated in Thailand, then Vietnam, with septic shock and multi-organ support; discharged after 3 weeks. No human-to-human transmission. Emphasis on prompt testing and prolonged antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時季が近づく：ウイットモア病についての警告
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスは重症度が高く（未治療死亡率10-50%以上）、東南アジア全域で症例・死亡が増加している。ベトナム・タイでの発生が確認されており、モンスーン時季に伝播リスクが高まる異常な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは高い病原性（未治療死亡率10-50%以上）、ワクチンなし、複数の感染経路（皮膚創傷・吸入・経口）を有する。ベトナム疾病管理センターが公式警告を発出しており、政府関心が高い。ハノイでの具体例（ネゲアン省の35歳男性がタイで感染）が報告されている。モンスーン時季の降雨・洪水により環境での菌の増殖が促進され、曝露リスクが急増する点が重要。東南アジア全体での症例増加傾向が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 什么是疟疾？如何预防？中疾控解答
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is malaria? How to prevent it? China CDC answers.
article.articleSummary: Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes. China eliminated indigenous malaria in 2021 (per WHO), but imported malaria remains the central control challenge as travel increases. Globally, 2024 estimates show 282 million malaria cases and 610,000 deaths, with 94% of cases and 95% of deaths in Africa. In China, local transmission risk persists due to vectors and a warmer climate, and misdiagnosis of imported cases can delay treatment. Prevention guidance: before traveling to Africa or Southeast Asia, consult public health authorities; pack long-sleeved clothing, nets, repellents, and ensure accommodations have screens; avoid peak biting times. After returning, monitor within one year for periodic chills, fever, and sweating, seek prompt testing (blood smear or rapid test), and complete prescribed therapy. Donor eligibility is restricted for recent travelers. China shifts from elimination to consolidation and emphasizes international cooperation to prevent reintroduction.

triage.headline_ja: 疟疾とは何か？どのように予防するか？中国疾病管理予防センターが回答
triage.triage_reason: 中国で2021年に土着性マラリアが排除されており、記事は予防啓発と輸入症例への対応についての情報提供です。新規の流行イベント、異常な増加、または深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示す証拠がありません。
triage.notes: 記事は中国疾病管理予防センターによるマラリア予防に関する啓発・情報提供記事です。中国は2021年にWHOから土着性マラリア排除の認定を受けており、現在は輸入症例への対応に焦点を当てています。新規の感染症危機を示すシグナルではなく、定期的な予防啓発の一環と判断されます。

article.articleHeadline: 40Cr Latent TB Carriers Biggest Hurdle To Elimination: Maha Task Force Head | Nagpur News
article.articleSummary: 40Cr latent TB carriers biggest hurdle to elimination in India, warns Dr Sushant Meshram, Maharashtra TB task force head, during Nagpur CME on Tuberculosis Infection. About 35-40 crore Indians harbor latent TB infection; asymptomatic individuals can progress to active disease with malnutrition, diabetes, aging, or immunosuppression. Tuberculin Skin Test (TST) and IGRA cannot predict progression, underscoring the need for targeted screening and preventive therapy in high-risk groups. Emphasis on identifying high-risk individuals—HIV, diabetes, close contacts—and avoiding universal treatment. Calls for improved molecular diagnostics and addressing latent reservoirs alongside infection control measures (ventilation, masks, guidelines). Event organized under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan by Maharashtra task force and NTEP; inaugurated by Dr Sunil Khaparde. Preventive options under NTEP: Isoniazid 6-9 months; Rifampicin-based 3-4 months; weekly INH + Rifapentine (3HP).

triage.headline_ja: 4000万人の潜在性TB保有者がインド根絶への最大の障害：マハラシュトラタスクフォース長
triage.triage_reason: インドの潜在性結核保有者数が大規模（3.5～4.0億人）であることが報告されており、公衆衛生上の重要性は高いが、新規患者の集団発生やアウトブレイクではなく、既知の慢性疾患管理の課題についての専門家会議の報告であるため。情報不足による確認が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はアウトブレイク・集団発生ではなく、インドの潜在性結核感染に関する専門家の警告と管理戦略についての学術会議の報告。既知の慢性公衆衛生課題についての政策・プログラム関連情報。WPRO基準では複数該当するが、IHR基準は1つのみ。新規患者集団発生や異常な流行パターンの報告ではないため、フルRRA進行前の経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Rapport de la situation epidemiologique du cholera en RD Congo (Interne OMS), semaine 15, 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report on the Epidemiological Situation of Cholera in DR Congo (WHO Internal), Week 15, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Week 15 cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,117 suspected cases and 28 deaths (case-fatality ratio 2.5%) across 16 of 26 provinces and 106 of 519 health zones. A new health zone, Kungu in Sud-Ubangi Province, reports 12 cases and 2 deaths along the river corridor. Maniema Province has for the first time since the outbreak begun reached zero cases. In Kinshasa, weekly cases continue to fall, with 33 cases in Week 15 after earlier grid surveillance started in Week 10. Preventive vaccination in Haut Lomami reached 2,756,470 people across 8 health zones, at 97.9% coverage. Flooding affected two health zones in Tshopo Province (Isangi and Tshopo) and four in Tanganyika Province (Ankoro, Kabalo, Kiambi, Nyemba).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ疫学状況報告（WHO内部）、第15週2026年
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。コレラによる複数州での流行、28名の死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められる。WPROスクリーニングでも5項目すべてに該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRC全土16州106保健ゾーンでコレラが発生。週15で1,117疑い症例と28死亡（CFR 2.5%）を報告。新たな流行地域としてSud-Ubangi州Kungu保健ゾーンが特定。Kinshasa市では週10から格子監視導入後、症例減少傾向（週15で33症例）。予防接種キャンペーンがHaut Lomami州で実施中（97.9%カバレッジ）。洪水がTshopo州とTanganyika州の複数保健ゾーンに影響。内部WHO報告である点から組織内での重要性も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Recurring fevers, missed signs: The reality of malaria in India today - The Times of India
article.articleSummary: India has seen substantial reductions in malaria cases and deaths over the past decade due to improved surveillance and control programs, but has not reached a malaria-free status; some regions continue to experience outbreaks, particularly during the monsoon. Dr. Girish Chandra Vaishnava notes delayed diagnosis, inadequate awareness, and unequal healthcare access in remote areas keep the threat alive. Transmission is fueled by stagnant water and poor sanitation. Early malaria symptoms—fever, chills, sweating, headache, malaise, with nausea or fatigue possible—are often confused with flu, delaying testing. Prevention emphasizes insecticide-treated bed nets, indoor residual spraying, removal of standing water, protective clothing, and repellents; home routines include clearing water-holding containers, regular cleaning, sleeping under nets, window screens, and covered water storage. Call to action: early detection, testing of fever, clean environments, and expanded healthcare access, especially on World Malaria Day.

triage.headline_ja: 再発性の発熱、見落とされた兆候：インドにおけるマラリアの現実
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるマラリアの継続的な流行と診断遅延の問題が報告されており、スクリーニング基準複数項目に該当するが、急性の新規アウトブレイクや国際的拡大の直接的証拠に乏しく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア根絶に向けた進展を報告しつつ、雨季の流行、診断遅延、不十分なヘルスケアアクセスなどの継続的課題を強調している。新規アウトブレイク宣言や急性の重症化の証拠がないため、IHR基準は該当しない。ただしWPRO基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、World Malaria Dayに関連する社会的関心がある。続報で患者数増加やアウトブレイク宣言が出た場合はPICKUPへの昇格を検討。

article.articleHeadline: อาจารย์หมอ เผย 'โรคตับอักเสบเอ' ประเทศไทย จัดอยู่ในกลุ่มระบาดต่ำ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor Reveals 'Hepatitis A' in Thailand Is in the Low-Outbreak Group
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A in Thailand is described as low-endemicity. There have been two noted large outbreaks: Chiang Rai in 2005 with numerous cases and 2 deaths, and Bueng Kan in 2012. Today, most Thais under 40 lack natural immunity to Hepatitis A, while immunity rises after age 40 and those over 60 are nearly 100% immune. Symptoms include jaundice, mild fever initially, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and sometimes diarrhea; jaundice typically appears after the first days. Fatalities are relatively low, mainly among patients over 40 with preexisting liver disease or other comorbidities. Vaccination is effective and long-lasting but not mandatory and currently costly, contributing to vulnerability if the virus enters unsensitized populations. Prevention emphasizes sanitation, safe drinking water and food, thorough handwashing, and rapid outbreak control to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: タイの「A型肝炎」は低流行グループに分類されていることが判明
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるA型肝炎の疫学的概要に関する教育的な記事であり、現在の積極的な流行・アウトブレイク報告ではない。過去の歴史的事例（2005年、2012年）の言及であり、現在の国際的な懸念はない。
triage.notes: 記事は現在のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、タイにおけるA型肝炎の疾病負担と疫学に関する専門家による解説記事である。過去の歴史的事例への言及であり、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準は満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: 四月需格外警惕肠道传染病，南昌疾控发布预防指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: April: Be Extra Vigilant for Enteric Infectious Diseases; Nanchang CDC Releases Prevention Guidelines.
article.articleSummary: April demands heightened vigilance for enteric infectious diseases in China, as the Nanchang CDC issues prevention guidelines for children. Primary transmission is fecal-oral, and viruses endure in moist environments; alcohol-based hand rubs are ineffective. Four defenses: 1) Entry control—onion-style dressing, keep skin dry, change sweaty garments, and practice hand hygiene; 2) Food/housing—thoroughly cook raw aquatic products; in meals, use separate utensils; ventilate homes 2–3 times daily for 30+ minutes; 3) School–family isolation—kindergartens are high-risk; HFMD and herpangina are related viruses; HFMD incubation 2–10 days; isolate at home for 1 week after symptoms resolve, with separate meals/toys; 4) Disinfection—avoid alcohol; use chlorine disinfectants (84-type); soak toys in 500 mg/L; handle vomitus with gloves and masks and chlorine for 30 minutes; sun-dry/wash plush toys; contaminated clothing should soak in disinfectant before washing; keep raw and cooked foods separate and reheat leftovers to prevent bacterial dysentery.

triage.headline_ja: 4月は腸道伝染病に特に警戒が必要。南昌疾病管理センターが予防ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: エンテロウイルス71は既知の病原体であり、記事は予防ガイダンスの発表であって新たな流行の報告ではない。ただし中国における腸道感染症の警戒情報であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は流行事例の報告ではなく、南昌疾病管理センターによる予防ガイダンスの発表である。エンテロウイルス71は既知の病原体で中国では季節的な問題。新規流行の明示的な報告がないため、IHR基準は満たさない。ただし、中国における腸道感染症（手足口病等）の警戒情報として、続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 4月以来流感病毒和鼻病毒活动水平呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Since April, activity levels of influenza viruses and rhinoviruses have shown an upward trend.
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, China reports rising activity of influenza viruses and rhinoviruses in respiratory infections. Since April, influenza and rhinovirus circulation has increased, with fluctuating epidemic activity. With the May Day holiday approaching, large-scale travel and gatherings are expected; authorities warn to monitor for dengue fever and chikungunya, as well as norovirus infections and hand-foot-and-mouth disease. Public health guidance urges adapting clothing to spring-summer weather, checking destination outbreak information before travel, and maintaining food and water hygiene to prevent disease from entering via the mouth. Outdoors, continue protection against mosquitoes and ticks. If you encounter marmots in the wild, avoid close contact. Maintain home health monitoring, especially for the elderly and young children, and seek medical care promptly if unwell.

triage.headline_ja: 4月以降、インフルエンザウイルスと鼻ウイルスの活動レベルが上昇傾向を示している
triage.triage_reason: 中国で複数の呼吸器系感染症（インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス）の活動が増加しているが、現時点では深刻な患者数や死亡報告がなく、情報が限定的。国内での流行傾向監視が必要だが、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性疾患（インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス）の通常の流行増加を報じており、5月連休期の大規模移動に伴う注意喚起が主体。重症度や死亡報告の具体的情報がなく、予防公衆衛生措置中心の内容。デング熱やチクングニア熱への警戒も言及されているが、現在の発生報告ではなく予防的警告。ウイルス性出血熱（ペスト様の野生動物接触警告含む）の可能性示唆あり。より詳細な疫学データの続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: गोलगप्पे-छोले खाकर 18 बच्चे बीमार, एक की मौत; फूड प्वाइजनिंग के बाद मेडिकल टीम कर रही कैंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18 children fall ill after eating golgappas and chole; one dies; medical team running a camp after food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of food poisoning linked to contaminated golgappes and chole sickened 18 children in Budgetan village, Mufassil area, Giridih district, Jharkhand, with one child, 6-year-old Ranjan Kumar, dying at Giridih Sadar Hospital. By Sunday evening, vomiting, diarrhoea, and severe abdominal pain spread, and several patients remained in critical condition and were admitted. A street vendor had sold golgappas and chole on Saturday evening; villagers reported contamination. Health authorities ramped up hospital staffing, launched a medical camp in Budgetan, and began tracing other possibly affected individuals. The Food Safety Department collected samples from the suspected foods for testing; authorities launched a search for the vendor. Deputy Commissioner Ramnivas Yadav, with SDM Shrikant Yashwant and SDPO Jitwahaan Urav, visited the hospital to assess the situation.

triage.headline_ja: ゴルガッペとチョレを食べた18人の子どもが病気になり1人が死亡。食中毒後、医療チームがキャンプを実施
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州ギリディー地区での食中毒アウトブレイク。18人の小児患者、1人の死亡報告あり、重症度が高く公衆衛生への影響は深刻。地域での対応体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: 食中毒の原因はゴルガッペ(パニプーリ)とチョレの汚染によるものと推定。原因物質が特定されていないため「Unknown Illness」分類となっているが、臨床的には食中毒と判断。6歳児の死亡例あり。医療当局による積極的な対応（医療キャンプ、検体採取、患者追跡）が実施中。露店商の追跡調査が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 240 Warga Buleleng Bali Meninggal akibat TBC dalam 2 Tahun Terakhir, Didominasi Usia Produktif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 240 residents of Buleleng, Bali died from TB in the last two years, predominantly among the working-age population.
article.articleSummary: 240 residents of Buleleng Regency, Bali died of tuberculosis (TB) over 2024–2025. In 2024, TB cases reached 1,072 with 121 deaths; in 2025, 1,031 cases with 119 deaths. 2025 treatment outcomes: 991 treated; 501 cured/completed, 303 still under treatment, 64 lost to follow-up, 3 treatment failures. In 2024, 994 treated: 769 cured, 92 lost to follow-up, 11 treatment failures. As of 24 April 2026, 1,649 TB suspects with 300 confirmed cases; 273 treated, 3 deaths before treatment. Emphasis on adherence to full TB therapy, early detection, contact tracing, and TB preventive therapy (TPT) for exposed individuals to reduce transmission. Prevention measures include cough etiquette, masking, and adequate home ventilation; stigma-reduction education. TB most affects productive-age adults 15–54 (average around 44–45 years), with children at risk via close contact or comorbidity.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州ブレレン地域で過去2年間に240人がTBで死亡、主に労働年代層が罹患
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリ州で結核による継続的な死亡（2024-2025年で240人）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行性）に複数該当。公衆衛生上の影響が明らかで、地域的な感染症制御の課題を示唆している。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の疾患であり「異常/予想外」には該当しないが、地域における継続的な死亡数と治療中断率の高さ（2025年で64人の追跡喪失）が公衆衛生の懸念事項。生産年齢層への影響と接触者追跡・結核予防療法の強調から、地域の感染症管理能力が試されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: 外媒：智利爆發野生鳥類感染高病原性禽流感病例-MoneyDJ理財網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foreign media: Chile reports an outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza in wild birds - MoneyDJ Financial Network
article.articleSummary: Chile reports the first outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 in wild birds in the southern Aysén Region, specifically Chile Chico, detected in a caiquén (Magellan goose). As of 2026-04-27, SAG (Agricultural and Livestock Service) activated surveillance, intensified monitoring of wildlife, and searches for dead birds or birds with infection-like symptoms; a reporting system for suspected cases remains in place. SAG urged poultry producers to strengthen biosecurity, house birds in protected areas, and separate poultry from wild birds and shared water sources. Separately, China banned imports of Chilean poultry products on 23 April 2026, a major export market accounting for about 15% of Chile’s poultry exports. Ongoing response focuses on surveillance and biosecurity; potential implications for trade.

triage.headline_ja: 外媒：智利爆發野生鳥類感染高病原性禽流感病例-MoneyDJ理財網
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。高病原性鳥インフルエンザH5N1の野生鳥類での初検出は南米では異常であり、主要な農業輸出国での確認のため国際的な貿易影響と拡大リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にChina（1814991）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではChinaは輸入禁止措置の実施国であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。イベントの主題はChile（対象国リストに含まれていない）での野生鳥類におけるHPAI H5N1検出である。したがってverified_locationsは空配列とした。ただしシグナル値が高いため、本イベントはグローバル影響を持つものとしてPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 함안군, 봄철 광견병 무료 예방접종···4월 29일
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haman County to hold free spring rabies vaccination on April 29.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Haman County, South Korea, on April 29, 2026, aims to prevent canine rabies. Free vaccination will be offered at each town office within the county, with morning sessions 10:00–11:00 for Daesan, Gunbuk, Beosu, Gaya, and Chilwon, and afternoon sessions 13:00–14:00 for Chilseo, Yeohang, Haman, Chilbuk, and Sanin. Dogs must be over 3 months old and have completed pet registration; unregistered dogs must register before vaccination. If attendance on April 29 is not possible, free vaccination is available through April 30 at local public-veterinary clinics. An Moon-jun, head of Haman County Agricultural Technology Center, emphasizes safety of pets and residents and invites broad participation since the service is free.

triage.headline_ja: 函安郡、春季狂犬病無料予防接種···4月29日
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の予防接種キャンペーン告知であり、流行発生や感染者の報告ではない。公衆衛生上の突発的脅威ではなく、定期的な予防対策の実施案内である。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（発生地域リストに含まれる）に関連する内容ではなく、韓国のハマン郡での予防接種キャンペーンに関するもの。韓国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。狂犬病の発生事例報告ではなく、予防措置の告知であるため、シグナルとしてはピックアップしない。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand Food Poisoning: 7-Year-Old Dies, 18 Hospitalised After Eating Golgappa and Chaat in Giridih | 📰 LatestLY
article.articleSummary: As of 27 April 2026, a suspected food-poisoning incident in Giridih, Jharkhand, has left a seven-year-old child dead and 18 others hospitalised after eating golgappa and chaat from a roadside vendor in Leda Bajto village, Mufassil police station area. Following Saturday evening exposure, more than 20 people developed vomiting and abdominal pain and were transported to Sadar Hospital by Sunday morning; one child died during treatment, while others remain stable under medical supervision. Police, led by SDPO Jeetwahan Oraon, have launched a probe to locate the cart vendor and are collecting food samples to determine contamination. Investigators are examining the exact cause of the outbreak and authorities stress the need for stricter enforcement of food-safety regulations for street vendors and public caution when consuming food from unverified sources as the inquiry proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールハンド州食中毒：ゴルガッパとチャートを食べた後、7歳児が死亡、18人が入院（ギリディ）
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒による死亡例と18人の入院患者が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（IHR基準1）と重症度（WPRO基準2）が認められるため、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事象は限定的な食中毒事案（道路脇の露店での食事が原因）であり、IHR基準では2つ未満だが、死亡例と複数の重症化例があり、かつWPRO基準で重症度と流行性基準に該当。地域的には限定されている可能性が高いが、食品安全に関わる公開情報と当局の対応が進行中であるため、トリアージはPICKUPとする。
