article.articleHeadline: भागलपुर में बर्ड फ्लू का कहर, तीन हजार मुर्गे-मुर्गियों की मौत के बाद भोपाल से आई डरावनी रिपोर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu ravages Bhagalpur, frightening report from Bhopal after the death of 3,000 chickens
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (H5N1) outbreak in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India, centered at Barari Regional Poultry Center, where about 3,000 chickens have died over the past two weeks. NIHSAD in Bhopal confirmed H5N1. Tests from Patna and Kolkata labs were inconclusive, with confirmation finally arriving from Bhopal. Authorities have declared an epicenter and a one-kilometer containment zone, mandating closure of all private and government poultry farms within the radius and immediate culling and burial of infected stock. Experts suspect spillover from wild birds’ droppings at the Barari facility. Reported human symptoms include fever, cough, breathing difficulty, red eyes, and muscle pain; the public is advised to avoid infected areas and dead birds. Poultry products sold in markets are not affected if properly cooked, since cooking to 100°C kills H5N1 (virus dies at 70°C). Enhanced surveillance around the zone.

triage.headline_ja: バガルプルで鳥インフルエンザが猛威、3000羽の鶏の死亡後、ボーパールから恐ろしいレポート
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ H5N1 の人獣共通感染症アウトブレイク。IHR基準3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、社会的関心も高い。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1確定症例は動物（ニワトリ3000羽）。人での疑い症状（発熱、咳、呼吸困難等）が報告されているが、検査確認状況は記事では明確でない。野鳥からの感染リスクと市場への流通リスクが指摘されている。複数州（ビハール州、マディヤプラデーシュ州、西ベンガル州）での確認・検査報告がある。NIHSAD（ボーパール）による確認検査が実施済み。人での確定例がない場合も、H5N1の人獣共通感染リスク、家禽への重篤影響、国際的波及の可能性からPickup判定。

article.articleHeadline: Meghalaya: 11-Year-Old Child with Rabies Dies After Alleged Refusal of Treatment at Two Tura Hospitals
article.articleSummary: Meghalaya’s Tura reports an alleged medical-negligence case after an 11-year-old girl, Netera Sangma of West Garo Hills, died in an ambulance following refusals of emergency treatment at two major hospitals in Tura (Tura Civil Hospital and Holy Cross Hospital) when rabies was suspected. She was referred from Dadenggre Community Health Centre to Tura Civil Hospital for urgent specialised care, but both institutions reportedly declined admission. Social activist Greneth M Sangma filed a complaint with the West Garo Hills Deputy Commissioner, seeking accountability, a judicial/magisterial inquiry, disciplinary action against on-duty staff, and ex-gratia compensation for the bereaved family. He argued that hospitals cannot refuse emergency care under Article 21 (Right to Life) and the Supreme Court’s Parmanand Katara ruling, and called for audits of emergency response and isolation facilities across Tura’s medical institutions to prevent further deaths.

triage.headline_ja: メーガーラヤ州：狂犬病が疑われた11歳の女児が、トゥーラの2つの病院での治療拒否後に救急車内で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病死亡例は重症度の観点で重要だが、個別事例の医療過誤訴訟であり、公衆衛生的な流行兆候や異常な集団発生ではない。より詳細な情報（他の新規症例の有無、流行状況）を必要とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは個別の狂犬病死亡例に関連した医療過誤訴訟事案である。公衆衛生上の流行または異常集団発生の兆候は報告されていない。メーガーラヤ州におけるより広範な狂犬病動向・他の新規症例の有無に関する続報を要注視。狂犬病は重篤疾患だが、本記事からは疾患そのものの流行拡大リスクは評価不可能。

article.articleHeadline: इंसान के फेंफड़ों में पैदा हो रहा ये 'खूबसूरत' फंगस, अंदर से खा रहा शरीर!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This 'beautiful' fungus growing in human lungs is eating away at the body from within!
article.articleSummary: Aspergillosis, an invasive fungal infection of the lungs caused by inhaled spores of Aspergillus fumigatus, A. flavus, and A. niger, is rising rapidly in immunocompromised individuals. Healthy immunity clears spores, but cancer patients undergoing treatment, organ transplant recipients, HIV, COPD, and asthma patients are at high risk. Invasive aspergillosis damages lung tissue and can invade blood vessels, spreading through the body; symptoms include fever, cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Mortality remains high (40–90%) even with antifungal therapy. The article links increasing cases to climate change, noting that high-emission scenarios could expand A. fumigatus’s range across Europe, with India also seeing rising risk due to heat and pollution. In India, cities like Delhi and Mumbai are highlighted, along with mold-prone, damp environments. Treatments include voriconazole and amphotericin B—expensive with significant side effects—and surgery may be needed in severe cases. Ongoing research aims at new drugs and vaccines, but prevention is crucial.

triage.headline_ja: 人間の肺で増殖する『美しい』カビが体を内側から蝕んでいる
triage.triage_reason: アスペルギルス症は既知の真菌感染症であり、記事はHIVを疾患名として記載していますが、実際の主題はアスペルギルス症です。インドの気候変動に伴う感染リスク上昇について論じていますが、現在の具体的な流行・アウトブレイクの報告がなく、情報不足により経過観察が適切です。
triage.notes: 疾患名フィールドではHIVが記載されていますが、記事サマリーはアスペルギルス症（Aspergillosis）が主題です。記事は気候変動に伴う潜在的なリスク上昇を論じており、デリーとムンバイが具体的に言及されていますが、現在のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、予測的な警告であるため、即座のシグナルピックアップは保留。継続的な監視が推奨されます。

article.articleHeadline: Giridih Food Poisoning News: शाम को खाई पानीपुरी, सुबह हो गई मासूम की मौत, 22 से ज्यादा लोग पहुंचे अस्पताल, गांव में मचा हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Giridih Food Poisoning News: Had pani puri in the evening, a child died in the morning, more than 22 people were admitted to hospital, panic gripped the village.
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning outbreak reported in Ledabajto village, Sadar block, Giridih district, Jharkhand, India. An unknown street vendor selling chaat and chhola around 5 PM on Saturday sparked illness that spread by Sunday morning to residents, including children, with fever, severe abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea. More than 22 people were hospitalized, and a 7-year-old boy, Ranjan Kumar, son of Rinku Devi, died during treatment at Sadar Hospital. The village authorities and health department rushed to the scene, and administrative teams launched containment efforts. The report does not confirm laboratory results or a definitive infection source; the cited vendor/food sale is the suspected link. This incident underscores a pediatric fatality and multiple hospitalizations from suspected foodborne illness in Jharkhand.

triage.headline_ja: ギリディ食中毒ニュース：夕方にパニプリを食べた子ども、翌朝に死亡。22人以上が入院、村はパニック状態に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響と異常性）。小児死亡を含む複数の重症例と急速な発症が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 未確定の食中毒アウトブレイク。7歳児の死亡、22人以上の入院者、発熱・腹痛・嘔吐・下痢の症状報告。原因特定のための検査結果は未確認。単一の食品ベンダーが推定感染源。迅速な疫学調査と原因確定が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 陸老夫妻樓道養雞雙雙進ICU急救　醫：鸚鵡熱衣原體感染 | ETtoday大陸新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly couple surnamed Lu raise chickens in the hallway, both rushed to ICU for emergency treatment; doctor says psittacosis (Chlamydia psittaci) infection.
article.articleSummary: In Guilin, Guangxi, China, during the 2026 Spring Festival, an 82-year-old man and his 76-year-old wife kept several chickens in their hallway. Both developed high fever and pneumonia and were admitted to the ICU, requiring ventilation; the wife’s condition worsened and she required extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) for 9 days, with about 40 days of hospitalization in total before leaving the ICU. The husband spent 23 days in ICU. Laboratory tests and imaging confirmed Chlamydia psittaci infection (psittacosis), with concurrent bacterial and fungal infections. Psittacosis is associated with birds (chickens, ducks, pigeons) and can transmit via aerosols; protective measures and environmental cleaning are advised when handling poultry. Seek early medical care for fever and dry cough with poultry exposure and report contact history to clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: ルさん老夫婦が階段通路でニワトリを飼養、双方ともICU集中治療へ　医師：オウム病クラミジア感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的懸念）。ヒト-ヒト感染可能なオウム病の重症例2件、死亡リスク高い重症化事例。
triage.notes: オウム病（Chlamydia psittaci）は動物由来感染症だが、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある呼吸器感染症。症例は高齢者で重症化（両者ともICU入院、1人はECMO使用9日間）。併発感染（細菌・真菌）の存在と長期化した入院が懸念材料。春節期間中の住宅内での長期接触による感染リスク。オウム病は国際的な懸念対象疾患。

article.articleHeadline: शरीर के इन संकेतों न करें नजरअंदाज, हो सकते हैं मलेरिया के लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore these signs in your body; they could be malaria symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Malaria symptoms in New Delhi, India commence with intense chills and shivering, followed by high fever that can spike dramatically. Headache, fatigue, and weakness are common, with nausea or vomiting in many cases. As the fever subsides, profound sweating often drenches clothing and leaves individuals exhausted. Some patients may experience diarrhea and dehydration. The Ayush Ministry cautions against dismissing these early signs as simple viral fever or weather effects, as delayed diagnosis can allow malaria to progress and involve multiple organs. Prompt medical evaluation is essential when people have repeated chills, high fever, severe headache, vomiting, or excessive sweating, since early treatment is typically effective. This guidance originates from an Ayush Ministry post shared via IANS News Feed on April 27, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 体のこれらの兆候を見落とすな。マラリアの症状かもしれない。
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリアの症状啓発情報であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。インド保健省による公衆衛生情報の発表であり、異常な流行や突発的な事象の報道ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント検出ではなく、インド保健・アーユルヴェーダ・ホメオパシー省（Ayush Ministry）による季節的マラリア症状の啓発キャンペーンである。ニューデリーでの新規アウトブレイク報告、症例数増加、死亡例の報告など、アクティブなシグナルは記載されていない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rùng mình cảnh chó không rọ mõm giữa mùa nắng nóng, nguy cơ dại bủa vây
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shudder at the sight of unmuzzled dogs in the heat of summer as the risk of rabies looms.
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk rises in Ho Chi Minh City (TP.HCM) amid hot weather. By 20 April 2026, the city reported 3 rabies deaths, more than half of the 2025 total (5). Unvaccinated dogs roam public spaces, including Gia Định Park in An Nhơn, with reports of dogs left unleashed and not muzzled. On 17 April, a dog in Phước Thắng ward that was not vaccinated bit three people. Nationwide, Dak Lak Province reported five bites from a dog suspected of rabies on 9 April, and a 56-year-old man in Tây Ninh who did not seek medical vaccination after a bite developed numbness, fear of water, and died after seeking traditional remedies. Experts warn that hot weather accelerates rabies progression in infected dogs. Prevention emphasizes vaccinating dogs from 3 months old with annual boosters, registering with local authorities, and not allowing roaming. For bites, wash the wound for 15 minutes, disinfect, and seek immediate vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin; avoid traditional remedies. The public is urged to follow the “5 no” guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: 暑さの中で口輪なしの犬が徘徊する光景に戦慄、狂犬病のリスクが迫る
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による死亡事例が報告され、2026年4月20日時点で3人の死亡があり前年同期の60%以上に達している。ヒト-ヒト感染ではないが、人獣共通感染症として公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、異常（気候に伴う感染増加パターン）も認められるため、IHR基準該当とWPRO基準該当により PICKUP 判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にベトナムの複数地域（ホーチミン市、ダク・ラク省、タイ・ニン省など）での狂犬病事例を記述している。2026年4月20日時点で3人の死亡（前年同期5人の60%以上）、ワクチン未接種犬による咬傷事例が報告され、気候要因（暑さ）が感染進行を加速させるという懸念が専門家から示されている。人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はないが、動物との接触による曝露リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore these signs in your body; they could be malaria symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Malaria signs highlighted by India’s Ayush Ministry via a New Delhi post on April 27, 2026. Early malaria symptoms can mimic everyday fatigue or weather changes, risking delayed diagnosis. Initial indicators include sudden chills and shivering, then a fever that may be very high and not follow typical viral patterns. Severe headache, a heavy sensation in the head, and fatigue are common, with nausea and vomiting also possible. As fever subsides, profuse sweating drenches clothing and leaves the patient exhausted. Diarrhea and dehydration risk may arise. Some people underestimate these signals, treating them as seasonal illness, but untreated malaria can become serious, affecting multiple organs. Prompt medical evaluation is advised if recurring chills, high fever, severe headache, vomiting, or heavy sweating occur, since early treatment improves outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 体のこれらの兆候を無視しないでください。マラリアの症状である可能性があります
triage.triage_reason: インドの保健教育情報（Ayush省による啓発投稿）であり、新規の流行事例や公衆衛生上の異常な事象ではない。マラリアの既知の症状説明であるため、IHR基準・スクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアの一般的な症状に関する啓発・教育コンテンツであり、具体的な流行事例・患者数増加・異常なアウトブレイク情報を含まない。Bluedot APIが検出した理由は疾患名+地域キーワードの検索マッチと考えられるが、感染症危機管理の対象となるシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: PM urges vigilance against all communicable diseases - phnompenhpost.com
article.articleSummary: Cambodia’s Prime Minister Hun Sen urged vigilance against all communicable diseases, highlighting Ebola as a potential threat that could arrive at any time, alongside ongoing Covid-19 precautions. As of October 30, Cambodia reported 137,988 Covid-19 cases, 134,923 recoveries and 3,056 deaths. Vaccination remains high: about 95.10% of an estimated 16 million people vaccinated as of October 29; over 10 million third doses, 4.5 million fourth doses, and more than one million fifth doses administered. The country maintains stockpiles of more than eight million Covid-19 vaccines, with 15 million more expected from China as needed, and the United States pledging 7.5 million doses (two million delivered; the remainder to follow, to prevent spoilage). Officials emphasize preventive measures given the virus’s invisibility and note that Ebola deaths in Africa underscore potential importation risks into Cambodia.

triage.headline_ja: 首相が全ての伝染病に対する警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19とエボラウイルス病が言及されているが、カンボジアは対象国ではなく、記事は予防的警告であり具体的な新規事例報告ではない。検証可能な対象国でのイベント発生が確認できないため。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる内容はカンボジアの首相による予防的警告（COVID-19とエボラの両方に対する警戒呼びかけ）である。カンボジアは対象国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。Chinaはワクチン供給パートナーとして言及されているが、これは感染症イベント発生地ではなく、対象国リストに含まれるため参考として記載。記事は既知の感染症状況に関する予防的声明であり、新たな異常事象を報告していない。

article.articleHeadline: 消息：意大利将涉窃疫苗中国男子引渡至美国 | 徐泽伟 | COVID-19 | 中共黑客 | 大纪元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News: Italy to extradite a Chinese man involved in vaccine theft to the United States | Xu Zewei | COVID-19 | CCP hackers | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Italy to extradite Xu Zewei, a Chinese national accused by the United States of cyber espionage targeting COVID-19 research, vaccines, and diagnostics. US DOJ charges allege that from 2020–2021 Xu and others in the Chinese hacking group Hafnium targeted U.S. universities, immunologists, and virologists working on COVID-19 vaccines, therapies, and testing. Xu entered Italy in July 2025, was arrested in Milan under a U.S. global warrant, and is detained in a prison in Pavia, northwest of Milan. After a court found extradition feasible, the Meloni government approved the extradition to the United States, where the defendant faces counts including telecom fraud, aggravated identity theft, conspiracy to commit telecom fraud, and unauthorized intrusion into protected computer systems. The case carries significance for U.S.–Italy cooperation; Xu’s family disputes the charges, claiming he is an IT engineer from Shanghai.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース：イタリアがワクチン盗難に関与した中国人男性を米国に引き渡す | 徐泽伟 | COVID-19 | 中共ハッカー | 大紀元
triage.triage_reason: 本件はCOVID-19関連の感染症イベントではなく、ワクチン研究に対するサイバースパイ・身体引き渡しに関する法的・政治的事件である。疾患の発生、流行、公衆衛生上の影響を扱わないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「COVID-19」タグを付与しているが、記事の実質はサイバースパイと法的引き渡し事件であり、感染症の発生・流行ではない。EBS監視対象の感染症イベント情報ではないため dismissed。対象国中国は言及されているが、イベント自体が感染症の健康リスクとして認識できない。

article.articleHeadline: शरीर के इन संकेतों न करें नजरअंदाज, हो सकते हैं मलेरिया के लक्षण - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore these body signals; they could be malaria symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Malaria symptoms in New Delhi, India, can imitate a common viral fever, delaying diagnosis. On 27 April 2026, the Ayush Ministry cautioned via X that initial signs include sudden chills and shivering, followed by high fever and severe headache, with weakness and fatigue. Nausea or vomiting may occur, and some patients experience diarrhea. As fever subsides, intense sweating and dehydration risk rise. If these recurrent chills, high fever, headache, vomiting, or excessive sweating appear, prompt medical evaluation is essential, since early treatment typically leads to recovery. The advisory underscores vigilance to prevent progression and organ involvement, stressing timely diagnosis and care to avert malaria complications.

triage.headline_ja: 体のこれらの兆候を無視しないでください。マラリアの症状である可能性があります。
triage.triage_reason: インドのニューデリーでのマラリア症状に関する保健省の啓発情報。スクリーニング基準では異常性と管理可能性について該当の可能性があるが、イベント規模、死亡数、流行の広がりに関する具体的なデータが不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は保健省（Ayush Ministry）による啓発メッセージであり、ニューデリーでのマラリア症状についての教育的情報提供である。具体的な患者数、流行規模、重症度に関するデータが記載されていない。季節的なマラリア発生の可能性があるが、異常な流行の兆候については不明。今後の疫学的データと確定患者数の報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Cimahi Catat Lonjakan Campak Tembus 237 Kasus, Mayoritas Anak Belum Divaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cimahi Health Office Records Measles Surge Surpassing 237 Cases, Most Children Have Not Yet Been Vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Measles surge in Cimahi City, Indonesia, with 237 suspected cases and 28 laboratory-confirmed positives as of 27 April 2026. Most cases are in children and spread across 13 kelurahan; no deaths and all patients recovered. Early April tallies were 155 suspected and 16 positives, rising to current figures. The majority of confirmed cases had not received measles or MR vaccination. Authorities urge parents to complete immunization, noting MR vaccine is given at 9 months, boosted at 18 months, and at ages 5–7 years via the School Immunization Month program. Cimahi’s 2025 basic immunization coverage exceeded 95%. Transmission is by respiratory droplets; prevention includes cough/sneeze etiquette, hand hygiene, and isolating individuals with fever and rash for at least four days after rash onset. Vaccination services are available at hospitals, Puskesmas, clinics, and independent midwives.

triage.headline_ja: チマヒ市保健局、麻疹患者237例を記録 大多数の子どもがまだワクチン接種を受けていない
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのチマヒ市で麻疹の急増（237疑似患者、28確認患者）が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的な関心）。麻疹はWHO通知対象疾患であり、ワクチン接種率の低下が背景にある中規模の流行シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: チマヒ市は西ジャワ州の人口密集地域。4月初旬から患者数が増加し、主に予防接種を受けていない子どもが罹患している。死亡例はなく全員が回復しているが、respiratory droplet感染のため、ワクチン接種率の改善と感染制御が重要。当局は予防接種キャンペーンを呼びかけている。

article.articleHeadline: Seven-Year-Old Dies, Nineteen Others Hospitalised After Eating Golgappa in Jharkhand's Giridih Area - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old dies and 19 others hospitalised in Giridih, Jharkhand, after consuming street-side golgappas, suspected food poisoning. Victims, mainly children, report severe vomiting and nausea shortly after eating. Health department launched probe, collected food samples, vendor’s cart seized; samples of flavoured water and chickpeas sent to a forensic laboratory to identify the contaminant. Preliminary investigations point to contaminated water used by the vendor as the likely source. Most patients are now stable, though 19 remain under medical observation. Officials issued a public advisory urging caution with street food and pledged enforcement against vendors lacking sanitation standards. This incident underscores concerns about unregulated street food safety in the region and highlights ongoing investigations into the exact contaminant.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルカンド州ギリディでゴルガッパ摂取後に7歳児が死亡、19人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の可能性が高い限定的な集団発生（1死亡、19入院）。公衆衛生影響は局所的であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いと評価される。ただし死亡例を含むため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 限定的な食中毒の集団発生。病原体が特定されていない（Unknown Illness）点が技術的には注目される。既に地方保健当局により調査・対応が実施されている。国際的拡大リスクは極めて低い。フルRRAは不要だが、病原体特定結果の続報を注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dog Bite Menace On Rise: Maharashtra Records Nearly 5 Lakh Cases, 19 Rabies Death In 3 Months
article.articleSummary: Dog bites and rabies in Maharashtra surged in early 2026: 4,99,553 bite cases and 19 rabies deaths from January–March 2026, per state public health data, versus 2025’s 15,19,913 bites and 33 deaths and 2024’s 11,41,688 bites with 23 deaths. The data, from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) and State Public Health Department, show urban centers bearing the brunt and a near doubling of cases over five years. The Vasai Virar Municipal Corporation (VVCMC) also reported a sharp rise in bites. A 10-year study (2014–2024) by BMC in collaboration with Humane Society International India assessed street dog population trends and the impact of sterilisation, underscoring ongoing rabies spillover risk and the need for sustained public health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 犬咬傷の脅威が上昇：マハーラシュトラ州が3ヶ月間でほぼ5ラク件の症例、19件の狂犬病死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハーラシュトラ州で狂犬病による死亡を含む大規模な犬咬傷事例が報告されており、過去5年間で症例数がほぼ倍増している。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急増）と、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に複数該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではマハーラシュトラ州（ムンバイ、ヴァサイ・ヴィラル地域）の具体的データが詳述されているが、インド全体の公衆衛生データとして報告されている。3ヶ月間で19件の死亡、約50万件の咬傷事例は極めて高い罹患率を示している。過去5年間での倍増傾向は深刻な管理課題を示唆。狂犬病は予防可能だが予防措置の不充分さが示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: ठेले पर गोलगप्पे खाने से मासूम बच्चे की मौत, 36 से अधिक लोगों की हालत गंभीर, मौत और जिंदगी के बीच जूझ रहे कई लोग, आखिर पानी पूरी में क्या था ऐसा? | Jharkhand Food Poisoning Case: An innocent child died after eating golgappas from a street vendor, and more than 36 people are in critical condition.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of an innocent child after eating golgappas from a street vendor, more than 36 people are in critical condition, many are fighting for their lives, what exactly was in the pani puri that caused this?
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand, Giridih district in India reports a street-vendor linked food poisoning outbreak after consuming golgappas/pani puri. More than 36 people fell ill, including one child who died, with several others in critical or serious condition. The incident is dated 27 April 2026. The article provides no laboratory confirmation or identified contaminant, but attributes illness to pani puri from a local vendor. Symptoms are not specified beyond illness and critical status. This event underscores food-safety risks associated with street-side vendors and the potential for severe outcomes in children, prompting ongoing investigations into contamination sources by health authorities. No information is provided on treatment details or broader outbreak scope beyond the reported cluster.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州での食中毒事件：路上販売の揚げたてスナック「ゴルガッペ」を食べた子どもが死亡、36人以上が重篤な状態
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例を含む集団食中毒事件であり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例と複数の重篤症例）および重症度の観点から1つ以上の基準を満たす。対象国インドでの発生。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月27日のジャールカンド州ギリディ地区での食中毒事件を報告。病原体の同定なし、汚染物質の特定なし、症状の詳細な記載なし。路上販売者由来の食中毒であり、子ども死亡例を含む36人以上の患者が報告されている。衛生当局による調査進行中。フルRRAでは検査確認状況、病原体同定、さらなる拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 一堆家庭都這樣做！婦吃隔夜菜喪命　專家揭這細菌不怕冷：易藏4類食物 | 健康 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many households do this! A woman dies after eating overnight leftovers; experts reveal this bacterium isn't afraid of the cold: four types of foods that readily harbor it.
article.articleSummary: In Henan, China, a 35-year-old pregnant woman died after suspected Listeria monocytogenes infection linked to refrigerator leftovers; she was hospitalized for three months. Listeria can thrive in cold, earning the label fridge killer and may contaminate foods beyond raw meat and seafood, including opened sauces, poorly sealed ready-to-eat dishes, and cut fruits stored in the fridge. For healthy adults, infection often causes mild diarrhea or fever, but risk is highest for pregnant women and the elderly. Listeria can cross the placenta, causing miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth; neonatal mortality among infected babies nears 30%. The incubation period can extend up to two months and initial symptoms may resemble a cold. Preventive measures: thoroughly reheat refrigerated foods until fully cooked; limit cooked leftovers to under three days; consume cut fruits within 24 hours; seal raw meat/seafood to avoid cross contamination; disinfect the fridge monthly.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの家庭がこのようにしている！女性が隔夜菜を食べて命を落とす　専門家がこの細菌は冷気を怖がらないことを明かす：4種類の食物に容易に潜伏
triage.triage_reason: リステリア菌による死亡例が報告されており重症度が懸念されるが、個人事例の報道であり集団発生または蔓延の証拠が不明瞭なため。情報充実を待つべき。
triage.notes: 記事は河南省での妊婦死亡例を報告しており、リステリア菌の冷蔵食品汚染リスクに関する啓発色が強い。集団発生の規模、他地域への拡大、対応体制の状況が不明。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Parbhani News: जिल्ह्यात मलेरियावर प्रभावी नियंत्रण; रक्त तपासणी, प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाययोजना
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parbhani News: Effective malaria control in the district; blood testing, preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Parbhani district in Maharashtra, India, has achieved effective malaria control over the past four years, with zero deaths reported. The district malaria control department attributes the success to continuous surveillance, large-scale blood testing, and comprehensive preventive measures. Rigorous vector-control activities included spraying and widespread use of bed nets, along with eliminating standing water around homes to prevent mosquito breeding. The integrated approach has reduced transmission and ensured a mortality-free period in the district through 2026. The report underscores the importance of sustained monitoring and community-level prevention to maintain malaria suppression and protect affected populations in Parbhani. This achievement underscores sustained progress against malaria, a vector-borne disease, and highlights the value of integrated surveillance and community engagement in endemic districts.

triage.headline_ja: Parbhani News: 県でマラリアに対する効果的な制御を達成；血液検査、予防措置
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの制御に成功した好ましいニュースであり、異常なイベントや危機の兆候ではない。死亡ゼロ、感染者数の継続的な減少、国際的拡大リスクがなく、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアの感染症危機・アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、制御成功の公衆衛生成果を報告する記事である。過去4年間にゼロ死亡を達成し、継続的なサーベイランス、血液検査、蚊帳配布などの予防措置が効果を発揮した事例。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk: Bé trai 2 tuổi tử vong do mắc viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak: 2-year-old boy dies from meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: On 27 April 2026, the Dak Lak Center for Disease Control (CDC) reported a fatal case of meningococcal meningitis in a 2-year-old boy from Tan An Ward, Dak Lak Province. The child developed rhinorrhea on 23 April, followed by fever and vomiting, and was hospitalized on 25 April with septicemia, meningococcal meningitis, and severe pneumonia. He died on 26 April at 9:45. The death was due to meningococcal infection on a background of pneumonia; the child had not been vaccinated against meningococcal disease. Dak Lak CDC conducted contact tracing, collected samples for testing, and provided prophylactic antibiotics to close contacts; environmental disinfection with Chloramin B was performed at the home and surrounding area. Meningococcal meningitis is caused by Neisseria meningitidis and spreads via respiratory droplets; vaccination is advised, especially for children. The report notes a link to an ongoing outbreak in Phu Quoc.

triage.headline_ja: ダックラック州：髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で2歳男児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による死亡例の報告であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡）と予想外性が該当。同時にプーケットの継続的なアウトブレイク関連が示されており、拡大リスクあり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでダックラック州での死亡が主題であり、ベトナム（1562822）を verified_locations に含める。プーケットへの言及はあるがタイの主要なアウトブレイク情報ではないため、タイは除外。ワクチン未接種の2歳児死亡という重度の事例であり、プーケットとの関連性も示唆されており、ベトナム国内でのシグナル拾い上げが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận 2 ca mắc viêm não mô cầu, 1 trẻ tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two cases of meningococcal meningitis reported, one child died.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal meningitis cases reported in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, with one pediatric death. On 27 April 2026, the Dak Lak Center for Disease Control confirmed two Neisseria meningitidis infections; the deceased is N.D.T.E., born in 2024, residing in Tan An ward, Dak Lak, and unvaccinated. The child’s symptoms began 23 April (nasal discharge), then high fever and vomiting by 25 April, leading to hospital care for respiratory failure, septicemia due to meningococcal meningitis, pneumonia, and meningitis; death occurred 26 April at 09:45. A close contact, the uncle, also tested positive and is currently symptomatic (cough, fatigue) and isolated at Tay Nguyen General Hospital. Authorities have initiated epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, testing, and chemoprophylaxis for close contacts, along with environmental disinfection and community alertness. Meningococcal disease is transmitted via respiratory droplets in close contact and can progress rapidly, underscoring outbreak vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎2例を報告、小児1名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当。小児死亡、接触者への急速な伝播、ワクチン未接種による脆弱性が認識されており、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはダックラク省（Dak Lak）が記載されていないが、記事サマリー内で明示されている。地名検証時に確認されたロケーション（Tân An ward, Dak Lak）はベトナム中部地域。小児死亡例の存在、接触者の二次症例発生、ワクチン未接種状況、急速な進行（症状発症から死亡まで3日）が懸念要因。アウトブレイク対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 一堆家庭都這樣做！婦吃隔夜菜喪命　專家揭這細菌不怕冷：易藏4類食物 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many households do this! A woman dies after eating yesterday's leftovers; experts reveal this bacterium isn't afraid of the cold: four types of foods that can easily harbor it.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-27 in Henan, China, a 35-year-old pregnant woman died after likely contracting Listeria monocytogenes from refrigerated leftovers, with three months of hospitalization prior to death. Listeria can thrive at refrigerator temperatures, earning the nickname fridge killer. Beyond raw meat and seafood, four food types are flagged as risk sources: opened sauces, improperly sealed ready-to-eat foods, leftovers stored after opening, and cut fruits. In healthy adults, infection often causes mild diarrhea or fever; however, risks are highest for pregnant women and the elderly, as Listeria can cross the placenta, causing miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth, with neonatal mortality near 30%. The incubation period can be up to two months, and early symptoms may resemble a cold. Prevention includes heating refrigerated foods until fully cooked, avoiding lukewarm reheating, consuming refrigerated prepared foods within 3 days, finishing cut fruit within 24 hours, sealing raw meat/seafood, and monthly fridge cleaning and disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの家庭がこうしている！女性が前日の残り物を食べて死亡、専門家が冷蔵庫細菌の脅威を明かす：4種類の食品に隠れやすい
triage.triage_reason: リステリア菌による妊婦死亡という個別重篤事例であり、重症度基準に該当するが、公衆衛生的影響の範囲やエビデンスが単一事例に限定され、IHR基準の複数該当や国際的拡大リスクの明確性に欠ける。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の死亡事例であり、集団発生の報告なし。リステリア菌は既知病原体で異常性に乏しい。食品安全に関する注意喚起記事としての性質が強く、感染症クラスター・集団発生とは異なる。ただし妊婦死亡という重症転帰が記述されているため、追加情報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Atasi Kasus TB, Pemprov Lampung Gandeng Dokter Paru, Pemeriksaan ke Berbagai Pintu Masuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tackling TB Cases, Lampung Provincial Government Teams Up with Pulmonologists for Screenings at Various Entry Points.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) control in Lampung Province, Indonesia, is being intensified through collaboration between the provincial government and pulmonologists, with screening tools to be deployed at multiple entry points, including seaports and airports in Bandar Lampung. Deputy Governor Jihan Nurlela says the goal is to boost TB case detection, currently around 14%, even though treatment success—including for drug-resistant TB—is already satisfactory. The initiative seeks to meet ASEAN-standard targets for case finding. Public guidance urges individuals with prolonged cough, night sweats, weight loss, or other TB symptoms to seek evaluation at the nearest community health center (puskesmas). If positive, close contacts should also be tested to interrupt transmission, and isolation remains a key preventive measure. Early entry-point screening aims to reduce spread and strengthen TB control in the region as of 27 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: TB対策を強化、ランプン州政府が肺専門医と連携し、複数の出入国地点での検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるTB症例への対策強化の報道であり、スクリーニング基準では「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性がある。しかし、新規発生や異常な増加の明確な証拠がなく、既存TB対策の継続的な取組みの報道であるため、情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（ランプン州）におけるTB対策の強化策に関するもので、新規感染症危機ではなく既存TB管理プログラムの継続的取組みの報道。ただしヒト-ヒト感染リスクと長期曝露の可能性があり、公衆衛生当局の関心は高い。続報で検査陽性率や新規症例の増加傾向が確認されれば評価を再検討する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Pani puri food poisoning suspected as a child dies, 60 others fall ill in Jharkhand
article.articleSummary: On 27 April 2026, in Jharkhand’s Giridih district, a suspected pani puri (gupchup)–related food poisoning has sickened more than 60 people and caused at least one death across Bajto and Palmo panchayats. On the first day, about 40–50 residents in Bajto reported diarrhoea; a six-year-old child died after being taken to Giridih Sadar Hospital. The following day, around 20 more cases appeared in Palmo, with about 10 patients admitted to hospital. All affected individuals are linked to pani puri sold by a vendor from Palmo, who was detained and released the same night. The family alleges ambulance delays (ambulance arrived around 3 pm after calls at 1–1:30 pm) and lapses in initial hospital care. Many patients receive saline; there is no laboratory confirmation reported, and the Civil Surgeon could not be reached for comment.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州でパニプーリ食中毒が疑われ、子ども1人が死亡、60人以上が発病
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessの集団発生（60人以上の患者、1人死亡）でIHR基準2項目以上に該当。食中毒の原因が確認されていない点で異常性あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上、イベントはインド・ジャールカンド州のギリディ地区（Giridih）およびその周辺のバジト（Bajto）とパルモ（Palmo）パンチャヤットで発生している。Bluedot APIはクロアチア（Bajto, Splitsko-Dalmatinska Županija）も検出しているが、これは同名地名の誤検出である。実際の感染症イベント発生国はインドのみ。原因食品（パニプーリ）が特定されているが、病原体の実験室診断がまだ行われていない点で情報が限定的。救急車の遅延や初期医療の不備についての家族からの指摘も含まれており、医療体制の適切性も問題となっている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford University deal could mark milestone in fight against malaria
article.articleSummary: As of 27 April 2026, Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India announced a non-exclusive global licence granting SII the rights to develop, manufacture, and potentially commercialise the R78C malaria vaccine candidate, which targets the blood-stage of Plasmodium falciparum. R78C forms part of a next-generation, multi-stage vaccine approach designed to combine multiple parasite-stage antigens to boost efficacy and durability, building on prior work with the R21 vaccine. The deal aims to enable scalable, affordable production in malaria-endemic regions, leveraging SII's global manufacturing reach to improve equitable access in low- and middle-income countries. Malaria remains a major public health burden with hundreds of millions of cases annually, predominantly among children in sub-Saharan Africa. The collaboration supports integrating R78C with existing components and advancing next-generation candidates toward broader global impact.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学の新型マラリアワクチン契約がマイルストーンとなる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存のマラリア流行ではなく、ワクチン開発・ライセンス契約に関する発表である。新規の感染症イベント（患者発生、流行、アウトブレイク）を報告するものではなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はオックスフォード大学とインドのSerum Institute of Indiaによるマラリアワクチン候補(R78C)のライセンス契約発表。既存マラリア流行の新規事例報告、患者数増加、アウトブレイクなどの具体的な感染症イベントの発生を報告していないため、EBS活動のシグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。記事は背景としてマラリアの公衆衛生負担に言及しているが、現在の具体的な流行危機を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand boy dies, 18 sick after eating roadside stall pani-puri
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning linked to a roadside pani-puri stall in Bajto village, Jharkhand, India, has led to one death and 18 people being treated, with authorities saying the 18 are in stable condition as of 27 April 2026. Health officials launched a formal investigation into the incident, with Deputy Commissioner Ramniwas Yadav stating that stale food held for several days may be the cause. Water samples are being tested as part of the inquiry, and laboratory confirmation has not yet been reported. The local administration and health department are coordinating to identify the infection source and prevent further cases, amid ongoing probe into the food vendor's practices. No other locations or imported/exported cases are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルカンド州の少年が死亡、露店のパニプリ喫食後18人が患病
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑い事案で1死亡18患者との重症度とアウトブレイクの可能性があるが、ラボ確認がなく「原因不明疾患」のため追加情報を注視する必要がある。国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はジャルカンド州（インド）の食中毒疑い事案。発生地域リストにCroatiaが含まれているが、記事サマリーに記載されておらず検証不可。ラボ確認待ちの段階であり、確定診断がなされていない点に留意。患者が安定状況とのことから急速な国際拡大の直接的リスクは低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Family of four people died due to suspected food poisoning in Mumbai
article.articleSummary: Four members of a Mumbai family died from suspected food poisoning yesterday, with vomiting reported; police say post-mortem examinations have been conducted and investigations are ongoing. A similar fatal suspected-food-poisoning case was reported last year in Odisha’s Dhenkanal district, in Asabani village under Kantabania Police Station limits. In a separate Odisha incident, a woman and her two sons died at Angul District Headquarters Hospital after consuming a meal of chicken, rice, and palanga leaves yesterday; they were brought to hospital and declared dead. These cases highlight suspected food poisoning as the cause of multiple fatalities, though no specific pathogens or laboratory confirmations are mentioned in the reports, and authorities continue inquiries.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの一家4人が食中毒の疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 複数の食中毒死亡事例（ムンバイおよびオディシャ州）が報告されており、重症度（死亡）は高いが、病原体が不明で検査確認なし。異常性は認められるが、公衆衛生への影響度が限定的で、国際的拡大リスクは低い。情報補完を待つ段階。
triage.notes: 食中毒の疑いだが病原体未特定、検査確認なし。ムンバイとオディシャ州（Angul、Dhenkanal地区）の複数地点での事例報告。警察による調査進行中。IHR基準2つ以上該当により技術的にはPICKUP対象だが、原因不明で情報が限定的なため、追加検査結果や病原体同定を待つべき段階と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ancaman Virus Marburg Mengintai, Kamera Ungkap Interaksi Berbahaya di Gua Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marburg virus threat looms as camera reveals dangerous interactions in a cave in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Python Cave, a known reservoir for Marburg virus, shows intense human-wildlife interactions. A Current Biology study using camera traps logged over 8,800 hours of footage from February-June 2025, recording 321 activities across at least 14 species, including birds of prey, primates, and leopards. Alarmingly, about 214 people—tourists, students, and researchers—entered or approached the cave despite safety rules. Marburg virus is carried by fruit bats; while the footage does not prove transmission, it underscores spillover risk via direct bat contact, intermediate animals, or contaminated surfaces. Only one person among hundreds wore a mask. Transmission risk rises during bat birthing seasons. Marburg was first detected in 1967 in Europe and has caused outbreaks in Africa, including Angola and the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: マールブルグウイルスの脅威が迫る、ウガンダの洞窟でカメラが危険な相互作用を記録
triage.triage_reason: マールブルグウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ新興感染症で、ウガンダの洞窟での人間と野生動物の危険な接触が記録されており、人獣共通感染症のスピルオーバーリスクが明確に存在する。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: Current Biology研究に基づく科学的証拠で、マールブルグウイルスの自然貯蔵宿主（オオコウモリ）と多数の観光客・研究者の接触が記録されている。スピルオーバー発生の直前的状況と判断される。記事は2025年2月～6月のデータに基づいており、妊娠期間中の伝播リスク増加について言及されている。マールブルグウイルス病の致死率は通常50～88％。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Reports 1,773 Malaria Cases Before Monsoon, Early Spike Linked to Weather Change and Waterlogging | મુંબઈમાં ચોમાસા પહેલાં જ મલેરિયાના કેસમાં મોટો ઉછાળો : ૪ મહિનામાં ૧૭૭૩ કેસ નોંધાયા
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai Reports 1,773 Malaria Cases Before Monsoon, Early Spike Linked to Weather Change and Waterlogging | In Mumbai, a major surge in malaria cases before the monsoon: 1,773 cases were reported in four months.
article.articleSummary: Malaria cases surge in Mumbai, India, with 1,773 cases recorded from January 1 to April 21, 2026, according to Maharashtra health department data. The pre-monsoon spike is linked to weather changes and waterlogging, creating breeding grounds for Anopheles mosquitoes. Mumbai’s 2025 total was 10,163 malaria cases. Across Maharashtra in 2024–25, daily malaria cases averaged about 74–75 statewide, with Mumbai contributing 30–40% (around 28 cases per day). The rise is driven by wetter conditions and water stagnation from large-scale infrastructure development, providing ideal habitats for Anopheles mosquitoes. The report centers on Mumbai; no further details on imported/exported cases or laboratory confirmation are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでモンスーン前にマラリア感染者1,773人を報告、気象変動と浸水が関連
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なマラリア増加（前モンスーン期）で異常性は限定的。ただしムンバイで短期間に1,773例の報告があり、数値は注視を要する。国際拡大リスクや深刻な死亡・重症化の報告がないため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的なマラリア増加（前モンスーン期）を報告しており、気象条件と水の停滞がAnopheles蚊の繁殖地を増加させている。死亡率や重症化に関する具体的データが不明。国内で管理可能と見られ、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。ただし短期間での症例急増は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 黄鳝鳝锥体虫病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow eel trypanosomiasis.
article.articleSummary: Yellow eel trypanosomiasis is caused by the eel trypanosome living in the blood of yellow eels. The disease shows a seasonal pattern with peaks from June to August. Infected eels exhibit weight loss, poor growth, and anemia, especially with heavy parasitemia; blood microscopy reveals parasites that tremble quickly but move slowly. Prevalence is high in natural waters: infection in yellow eels from Honghu Lake and two other lakes ranges from 70% to over 100%, while BaiMiao Fish Farm ponds show 20–30% infection. Lower pond infection is attributed to water management and disease-control measures that reduce vectors and intermediate hosts. Seasonality is not strongly affected by the parasite’s incidence. The eel trypanosome is described as a common parasite in yellow eels, consistent with the related hidden thorn parasite.

triage.headline_ja: 黄鳝鳝錐体虫病
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは野生・養殖ウナギ（黄鳝）における原虫寄生症であり、ヒトへの病原性は記述されていない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および社会的関心の証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物（ウナギ）の寄生虫疾患に関する記事であり、IHR通知対象の感染症ではない。Bluedotが中国での発生を検出したが、ヒト感染例や公衆衛生上の懸念は記事に記載されていない。対象国リストの適用外。

article.articleHeadline: Пошук стародавньої ДНК у тропіках. Скелети з В'єтнаму змусили переглянути історію сифілісу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Search for ancient DNA in the tropics. Skeletons from Vietnam forced a reassessment of the history of syphilis.
article.articleSummary: 3,200–4,000-year-old skeletal remains from Man Bac, northern Vietnam, show congenital treponematoses transmission beyond venereal syphilis. Dr. Melandri Vlock and colleagues at Charles Sturt University analyzed teeth and bones of three children, revealing defects consistent with treponemal infection. The regional epidemiology indicates frambesia tropica–like disease was widespread among adolescents and children, aligning with non-venereal transmission via ordinary contact. This challenges the long-standing palaeopathology assumption that congenital infection in ancient remains is definitive proof of venereal syphilis. The finding implies a global re-evaluation of historical claims that Columbus introduced syphilis to Europe; congenital transmission can no longer be used as a reliable diagnostic filter. DNA recovery in tropical contexts is severely hampered by rapid degradation, leaving many ancient treponematoses genomes unrecoverable.

triage.headline_ja: 古代DNAの熱帯地での探索。ベトナムの骨格遺跡が梅毒の歴史の再評価を迫る
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは3,200～4,000年前の古代遺骨に関する古病理学的な考古学研究であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。現代の公衆衛生脅威を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は考古学・古病理学の学術研究に関するもので、現在の感染症監視対象外である。Man Bac遺跡（ベトナム北部）の古代遺骨分析であり、現代の患者発生やアウトブレイクではない。シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Can Extreme Heat Have A Bad Effect On Your Gut? Experts Explain Gut Infections
article.articleSummary: During Mumbai’s ongoing heat wave, stomach infections have surged, with doctors reporting about a 50% rise among adults aged 30–45 presenting with loose stools, nausea, vomiting and weakness. Experts attribute these cases to heat-accelerated bacterial contamination of food and water, compounded by dehydration that weakens the gut lining. Rapid transitions between extreme heat and air conditioning may further disrupt digestion and immunity. Dr. Rishikesh Malokar notes the surge and links symptoms commonly to bacterial contamination rather than viral infection; Dr. Shubham Jain cites a 30% rise in gastrointestinal infections, with about 3 in 10 patients showing dehydration, bloating, gas, acidity, nausea and weakness. Precautions include freshly cooked home meals, avoiding street foods and open fruits, and staying well hydrated. During peak summer in Mumbai, strict food hygiene and avoiding uncovered foods can reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 極度の暑さは腸に悪い影響を与える可能性があるか？専門家が腸感染症について説明
triage.triage_reason: 未知の疾患ではなく、既知の季節性胃腸感染症の増加についての一般的な健康記事。公衆衛生上の新規脅威として扱うべき異常なイベントではなく、予防医療の啓発記事である。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の胃腸感染症の一般的な啓発記事であり、感染症イベントの検出というより健康情報メディア記事である。Bluedot APIが『Unknown Illness』として分類しているが、実態は既知のバクテリア性胃腸感染症の季節的増加である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk ghi nhận một bệnh nhi tử vong do bệnh viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak records one pediatric death due to meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Dak Lak, Vietnam reports a pediatric death from meningococcal meningitis. Patient N.D.T.E. (born 2024) from Quảng Phú commune and resident of Tân An ward developed runny nose on 23 April, then fever, vomiting, and lethargy on 25 April. He was treated at Thiện Hạnh General Hospital and a regional hospital, with septicemia due to Neisseria meningitidis, pneumonia, and meningitis. He died on 26 April at 09:45 from fulminant meningococcemia with pneumonia; the child had not received meningococcal vaccination. On 26 April, Dak Lak CDC collected samples from the patient and a close contact N.Đ.Q. (born 1985). Both samples tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis (2/2). On 27 April, N.Đ.Q. developed cough and fatigue and was admitted to the Infectious Diseases Department, isolated. Authorities conducted investigation, contact tracing, microbiological testing, prophylaxis for close contacts, and environmental decontamination with 0.5% Chloramine B; vaccination is emphasized for prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による小児死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目該当（異常性・重症度）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。死亡事例、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、予防接種未受検の小児患者という特性から国際的関心の対象となる。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による確認死亡例1件、追加確認症例1件（接触者）。両者ともNeisseria meningitidis PCR陽性。予防接種未受検の2024年生まれの小児患者が重症化・死亡。発症から死亡まで3日の急速な進行（劇症型敗血症菌血症）。地域的な接触者追跡、環境除染、予防接種対応が実施されている。ベトナムではメニンゴコッカスワクチン導入状況が不明であり、公衆衛生上の懸念が存在。

article.articleHeadline: 5 dấu hiệu trẻ mắc bệnh truyền nhiễm mùa nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 signs that children contract infectious diseases during the hot season
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-27, pediatric admissions rise in Ho Chi Minh City during the hot season. Children’s Hospital No.1 reports a 15–20% increase versus the same period; Children’s Hospital No.2 handles about 3,000–4,000 daily visits, up ~20%. Common illnesses include acute respiratory infections, gastrointestinal infections, hand-foot-mouth disease, dengue, chickenpox, measles, and influenza, with meningococcal disease and pneumonia among concerns. Key signs to monitor: fever >38°C with fatigue or poor feeding; prolonged fever unresponsive to meds; vomiting, dehydration, diarrhea; irritability; rash; and, if accompanied by mouth ulcers, tremor, convulsions, or dyspnea, urgent evaluation for severe infectious diseases. Preventive measures emphasize vaccination (influenza, varicella, measles, meningococcal, Japanese encephalitis, RSV, cholera), hygiene, hydration, and sun-related precautions. Vaccination specifics: influenza from 6 months; under 9 years two doses 1 month apart, from 9 years one dose; varicella and measles two-dose schedules; meningococcal vaccines cover serogroups A, C, Y, W, plus B; RSV monoclonal antibody for birth to 2 years.

triage.headline_ja: 5つの兆候：子どもが暑い季節に感染症にかかる
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で小児の感染症患者が増加（前年同期比15～20%）し、多数の疾患（コレラ、RSV、髄膜炎菌、日本脳炎、麻疹、麻疹、インフルエンザ、エンテロウイルス71、デング、水痘）が関連している。WPROスクリーニング基準が複数該当（異常性、重症度懸念、流行可能性、管理可能性の検討が必要）。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市において多重の感染症（計10疾患）が同時に増加している。特に麻疹、デング、水痘などのVPD（ワクチン予防可能疾患）が含まれている点が注目される。季節的な流行の可能性があり、ベトナム全域への拡大リスクも考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Sudah 18 Korban, Kini Anak 11 Tahun Digigit Anjing Rabies di Buleleng Bali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are already 18 victims; now an 11-year-old child bitten by a rabid dog in Buleleng, Bali.
article.articleSummary: An 11-year-old child was bitten by a stray dog suspected of rabies in Banyuning, Kelurahan Banyuning, Kecamatan Buleleng, Kabupaten Buleleng, Bali, on Sunday 26 April 2026 at about 14:00 WITA. This follows a surge of dog-bite cases earlier in the week, with 18 residents bitten on 23 April 2026, including two children aged 10 and 5. All victims have received rabies vaccines at local health centers and hospitals, but the biting dogs have not yet been captured. The Buleleng Department of Agriculture and Livestock has been vaccinating pets and stray dogs in the area. Authorities note difficulties in accessing rabies vaccines at primary care facilities, as observation of animals often slows response; amid the emergency, some residents have paid privately to receive vaccines. The incident underscores ongoing rabies risk in Bali's Buleleng.

triage.headline_ja: 既に18人の被害者、今度は11歳の子どもがバリ州ブレレン地区で狂犬病の疑いのある犬に咬まれた
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリ州で狂犬病による複数の咬傷事例（計19人以上）が発生。致死的疾患であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、管理能力の課題（ワクチン不足）が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上該当、スクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致命率がほぼ100%の重篤疾患。短期間での複数事例、特に子ども被害、ワクチン・動物確保の課題が指摘されており管理困難性が高い。バリ州の観光地としての国際的位置づけを考慮すると、渡航者への感染リスクも存在。

article.articleHeadline: Kondisi Sempat Kritis, Jessica Iskandar Ceritakan Momen Lawan Hepatitis A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Condition Was Briefly Critical: Jessica Iskandar Recounts the Moment She Battled Hepatitis A.
article.articleSummary: Indonesian actress Jessica Iskandar (Jedar) faced a severe Hepatitis A episode in Thamrin, Central Jakarta, Indonesia, requiring intensive care after a prolonged fever peaking at 39.3°C with daily spikes for about three days. Initial blood tests did not clearly indicate Hepatitis A, allowing her to go home, but her condition deteriorated, prompting re‑evaluation and a hospital admission where clinicians confirmed Hepatitis A. She reports weakness, constant fever, malaise, chills, and tremors; there is no specific antiviral treatment, with recovery resting and supportive care. She suspects food hygiene issues triggered the illness and now emphasizes stricter cleanliness at home and cautious food handling, including handwashing or wearing gloves. Her immunity has been compromised by sleep deprivation from over a year of caring for her baby; she is gradually improving and resuming activities with heightened health precautions. No mention of vaccination or outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 状態が一時的に危篤状態に：ジェシカ・イスカンダルがA型肝炎と闘った瞬間を語る
triage.triage_reason: 個人の疾患エピソード報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常や集団発生の証拠がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアの著名人による個人的な疾患経験談であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生やアウトブレイクの兆候を示していない。A型肝炎はインドネシアで既知の疾患であり、単一症例の重症化報告は通常の感染症監視対象外。フルRRA進行の必要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: 哪些病媒生物需要重点关注和防范？专家列出名单
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Which disease vectors require special attention and prevention? Experts have listed the names.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-27, China's National Health Commission, via Guangdong Provincial CDC, held a press briefing on Healthy Cities and disease prevention. Experts identified key disease vectors needing attention: dengue fever and chikungunya are transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; Japanese encephalitis by Culex tritaeniorhynchus; and malaria by Anopheles sinensis. Mosquitoes are among the deadliest vectors, with the WHO noting over 700,000 annual deaths from vector-borne diseases worldwide. Beyond mosquitoes, rodents spread plague, hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome, and leptospirosis; flies and cockroaches act as carriers of enteric pathogens such as Shigella, Salmonella, Vibrio cholerae, and Escherichia coli, with cockroaches also linked to allergic reactions and dermatitis. Ticks transmit severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, Lyme disease, and tick-borne encephalitis. The CDC urges environmental cleaning, personal protection, and integration of vector-control measures into daily life and public health campaigns to prevent outbreaks in China and globally.

triage.headline_ja: どの病媒生物に重点的な注意と予防が必要か？専門家がリスト化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国の公衆衛生委員会による病媒生物（蚊、ネズミ、ハエ、ダニなど）に関する啓発・教育的な発表であり、具体的な疾患の集団発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。複数の疾患名が列挙されているが、いずれについても患者数、重症度、具体的な発生状況の報告がなく、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の公式な病媒生物対策の啓発活動であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。複数の疾患が言及されているが、いずれも一般的な説明に留まり、現在の活動的な発生状況は示唆されていない。当該地域（広東省）での特定の疾患集団発生の報告もない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 2026年全国疟疾日宣传活动启动仪式在腾冲举办
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 2026 National Malaria Day Publicity Campaign Launch Ceremony Held in Tengchong
article.articleSummary: On April 26, 2026, the National Malaria Day publicity campaign launch ceremony was held in Tengchong City, Yunnan Province, China, to mobilize society to prevent malaria and avert re-transmission from imported cases. The 2026 theme—'Prevent malaria, prevent importation, early detection, early treatment'—was showcased through malaria prevention videos, themed display boards, expert consultations, and health-education materials designed to emphasize that residents are their own first line of defense. The event was organized by the National Health Commission’s Division of Health Immunization and hosted by the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention’s Institute of Parasitic Diseases Prevention and Control (National Center for Tropical Diseases Research), with co-management by Yunnan Provincial CDC and the Yunnan Institute of Parasitic Diseases Prevention and Control. The nationwide campaign will proceed under the framework of Health China 2030 and the malaria importation/re-transmission management measures, targeting priority regions and populations and strengthening surveillance and joint prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年全国疟疾日宣传活动启动仪式在腾冲举办
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は国家衛生保健委員会主催のマラリア予防啓発キャンペーンの発表イベント報道であり、新たな感染症クラスターの発生や異常事象を報告するものではない。ルーチンの公衆衛生啓発活動として分類され、シグナルトリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは中国国内のマラリア予防啓発キャンペーン開始式であり、既存の疾病管理枠組み内での定例的な公衆衛生活動。輸入症例と再感染リスク管理に言及しているが、新規アウトブレイク、重症化、国際拡大のリスクは記事から認識されない。

article.articleHeadline: Ako putujete u ove zemlje, budite oprezni: Britanci izdali upozorenje zbog opasne groznice koja se širi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you are traveling to these countries, be careful: Britons have issued a warning about a dangerous fever that is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Travel Health Pro and UK Foreign Office have issued a warning as yellow fever cases rise. By early 2026, 41 cases have been reported, including 18 deaths; in 2025, South and Central America recorded 346 cases and 143 deaths. Yellow fever is a mosquito-borne flavivirus causing fever, severe muscle pain, jaundice, bleeding, and injury to liver, kidneys, and heart; severe forms carry 20-50% mortality. Urban transmission in areas with abundant mosquitoes raises epidemic risk. Risk countries include many in Africa (Angola, Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, DR Congo, Ivory Coast, Ghana, Nigeria, Senegal, Uganda) and in the Americas (Argentina, parts of Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Venezuela). In 2026, spread extends beyond regions (e.g., São Paulo, Brazil; Tolima, Colombia). Vaccination before travel and mosquito bite prevention are advised; check Travel Health Pro or Foreign Office guidance. Diagnosis by culture, serology, or PCR; treatment is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: これらの国に旅行する場合は注意してください：イギリス人が広がっている危険な熱についての警告を発行しました
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の多地域での拡大報告であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当、かつ旅行警告発出による社会政治的関心があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域には対象国外の多くの国が含まれている（パナマ、アルゼンチン、エクアドル、ウガンダ、セネガル、パラグアイ、ベナン、コートジボワール、カメルーン、アンゴラ、ペルー、ブルキナファソ、ベネズエラ、スリナム、ナイジェリア、コロンビア）。記事サマリーに明示されている対象国内の発生地はブラジル（サンパウロ、都市部での伝播拡大）、DRC、ガーナのみ。2026年初期での41例（死亡18）、2025年での南米・中米346例（死亡143）の報告があり、蚊媒介によるウイルス感染症として都市部での流行拡大リスクが高い。ワクチン接種前後のトラベルヘルスケアガイダンスと媒介生物対策が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra en RDC : le Nord-Kivu en tête avec de nouvelles contaminations, 215 cas suspects et un décès, résurgence signalée à la prison de Mbanza-Ngungu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in the DRC: North Kivu leads with new infections, 215 suspected cases and one death, resurgence reported at Mbanza-Ngungu Prison.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) concentrates in North Kivu with 215 new suspected cases and 1 death this week. Nationally, suspected cases total 915 with 4 deaths (case fatality 0.4%), down from 968 and 1.5% the prior week, with declines also seen in Kinshasa, Haut-Katanga, Tanganyika, and Haut-Lomami. Kinshasa city-province reports 33 new suspected cases and no deaths, 10 active patients in treatment (down from 16). In Mbanza-Ngungu Prison, cumulative cases rose from 160 with 13 deaths as of 17 April to 168 cases after 8 new cases since 18 April, across four prison pavilions. WHO/OMS continues multisectoral support to strengthen community detection, water treatment, sanitation, handwashing, and rapid reporting, aided by partners including FCDO. Authorities urge ongoing awareness and engagement across local leaders, media, schools, churches, and families.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるコレラ：北キブ州が主導、新規感染215件疑い例と1名死亡、ムバンザ・ングング刑務所での再発生報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。複数地域での流行継続、刑務所での再発生、死亡例報告。
triage.notes: コレラは環境中での生存能力が高く国際的拡大リスク有。刑務所環境での再発生は管理困難性の指標。複数地域での継続的な症例報告とWHO支援体制の継続から、国家的には管理可能性に課題あり。発生地域情報に北キブ州（North Kivu）の記載なし（Bluedot APIの地名抽出にギャップあり可能性）が、記事サマリー内で北キブ州が主要流行地として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Zydus receives approval to conduct Phase III trials of Zintrodiazine for malaria in India - Express Pharma
article.articleSummary: Zydus Lifesciences has received approval to conduct two Phase III clinical trials of Zintrodiazine for uncomplicated malaria in India. The multicentre, randomised, assessor-blind, active-comparator studies will evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of orally administered Zintrodiazine in patients with malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax. The P. falciparum trial will enroll 651 patients to evaluate efficacy by PCR-adjusted adequate clinical and parasitological response (ACPR); the P. vivax trial will enroll 390 patients to assess ACPR. Secondary endpoints include recrudescence (return of symptoms and parasites due to incomplete clearance), incidence of new infections, parasite clearance time and fever clearance time. Trials are conducted in India with the aim of supporting regulatory assessment of Zintrodiazine.

triage.headline_ja: Zydus Lifesciences、インドでマラリア治療薬Zintrodiazineの第III相試験実施を承認される - Express Pharma
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医薬品開発企業による臨床試験の承認に関するニュースであり、新規感染症アウトブレイクやイベントではなく、マラリア対策としての治療薬開発進行状況の報道である。感染症危機管理における即時対応が必要なシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアの臨床試験承認に関する報道であり、感染症アウトブレイク、異常事象、または医療危機に関するシグナルではない。医薬品開発の進行状況は感染症危機管理トリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Why are we seeing more outbreaks of the deadliest diseases? - AOL
article.articleSummary: Three suspected viral hemorrhagic fever cases in Lotimor, South Sudan, near the Ethiopian border, present with vomiting, diarrhea, high fever, and bleeding. An Airfinity alert, with WHO involvement, flags Ebola. The article notes outbreaks of Ebola and Marburg are rising: last year Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Ethiopia, and Marburg in Tanzania; excluding the South Sudan cases, there have been 15 Ebola/Marburg events since 2020, versus 11 in the preceding period. The 2014 West Africa Ebola outbreak killed about 11,000 across Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Guinea. Drivers include bat reservoirs and increased human–animal contact from deforestation, mining, agriculture, and bushmeat; the 2024 Rwanda Marburg outbreak traced to a miner with bats; concern about airborne transmission remains, though spread is primarily by contact. Reston strain shows airborne potential in animals; male survivors may harbor virus for up to five years. Governments are more prepared and vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ最も危険な疾病のアウトブレイクが増加しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。Ebola/Marburg VHF（複数国での複数事例）は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常な頻度増加、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを示す。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはEbola/Marburg VHFの歴史的・現在的流行を扱っており、South Sudan（対象国外）の疑い事例を報じている。DRCは過去1年の発症国として明記されており、対象国リストに該当。Ethiopia、Uganda、Tanzania、Liberia、Sierra Leone、Guineaは記事で言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。Reston株のairborne transmissionの懸念も注視点。

article.articleHeadline: Le coin lecture tmv : virus, pandémies et procès animalier
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TMV Reading Corner: viruses, pandemics and animal trials.
article.articleSummary: Les animaux malades des humains: au procès des zoonoses uses a courtroom frame with a mink, a bat, a pangolin, and a monkey pleading innocence to probe responsibility for pandemics. Anthropologist Frédérick Keck and illustrator Héloïse Chochois fuse scientific reports and historical facts to question humanity’s relation to other species, industrial farming, and climate disruption. A mink recounts suffering under human-imposed conditions and pleads not to be culled. The nutria (ragondin) is cited as Covid’s top culprit, with its scales used in Chinese medicine. Bats are virus reservoirs that do not transmit among themselves, unlike humans who spread gastrointestinal infections and influenza. The piece culminates in asking whether humans are the real culprit, leaving readers to decide. 128 pages.

triage.headline_ja: TMV読書コーナー：ウイルス、パンデミック、および動物裁判
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウイルスとパンデミックに関する文学作品（裁判形式の創作）の書評であり、実際の感染症イベント報告ではない。具体的な患者数、流行状況、公衆衛生上の具体的な懸念事項が記述されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の実際の発生を報告するメディアニュースではなく、パンデミックに関する創作文学作品（『動物たちの病：人間に苦しむ』）の書評である。COVID-19およびインフルエンザはサマリー内で言及されているが、これらは文学的背景設定の一部として扱われているのみで、実在する現在の感染症イベントの報告ではない。Bluedot APIの分類エラーと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: El sector del cerdo blanco busca más reaperturas de mercados tras la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The White Pig Sector Seeks More Market Reopenings After Swine Fever
article.articleSummary: Spain's white pig sector is pushing governments to broaden regionalization of African swine fever (ASF) to permit entry of products from all non-affected areas and reopen markets. Interporc chief Alberto Herranz says Japan and the Philippines are the main targets for accepting regionalization, following China's earlier agreement with Spain that kept trade flowing despite the first ASF focus, a pact credited with saving more than €1 billion. Ongoing wild boar outbreaks in Catalonia keep the sector vigilant, requiring reinforced biosecurity measures. China remains a key customer, with authorities' cooperation and favorable access conditions; Herranz notes that tariffs on Spanish exports have been substantially lower in China than the EU average amid a possible dumping probe into European pork. The goal is to allow imports from all Spanish zones not affected by ASF.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラ後、白豚セクターはより多くの市場再開を求める
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は動物衛生上の重要な疾患であり、国際的な貿易に影響を与える懸念がある。しかし、本記事は貿易交渉・市場再開に関する産業部門の提言が主題であり、新規の疫学的発生・拡大の報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はスペインのASF流行に関連する貿易再開交渉が主題である。対象国ではスペイン（EU加盟国、対象外）が最も詳細に述べられており、フィリピンと中国は将来的な市場再開の対象国として言及されている。日本はGeoNames IDで対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。本記事は新規のASF発生報告ではなく、既知の継続的流行への対応策の議論であるため、緊急度は相対的に低い。

article.articleHeadline: पाणीपुरी खाल्ल्यामुळे ६० जणांना विषबाधा, एका चिमुकल्याचा मृत्यू; झारखंडमधील धक्कादायक प्रकार!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 60 people poisoned after eating pani puri, a toddler dies; shocking incident in Jharkhand!
article.articleSummary: In Jharkhand’s Giridih district, 60 people from Bajto and Palmo villages have fallen ill with food poisoning after consuming pani puri from a single vendor based in Palmo. About 40–50 residents of Bajto developed symptoms on Sunday, with 20 more from Palmo admitted to a government hospital the next day. A six-year-old child died; his father blamed hospital delays, recounting that ambulance assistance arrived around 3 pm after a 1:30 pm call and that no immediate care was provided for about 90 minutes. The vendor was detained by police but released the same night. No official comment from civil authorities was available at the time; Indian Express could not reach the Civil Surgeon for confirmation. Investigations are ongoing to determine the infection source and the vendor’s role.

triage.headline_ja: パニプリを食べた後、60人が食中毒、幼い子どもが死亡；ジャールカンド州での衝撃的な事件！
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒による死亡を含む重篤な健康被害（60人発症、1人死亡）、医療対応の遅延、複数の村を巻き込んだ共通源爆発が確認される。国内的には異常/予想外な事象であり、インドの公衆衛生当局の介入と調査が進行中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にクロアチア（Bajto, Splitsko-Dalmatinska Županija）を誤判定。記事サマリーはジャールカンド州（インド）のみを対象としており、Croate関連の地点は地名の同名重複による誤検出と判断。食中毒の原因特定と医療体制の問題が調査対象となっており、今後の感染症情報（特にコレラなど水系感染症の可能性）に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo viêm não mô cầu: 2 Ca mắc và 1 trẻ tử vong tại Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis alert: 2 cases and 1 child died in Dak Lak.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal meningitis cases were reported in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, including one child death. The index patient, N.D.T.E., born 2024 and resident of Tan An ward, developed a runny nose on 23 April, then high fever and vomiting on 25 April and was admitted to Thien Hanh General Hospital and later transferred to Tay Nguyen Regional General Hospital. Diagnoses included septicemia due to Neisseria meningitidis, meningitis, respiratory failure II, and pneumonia; the child died at 09:45 on 26 April. The patient had not received meningococcal vaccination. Lab tests were positive for Neisseria meningitidis in both the child and a nearby uncle, who is now isolated and treated. Nationally, 26 meningococcal cases and 5 deaths occurred in the first four months of 2026, up about 50% from 2025. Early warning signs: fever, headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, purpuric rash; in children: irritability, poor feeding, lethargy, seizures. Vaccination and prompt care are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の警告：ダクラック省で2件の症例と1人の子どもの死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡あり、異常性：前年比50%増加、国際拡大リスク：未評価だが新興感染症）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度：死亡例あり、流行リスク：ヒト-ヒト感染病原体、管理可能性：国内集計でコントロール状況の不明確性）。社会的関心も高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、ダクラック省でのメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎の発生を報告。前年同期比で約50%増加という傾向が懸念される。予防接種未実施の死亡例があり、重症度が高い。ベトナムは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に追加。発生地域に Long An と Tân An が含まれているが、サマリーの主題は Dak Lak Province（ダクラック省）であり、これはベトナム国内の別の地域。

article.articleHeadline: West Nile Fever Reported In Kerala: Early Signs And Prevention Tips You Should Know
article.articleSummary: West Nile Fever has been reported as suspected in Kerala, India, with cases spanning Elanji, Eroor, Pallikkara, Ponekkara and Palluruthy as investigations continue. The illness is caused by the West Nile virus, cycling between birds and mosquitoes; humans are incidental hosts and transmission is not typically person-to-person. Most infections are asymptomatic (about 80%), while about 20% develop flu-like illness with fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, or rash; rare cases affect the brain or nervous system. Severe illness signs include high fever, stiff neck, confusion, tremors or seizures, requiring urgent medical care. Risk is higher for older adults and immune-compromised individuals, with estimates that up to 1 in 150 infected may develop severe disease. Kerala’s climate and monsoon season may favor mosquito breeding, underscoring prevention: repellents, protective clothing, nets, drainage, and vector-control efforts. Suspected cases noted in Ernakulam; seek prompt medical advice for persistent fever or neurological symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ウエストナイル熱がケーラ州で報告：初期兆候と予防対策について知るべきことを参照
triage.triage_reason: ウエストナイル熱がインドで初めて報告されたシグナルであり、異常/予想外の疾患出現（IHR基準2項目該当：異常性+国際拡大リスク）、複数地域での多数事例、脳炎等の重症化例が存在し、スクリーニング基準3項目以上該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのケーラ州（Ernakulam地区含む）でウエストナイル熱の疑似症例が報告されていることを述べており、複数の小地域にまたがる事例が記録されている。ウエストナイル熱はWPRO地域では新興再興感染症として重要。モンスーン季節の蚊媒介環境条件が存在する点も懸念材料。社会的関心もNDTVなど主要メディアで報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: 如何防控蚊媒传染病？专家：清积水、灭成蚊、防叮咬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to prevent and control mosquito-borne infectious diseases? Experts say: drain standing water, kill adult mosquitoes, and prevent bites.
article.articleSummary: On 27 April 2026, Chinese authorities warned that dengue fever and chikungunya fever—both transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes—pose increasing risk in southern China, including Guangdong. The prevention core is 'drain standing water, kill larvae, and prevent bites.' Measures: 1) Drain standing water in residential, construction, and park areas; remove idle containers, discarded tires, and litter. For fixed waters such as rainwater wells and drainage channels, perform regular cleaning—about one minute before/after work with a weekly deep clean. 2) Implement adult-mosquito control using physical and chemical methods (electric swatters, coils, fogging); conduct residual spraying where needed in common areas. 3) Strengthen personal protection: wear light-colored long sleeves and pants, apply repellents containing DEET or Picaridin, avoid dawn/dusk, install screens, and use nets at night. 4) Encourage community participation; report unusual mosquito activity to local committees, and if returning from dengue/chikungunya areas or after a bite with fever (≥38°C), severe headache, eye or muscle pain, or rash, seek medical care and disclose travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介感染症の防除方法は？専門家：溜め水を排除し、成蚊を駆除し、刺咬を防止せよ
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアとデング熱の両疾患が中国南部で増加リスク評価されており、複数のWPRO基準に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、国際的な拡大の直接的な兆候など重要な情報が不足している。続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発メッセージが主で、具体的な患者数・確認数・重症度に関する情報が記載されていない。中国当局による警告と広東省での蚊媒介感染症リスク認識は存在するが、現在のアウトブレイク規模や実際の患者発生が不明。蚊媒介感染症は季節性・地域性が強く、溜め水排除などの予防活動が行われていることは対応体制の稼働を示唆。今後の患者数増加報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Of Family Die Of Suspected Food Poisoning After Eating Watermelon
article.articleSummary: Four members of a Mumbai family (Abdullah Dokadia, 40; Nasreen Dokadia, 35; daughters Aisha, 16, and Zainab, 13) died from suspected food poisoning in the Pydhonie area after a dinner on April 25. Nine relatives dined together; four later ate watermelon. By early morning of April 26, the four developed severe symptoms (vomiting, loose motions) and were hospitalised, first with a family doctor then at JJ Hospital. The younger daughter died at about 10:15 AM, the husband at about 10:30 PM; the wife and elder daughter died during treatment. Post-mortems have been conducted; final cause to be confirmed after histopathological reports. An Accidental Death case is registered at JJ Marg Police Station. One victim reportedly had biryani before watermelon. In a separate incident in Jharkhand’s Giridih district, a seven-year-old died and 18 were hospitalised after allegedly consuming contaminated golgappa/chaat from a street vendor in Bajto village; investigation ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: スイカを食べた後、一家4人が食中毒の疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド（ムンバイとジャールカンド州）での食中毒関連の死亡事例で、複数州での類似事象、死亡者4名以上、国内拡大の可能性があり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）および社会的関心を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にインド国内（ムンバイ・ジャールカンド州）での食中毒事件を報告。Bluedot APIが検出したクロアチア関連の地名（Bajto, Splitsko-Dalmatinska）は座標の重複エラーと考えられるが、本文ではジャールカンド州Giridih地区Bajto村での事象と記載されており、インド領域内。複数地域での類似事象、死亡率の高さ、街頭食品販売を伴う可能性が高い曝露経路から、フードセーフティと感染症管理の観点から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC Masih Tinggi, Dinkes Malut Perkuat Kolaborasi Lintas Sektor untuk Target Eliminasi 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB Cases Remain High, North Maluku Health Office Strengthens Cross-Sector Collaboration Toward the 2030 Elimination Target.
article.articleSummary: TB remains a major health challenge in North Maluku, Indonesia, with global and national context from the Global TB Report 2025 showing 10.7 million cases worldwide and Indonesia's estimate of 1.08 million cases (382 per 100,000). On 27 April 2026 in Ternate, the North Maluku Health Office (led by Julys Giscard Kroons) underscored cross-sector collaboration to accelerate TB control, launching a Coordination and Planning Meeting for Public Private Mix (PPM) and expansion of TB preventive therapy (TPT) at the provincial level. In 2025, local TB case finding reached 3,961 cases, ~81% of a 90% target (up from 77%). Treatment outcomes show 75% success for drug-susceptible TB and 29% for drug-resistant TB, with TB among children around 23%. Elimination by 2030 hinges on active, integrated participation of all sectors and professional associations ensuring standardized care.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者数が依然多い、北マルク州保健局が2030年の排除目標に向けて部門横断的協力を強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病で、異常または予想外の発症ではなく、国家的な制御活動の進捗報告である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当は少ないが、政府による対応強化と国家目標への取り組みが認められるため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は結核という既知の感染症について、インドネシア（北マルク州）における制御活動の進捗報告である。政府レベルでの対応強化（PPM拡大、TB予防療法の展開）が記述されており、公衆衛生上の優先度は高いが、新興の危機的イベントではない。WPROスクリーニング基準は重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさで該当するが、異常性や予想外性に乏しく、またIHR基準は深刻な影響が認められるものの国際的な拡大リスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kudus mengajak masyarakat manfaatkan CKG untuk deteksi dini TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kudus Health Office invites the public to take advantage of CKG for early TB detection.
article.articleSummary: Kudus Health Office invites the public to use the Free Health Check (CKG) program for early detection of tuberculosis (TB) in Kudus Regency, Central Java, Indonesia. Health chief Abdul Hakam calls CKG a key entry point for TB case finding and notes intensified screening of suspected TB cases, including at 200 pesantren. Major risk factors include smoking (including passive exposure), malnutrition, and close contact with TB patients. The program aims to rapidly detect and treat TB to prevent transmission, with household members screened if one member is TB-positive. As of March 2026, 167,902 people registered for CKG, with 155,354 attending. Kudus collaborates with RSUD Kudus for diagnosis via X-ray, supported by mobile X-ray units and Near Point-of-Care TB (saliva-based) testing. Kudus ranks second in Central Java for TB control, and plans to add more mobile X-ray units to expand coverage toward the national TB elimination target by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: Kudus保健局が結核の早期検出のためにCKG（無料健康診断）の活用を国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで結核の早期検出プログラムが推進されている事例であるが、新規感染症発生や異常なアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、既存プログラムの通常的な公衆衛生活動である。スクリーニング基準の該当は限定的で、情報不足もあるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は結核症例の新規検出やアウトブレイクを報告しているのではなく、Kudus地域における既存の結核スクリーニングプログラム（CKG）の推進と拡大に関する通常的な公衆衛生情報です。結核は長期曝露リスクと流行しやすさの基準に該当しますが、異常性や予想外性は認められません。

article.articleHeadline: 香港发现今年首例登革热本地病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong Detects Its First Locally Transmitted Dengue Fever Case This Year.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports its first locally transmitted dengue fever case of 2026. As of Apr 23, the city has 16 dengue cases this year, with 15 imported and one local; the local case is a 21-year-old man from Tai Po Tai Wo Estate who developed fever, headache, myalgia and rash on Apr 12, was hospitalized Apr 16, and tested positive for dengue. Preliminary investigation places potential exposure at a road-construction site on Lantau Island, with most activities during the incubation (Mar 29–Apr 9) around the site and residence; no travel during incubation. The site has been halted; vector control and worker health surveillance are in progress, and a health station at Tai Wo Plaza offers free dengue antibody testing. Imported cases originate from the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand, and UAE. HK 2025 dengue cases were all imported; 2024 had 5 locally transmitted and 156 imported. Global dengue remains a rising public health challenge per WHO. Risk of local spread grows with warmer months.

triage.headline_ja: 香港が今年初の地域内感染デング熱症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の地域内感染が確認され異常・予想外な症例ではあるが、単一症例であり重症度情報や国際的拡大リスクが限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 香港(Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)は中国に含める。記事は単一の地域内感染症例報告であり、複数の国からの輸入症例が背景にあるが、香港自体での局所的な曝露リスク(建設現場)に限定されている。気温上昇に伴う媒介蚊活動の増加により局所感染拡大リスクが指摘されており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện 2 bệnh nhân mắc viêm não mô cầu ở Đắk Lắk, 1 trường hợp tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two patients diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis in Dak Lak Province, one dead.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal meningitis cases reported in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, with one death. An infant, N.D.T.Ê (born 2024) from Quảng Phú Commune developed nasal symptoms on 23 April, then high fever, vomiting, and lethargy on 25 April. Diagnosed with septicemia due to Neisseria meningitidis, severe pneumonia, and meningitis; died on 26 April at 09:45. The child had not received meningococcal vaccination. On 26 April, Dak Lak CDC collected samples; tests at Viện Vệ sinh Dịch tễ Tây Nguyên were positive for Neisseria meningitidis in two cases—the patient and his uncle, N.Đ.Q (born 1985), residing in Tan An Ward. The uncle showed symptoms on 27 April and was admitted to Tây Nguyên Regional General Hospital. Authorities conducted contact tracing across Cu M’Gar, Buôn Ma Thuột, and nearby communes; provided antibiotic prophylaxis to close contacts and disinfected environments with Chloramine B 0.5%. Public health messaging and vaccination recommendations emphasize meningococcal vaccination, especially for children.

triage.headline_ja: ダク・ラク省で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎患者2名を確認、1名死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響=死亡例あり、異常性=2つの確認事例、国際拡大リスク=接触者追跡により拡大リスク存在）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさで該当。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は報告可能疾患で、死亡例と確認事例（検査陽性）がある。接触者追跡と予防投与が実施されている。ワクチン未接種の乳児が死亡したため、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm não mô cầu, 1 trẻ không qua khỏi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis: one child did not survive.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 April, the Dak Lak Provincial Center for Disease Control reported two meningococcal meningitis cases in Dak Lak province, Vietnam, with one child succumbing. The deceased is 2-year-old N.D.T.Ê who developed symptoms starting 23 April (runny nose), high fever and vomiting by 25 April, then became lethargic and was admitted to Tây Nguyên Regional General Hospital; he died on the morning of 26 April. He had not been vaccinated. His uncle, N.Đ.Q., also tests positive for Neisseria meningitidis and exhibits cough and fatigue; he is in isolation and receiving treatment. Health authorities conducted rapid contact tracing, provided prophylactic antibiotics to close contacts, and disinfected the environment around the case. Meningococcal meningitis spreads via respiratory droplets and can progress rapidly with high mortality. Vaccination is advised, along with hygiene and prompt medical care. Nationwide, a recent case includes an 11-year-old student in Phú Quốc.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：1人の子どもが生き残らなかった
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による小児死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性」に該当。迅速な接触者追跡と感染対策が実施されているが、ワクチン未接種の高リスク集団が存在するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではダクラク省とフーコック島での症例が報告されており、いずれもベトナム国内。2歳の未接種小児が死亡し、親族も陽性確認。呼吸器飛沫感染による伝播リスクと高い致死率が問題。保健当局による接触者追跡と予防的抗生物質投与は実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Compleja evolución de enfermedad de manos, pies y boca en Vietnam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Complex progression of hand, foot, and mouth disease in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces a complex progression of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD), aggravated by significant circulation of Enterovirus 71 (EV71). As of April 15, 2026, Vietnam registered more than 34,000 HFMD cases and eight deaths. By comparison, 2023 had about 178,000 cases and 32 deaths; 2024 had 82,000 cases and one death; the previous year recorded about 105,000 cases with two deaths. In Hanoi, 2025 saw 6,271 HFMD cases; in early 2026, 2,308 cases were recorded across 126 districts/communes, with about 95% under five years old. The National Children's Hospital has treated over 700 HFMD patients this year, including more than 50 with severe disease. Hanoi's Pediatric Hospital reported 106 hospitalized and 569 ambulatory cases in March, and 92 hospitalized with 435 ambulatory in the first two weeks of April. HFMD has been detected in 34 provinces and cities; peaks occur March–May and September–October, with year-round transmission.
