triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでの手足口病の複雑な進展
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病の流行が継続中で、8名の死亡を含む34,000例以上の確定患者が報告されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たす。小児を中心とした多数患者の継続的な流行構造が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナム（特にハノイ）でのEV71関連手足口病流行に焦点を当てており、Bluedotが付与した発生地域はすべて同じイベントを指している。2026年4月時点で過去3年との比較データが提供されており、流行トレンド監視の重要性が高い。重症例および死亡が報告されており、小児への影響が顕著である。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk: Triển khai truy vết gấp sau khi phát hiện 2 ca viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak: Rapid rollout of contact tracing after detection of two cases of meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Two concurrent meningococcal meningitis cases reported in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, in April 2026, including a 2-year-old child who died on 26 April. The patient from Quảng Phú Commune developed runny nose on 23 April, then high fever, vomiting, and lethargy; diagnosed with septicemia and suspected meningococcal meningitis, with death despite resuscitation. A second case, N.D.Q., the child’s uncle from Tan An ward, Dak Lak, presented with cough and fatigue and tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis meningitis; he is hospitalized in Tây Nguyên General Hospital under isolation. Rapid tracing, sampling, and prophylactic antibiotics were deployed across Tan An, Quảng Phú, Tân Lập, Ea Kao, Thành Nhất, and Cuôr Đăng, with Chloramine B 0.5% environmental disinfection and targeted public-health messaging. Meningococcal meningitis spreads via close respiratory contact; vaccination is advised, especially for children. The report also notes a contained meningococcal outbreak at Cai Tau Prison in Ca Mau.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省：髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎2症例検出後、急速な接触者追跡展開
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の死亡例を含む2症例が報告され、多地域での急速な接触者追跡と公衆衛生対応が展開されている。IHR基準で異常性・予想外性と公衆衛生への影響が認められ、スクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例）、流行しやすさ、対応の必要性が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、発生地域はベトナム・ダクラク省およびカマウ省（獄中集団発生）と確認。2026年4月の最新報告。2歳児の死亡例あり、接触者追跡と環境消毒が急速に展開されている。国内の複数省における事例報告のため、WPRO基準の全項目に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Cháu bé 2 tuổi tại Đắk Lắk tử vong do nhiễm não mô cầu, khẩn trương phòng dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 2-year-old child in Dak Lak dies from meningococcal infection, urgent disease-control measures.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal disease cases reported in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, including a fatal 2-year-old boy (N.D.T.Ê) from Tan An ward. On 23 April, he developed runny nose and fever, progressing to high fever, vomiting, and lethargy; diagnosed with acute respiratory failure, suspected septicemia due to Neisseria meningitidis, severe pneumonia, and meningitis monitoring, and died on 26 April at 09:45. The child had not been vaccinated against meningococcal disease. A close contact, his uncle N.D.Q (41), tested positive for meningococcal bacteria and was isolated. Public health teams conducted contact tracing across Quảng Phú, Cuôr Đăng, and Tan An, Tan Lập, Ea Kao, Thành Nhất; close contacts received prophylactic antibiotics. Environmental decontamination with Chloramine B 0.5% was performed. Authorities urge vaccination and hygiene; meningococcal disease can progress rapidly and be fatal within 24 hours if untreated.

triage.headline_ja: ダックラク省の2歳児が髄膜炎菌感染で死亡、疾病管理の緊急措置
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌疾患による死亡例と陽性確定例の報告。IHR基準で重症度（死亡）と異常性を満たし、WPROスクリーニングでは重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。ベトナムは対象国であり、公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 2歳児の死亡例、接触者の陽性確認、迅速な予防措置（抗生物質投与、環境消毒、接触者追跡）が実施されている。未接種児童の死亡であり、公衆衛生面で重要。ただし国際的な拡大リスクは現時点で低い。

article.articleHeadline: 隔夜菜其實超毒？35歲孕婦染李斯特菌亡 專家列3招保命 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are yesterday's leftovers actually super toxic? A 35-year-old pregnant woman dies after contracting Listeria monocytogenes; experts list three life-saving tips.
article.articleSummary: In Henan Province, mainland China, a 35-year-old pregnant woman died two days after turning 35 from Listeria monocytogenes infection after eating refrigerator leftovers. After three months of hospital treatment, she passed away. Listeria monocytogenes can grow at refrigeration temperatures, making cold storage insufficient protection; it can be found in opened sauces, inadequately sealed ready-to-eat foods, and even cut fruit stored in the fridge. While healthy adults often experience mild symptoms, pregnant women and the elderly face serious risk because the bacterium can cross the placenta, causing miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth; neonatal mortality approaches 30%. The incubation can be up to two months, and early symptoms resemble a cold, delaying diagnosis. The article lists three preventive principles to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 隔夜菜其實超毒？35歲孕婦染李斯特菌亡 專家列3招保命
triage.triage_reason: リステリア感染による妊婦死亡例の報告であり、重症度は高いが、単一症例の記事報告であり、国内流行を示唆する情報がない。社会的関心がある食品安全関連の個別事例として経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一の妊婦死亡症例の報告であり、集団発生や地域的流行の証拠がない。記事は食品安全啓発を目的とした個別ケースの紹介と予防措置の説明が主である。リステリア症は妊婦において重症化リスクが高いため、臨床的には重要だが、流行病学的シグナルとしてはWATCH段階が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 吃冰箱剩菜！35歲孕婦「3個月後逝世」　食農專家警告：小心1細菌 | ETtoday生活新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eating leftovers from the fridge! A 35-year-old pregnant woman died three months later; a food and agriculture expert warns: beware of one bacterium | ETtoday Life News | ETtoday News Cloud
article.articleSummary: In Henan, China, a 35-year-old pregnant woman infected with Listeria monocytogenes died three months after hospital admission. Food and agriculture expert Wei En warns that Listeria can continue to grow in refrigerated foods, earning it the nickname 'fridge killer.' Unlike most bacteria, Listeria can multiply at fridge temperatures and contaminate not only raw meat and seafood but also opened sauces, unsealed prepared foods, and cut fruits stored in the refrigerator. For healthy adults, infection often causes mild diarrhea and fever, but in pregnancy and the elderly it can cross the placenta, causing miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth; newborn mortality can approach 30%, with incubation up to two months and early symptoms resembling a cold, delaying diagnosis and treatment. Prevention: thoroughly reheat leftovers; refrigerate cooked foods no more than 3 days; finish cut fruits within 24 hours; seal raw meats/seafood; clean and sanitize the fridge at least monthly.

triage.headline_ja: 冷蔵庫の残り物を食べた！35歳の妊婦が3ヶ月後に死亡　食農専門家が警告：ある細菌に注意
triage.triage_reason: Listeria monocytogenes感染による妊婦死亡という重篤な個別事例が報告されており、異常性と重症度が高い。特に妊娠中の感染に対する警告情報が含まれ、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 河南省での妊婦死亡事例は個別症例報告だが、Listeria monocytogenes感染の危険性（特に妊娠中および高齢者）、冷蔵庫での増殖能、潜伏期2ヶ月という特性が強調されている。食品安全に関する公衆衛生情報として相応の関心が見込まれる。ただし、集団発生や急速な国際的拡大のリスクは現在の情報からは明確でない。

article.articleHeadline: Cháu tử vong do não mô cầu, chú ruột 40 tuổi cũng nhiễm bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Grandchild dies from meningococcal disease; 40-year-old uncle also infected.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 April 2026, two meningococcal disease cases in the same family were reported in Đắk Lắk Province, Vietnam. A 2-year-old child, N.D.T.Ê, from Quảng Phú Commune (temporary resident of Tân An Ward), developed symptoms on 23–25 April and died on 26 April at Central Highlands General Hospital, diagnosed with septicemia due to Neisseria meningitidis, severe pneumonia, and suspected meningitis; the child had not been vaccinated. A 40-year-old uncle, N.Đ.Q from Tân An Ward, tested positive for meningococcus and is confined to the Infectious Diseases Department at the same hospital. Authorities conducted contact tracing, collected specimens from close contacts, provided prophylactic antibiotics, and disinfected the living area. Meningococcal disease spreads via respiratory droplets; vaccination and prompt medical care are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎で孫が死亡、40歳の叔父も感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」（小児死亡例）および「重症度」（致死例＋入院例）が該当。WPRO基準でも「異常性」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ベトナムのĐắk Lắk省での髄膜炎菌感染症の家族集積例（小児死亡例含む）。迅速な当局対応（接触者追跡、予防抗生物質投与、消毒）が実施されている。ワクチン未接種の小児死亡という深刻な転帰を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Một bệnh nhi 2 tuổi ở Đắk Lắk tử vong do mắc viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 2-year-old child in Dak Lak died from meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: On 27 April 2026, Dak Lak Province’s Center for Disease Control reported two meningococcal meningitis cases in Dak Lak, Vietnam, including one death. The deceased is 2-year-old N.D.T.Ê., from Quảng Phú Commune and living in Tân An Ward. He developed nasal discharge on 23 April, then fever, vomiting and lethargy on 25 April, and died on 26 April at 09:45. He had not received meningococcal vaccination. Laboratory testing at the Tây Nguyên Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology confirmed meningococcal infection in both the child and his uncle, N.Đ.Q., born 1985. The uncle developed cough and fatigue on 27 April and was admitted to the Infectious Diseases Ward in Buon Ma Thuot. Health authorities conducted contact tracing in Cư M’gar and Buôn Ma Thuột, provided antibiotic prophylaxis to close contacts, and performed environmental disinfection with Chloramine B 0.5% and issued public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ダックラック省の2歳児が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による小児死亡事例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外性、人-人感染の可能性があり、IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準も複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にダックラック省（Dak Lak）での発生が述べられており、2例（死亡1例、叔父1例）の髄膜炎菌感染が検査で確認されている。接触者追跡と予防的抗生物質投与など適切な対応が実施されているが、未接種の小児死亡という重大性、及び叔父への二次感染の可能性が認識されるため、フルRRA対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Walikale : recrudescence du paludisme dans la zone de santé de Kibua, les autorités sanitaires tirent la sonnette d'alarme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Walikale: resurgence of malaria in the Kibua health zone, health authorities sound the alarm.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 April 2026, malaria is resurging in Kibua health zone, Walikale territory, North Kivu, and remains the leading cause of consultations in several health facilities. The zone medical chief Dr. Yves Tsongo says the situation has not improved despite health teams and community relays' efforts, with awareness campaigns achieving limited impact. Contributing factors include widespread mosquito proliferation in Kibua and risky use of insecticide-treated nets for non-protective purposes, such as building, poultry, or crop protection. A major challenge is shortages of essential antimalarial medicines across several health areas. Dr. Tsongo urges simple, effective protective actions: sleep under a treated net every night, reduce standing water, and seek care at the first fever. Nets must not be repurposed; collective responsibility is needed to prevent a durable malaria crisis in this underserved zone.

triage.headline_ja: ワリカレ：キブア保健地域におけるマラリアの再燃、保健当局がアラームを鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの再燃は公衆衛生関心事だが、IHR基準を満たすには国際拡大リスクや深刻な死亡情報が不明。DRCの内部状況であり、スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが社会的・政治的関心の詳細が不明なため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事はキブア保健地域（ワリカレ地区、北キブ州、DRC）におけるマラリアの再燃を報告。医薬品不足、蚊の大量発生、不適切な網の使用など複数の課題が存在。死亡数や入院数などの重症度データは記事に記載されておらず不明。DRC内の限定的な地理的範囲であり国際拡大のリスクは現時点で低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค เตือนคนไทยระวัง 'วัณโรค'ยังระบาดหนัก ยันไม่ติดต่อผ่านการกิน-ดื่มน้ำร่วมกัน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control warns Thais to beware: Tuberculosis remains widespread, insisting it is not transmitted through sharing meals or drinks.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Disease Control warns that tuberculosis remains a major public health issue. WHO projections for 2025–2026 estimate about 104,000 new TB cases and 11,300 deaths annually in the country, with roughly 25% of Thais harboring latent TB infection; risks are higher among the elderly, those with diabetes or kidney disease, HIV, or other immunocompromised conditions. TB spreads via airborne droplets from coughing, sneezing, or loud talking; it is not transmitted through sharing meals or drinks or by touch, and extrapulmonary TB generally does not spread through ingestion. Early diagnosis and strict adherence to a 6–9 month treatment can cure TB and reduce transmission. The Department is intensifying screening—especially for household/close contacts, people with HIV, overcrowded communities, prisoners, and migrant workers—using chest X-ray with AI and molecular diagnostics plus drug-resistance testing, aiming to end TB by 2035 (2578 BE). Public health measures include eating hot meals, using serving spoons, handwashing, personal cups, masks when coughing, avoiding crowds, and annual health checks.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省が警告：結核が依然として広く蔓延、食事や飲み物の共有での感染はないと確認
triage.triage_reason: 結核はタイで継続的な公衆衛生課題であり、年間104,000件の新規症例と11,300人の死亡が予測されているため重症度基準に該当するが、記事は警告・啓発性が主であり、新たな流行勃発やアウトブレイクではない。情報不足の点もあり、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病である結核についての啓発・スクリーニング強化の警告であり、新たなアウトブレイク報告ではない。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（重症度）。WPRO基準は3つ該当するが、政府による継続的対応と啓発活動という文脈であり、急速な状況悪化の兆候はない。フルRRA実施の優先度は低い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 美國阿肯色州爆高致病性H5N1　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arkansas, USA reports outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 outbreak reported in Clay County, Arkansas, United States, following a World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) notification. To protect public health, Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety under the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department immediately instructed the industry to suspend imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from the affected area. Hong Kong authorities are in contact with U.S. authorities and will monitor developments via the OIE and related channels to determine further actions as the situation evolves. The measures come as a precautionary response to the Arkansas outbreak. Hong Kong imported about 54,830 tonnes of frozen/refrigerated poultry meat and around 4.33 million eggs from the United States in the previous year.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ・アーカンソー州で高病原性H5N1鳥インフルエンザが発生　香港は家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1は国際的に懸念される病原体であり、香港が輸入停止措置を取るなど社会的関心がある。ただし、記事の主たる発生地はアメリカ・アーカンソー州であり、対象国（GeoNames）リストに含まれないため、WPRO地域の直接的な感染症脅威としては評価が限定的である。情報が不足しており、続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生の主たる場所はアメリカ・アーカンソー州であるが、記事ではアメリカは対象国リストに含まれていない。香港（中国）が輸入停止措置により対象地域として含まれる。H5N1は高い国際的関心を持つ病原体だが、本記事では人への感染報告はなく、動物・環境カテゴリのみ。香港の対応は貿易制限的措置として該当するため、IHR基準を満たすが、中国地域での実際の感染イベントの詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: West Nile Fever Reported in Kerala: Mosquito-Borne Virus Raises Alert
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever reported in Kerala, India, prompting a public health alert as authorities monitor a mosquito-borne outbreak. The report notes that many infections may go unrecognised. When symptoms appear, they can progress to severe neurological disease; the infection can cause encephalitis or meningitis in rare cases. Severe infection signs include high fever with stiff neck and confusion or disorientation, and affected individuals may experience tremors or seizures, requiring urgent medical care and posing life-threatening risks. The article provides no case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or information on the source beyond labeling the virus mosquito-borne, nor on imported/exported cases or an ongoing outbreak timeline. Published 2026-04-27, the piece alerts clinicians and the public to watch for neurologic symptoms in Kerala residents and visitors.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でウェストナイル熱を報告：蚊媒介ウイルスが警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、神経合併症による深刻性）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）。対象国インドでの蚊媒介ウイルスアウトブレイクの警戒段階報告のため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケーラ州での報告が明記されており、インドでの蚊媒介ウイルス（ウェストナイル熱および原因不明脳炎）のアウトブレイク警戒状況。詳細な症例数、検査確認情報、発生系統（輸入/地域伝播）、アウトブレイク期間等の情報が不足しており、現段階では初期警戒報告と判断される。神経合併症（脳炎、髄膜炎、痙攣）による重症化リスク、および蚊媒介による流行可能性が懸念要因。続報による詳細情報収集が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Novartis secures pair of regulatory wins for skin disease and malaria treatments
article.articleSummary: European Commission approves Novartis' Rhapsido (remibrutinib) for adults with chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) unresponsive to H1-antihistamines, marking the first oral CSU therapy in Europe. Rhapsido is a twice-daily BTK inhibitor that blocks histamine-release pathways; Phase III REMIX-1 and REMIX-2 across 926 CSU patients showed significant itch and hive improvement, with a safety profile not requiring routine lab monitoring. Common adverse events: nasal congestion, sore throat, and runny nose. FDA approved the same indication in September 2025; GlobalData forecasts CSU sales at $2.6 billion by 2032, challenging Dupixent and Xolair. Separately, WHO prequalified Coartem Baby (artemether-lumefantrine) for newborns and infants 2–5 kg, enabling broader public-sector procurement; developed with MMV as Riamet Baby. Novartis will supply primarily on a not-for-profit basis in malaria regions, including Ghana; Excellergy acquisition announced last month.

triage.headline_ja: ノバルティスが皮膚疾患とマラリア治療薬で規制当局から承認を獲得
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医薬品の規制承認ニュースであり、進行中の感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上の危機を報告するものではない。マラリアは背景情報として言及されているが、新規感染症イベント、異常な発生、急速な拡大、重症化傾向などの具体的なシグナル要素を含まない。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はノバルティスのCoartem Baby（アルテメータ-ルメファントリン）の新生児・乳幼児向け剤形に対するWHOプレクオリフィケーション取得であり、医薬品開発・承認に関する企業ニュースである。マラリア地域（ガーナ含む）での供給計画が言及されているが、これは既存のマラリア対策の強化に関する事項であって、新規感染症シグナルではない。感染症危機管理の観点でのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 5.991 Warga Kudus Terduga TBC, DKK Sebut Kebiasaan Merokok Jadi Pemicu - Suara Merdeka Muria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5,991 Kudus residents suspected of TB, the Kudus Health Office says smoking habit is a trigger - Suara Merdeka Muria
article.articleSummary: 5,991 residents of Kudus, Central Java, Indonesia, were identified as tuberculosis (TB) suspects through free health screening in March 2026, according to the Kudus Health Office. The figure exceeds the target detections of 4,281 TB suspects. Officials note that TB can affect all ages, including youths, and point to smoking as a trigger alongside lifestyle and daily activities. As part of the national push toward TB elimination by 2030, Kudus is expanding screening with a mobile chest X-ray unit and MTUC-assisted diagnostics in collaboration with RSUD Kudus. The Health Office will also screen pesantren (boarding schools) in Kudus, citing more than 200 institutions; next month the program targets these schools to enable early TB detection among young people.

triage.headline_ja: クドゥス住民5,991人が結核の疑いで発見、クドゥス保健局は喫煙習慣がトリガーだと指摘 - スアラ・メルデカ・ムリア
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・クドゥス地域での結核疑い患者5,991人の発見は地域的には重要だが、既知の感染症の標準的なスクリーニング結果であり、国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠や急速な感染拡大の兆候がない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病で、記事は地域保健局によるスクリーニング活動の報告。2030年までの結核排除に向けた国家戦略の一環として組織的に実施されている通常の公衆衛生活動。死亡・重症化の具体的報告がなく、国際的拡大リスクの証拠もない。ただし感染継続の可能性と人口への広範な影響があり、対応の詳細が不明なため、今後の感染者数や重症度の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Surtos de dengue e gripe aumentam busca por atendimento em casa | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and Flu Outbreaks Increase Demand for Home-Based Care | G1
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-27, dengue and Influenza A activity in São Luís, Maranhão, Brazil is driving higher demand for home-based care. With dengue and flu cases rising, health facilities in São Luís are crowded, raising exposure risk during transport to hospitals. Pre-hospital care provides in-home medical evaluation and guidance, reducing travel and crowd exposure, and may resolve cases at home or direct patients to a health unit. Hospitals report overcrowding from mild-to-moderate cases, disproportionately affecting children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. VitalMed operates in the São Luís metropolitan area, deploying teams and ambulances for urgent/emergency and non-admission cases. Experts underscore avoiding unnecessary exposures and seeking timely, appropriate care. Medical professional cited: Dr. Monise Maria de Moura Simeao (CRM 13990-MA).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とインフルエンザの流行が在宅医療サービスの需要を増加させている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱とインフルエンザA同時流行の報告だが、現在の情報は地域的な医療サービス利用の変化に焦点を当てており、国際的拡大リスクや重篤度、死亡などの詳細が不明。追加情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマラニャン州サンルイスにおけるデング熱とインフルエンザA同時流行を報告。医療施設の過密化と在宅医療需要の増加が主題。重症度、死亡数、地域外への拡大リスクなどの詳細は記載されていない。WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」には該当するが、IHR基準の該当がないため、現段階ではWATCH判定。続報で死亡数、重症度、流行規模の拡大などの情報が得られればPICKUP検討となる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : lancement d'une vaste campagne de vaccination contre la rougeole et la polio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Launch of a Large Vaccination Campaign Against Measles and Polio
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo launched a nationwide vaccination campaign against measles–rubella and poliomyelitis under the Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI), targeting 23 million children aged 6 months to 14 years in 11 central and western provinces, while polio vaccination is rolled out nationwide for children 0–5 years with the aim of eradication. A fixed-site strategy is used in schools and health centers, including deployment in Mbandaka to reach more children quickly. The campaign emphasizes collaboration with parents and school communities to boost participation. This effort follows a concerning health context: in 2025, measles caused more than 82,000 suspected cases and about 1,200 deaths, with eastern regions affected by conflict with M23 rebels and displaced populations living in poor hygiene. Outcomes depend on logistics, uptake, and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：麻疹とポリオに対する大規模予防接種キャンペーンの開始
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹とポリオの2つの重大な感染症における予防接種キャンペーンの報道だが、記事の主体は既に発生している疾患への対応措置（予防接種）であり、新規の疾患クラスター発生やアウトブレイクの警報ではない。ただし、背景に2025年の麻疹による1,200人以上の死亡と82,000件以上の疑い例があり、公衆衛生上の重要性は高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける麻疹とポリオの予防接種キャンペーン開始を報道している。背景として2025年の麻疹による1,200人以上の死亡と82,000件以上の疑い例がある。これは既存の流行への対応であり、新規のシグナル検出ではないため、WATCH判定とした。引き続き麻疹の死亡数、ポリオの症例報告、キャンペーンの進展状況を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk: Phát hiện 2 trường hợp mắc viêm não mô cầu, triển khai gấp công tác truy vết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak: Two cases of meningococcal meningitis detected; rapid contact tracing efforts underway.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases detected in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, as of 27 April 2026, with one death and one additional case under isolation. The fatal index case is a 2-year-old child from Quảng Phú Commune who developed symptoms on 23–25 April and died on 26 April; diagnosis included septicemia and meningococcal meningitis, and the child had not been vaccinated. The second case, reported on 27 April, is the uncle of the patient, N.Đ.Q, from Tan An ward, who presented with cough and fatigue, was admitted to the Infectious Diseases Ward at Tay Nguyen Regional General Hospital, and tested positive for meningococcal meningitis. The patient exhibited widespread purpura and is in isolation. Local health authorities (Dak Lak CDC, Cau M’Gar District Health Center, Buôn Ma Thuột General Hospital, and local health stations) conducted contact tracing, collected samples, provided prophylactic antibiotics to close contacts, and performed environmental disinfection with Chloramin B 0.5%. Public risk communication efforts are ongoing. Meningococcal meningitis, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, spreads via respiratory droplets; vaccination is recommended, especially for children, along with prompt medical care and hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の2症例を検出、迅速な接触者追跡対応を展開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：小児死亡例、異常性：予期しない集団発生、国際的拡大リスク）。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は急速進行性かつ致死的で、接触者追跡体制が構築されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は空気感染性疾患で急速に進行し致命率が高い（本例でも2歳児が死亡）。未接種者における易感染性の存在、呼吸器飛沫による伝播リスク、地域社会での急速拡大の可能性が懸念される。ベトナム当局は接触者追跡・予防投与・環境消毒を実施しており、リスク認識と対応体制が存在している。

article.articleHeadline: Anopheles maculatus s.l as potential malaria vectors with opportunistic feeding in Meghalaya, Northeast India - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum infections were detected in Anopheles maculatus s.s. and An. pseudowillmori in Meghalaya’s Khasi Hills and Garo Hills (NE India). The study, covering 2019–2023 (except 2021), analyzed 215 resting adults: 177 An. maculatus s.s.; 33 An. pseudowillmori; 5 An. willmori. Parasite detection showed P. falciparum in 49/177 An. maculatus s.s. (27.68%) and 16/33 An. pseudowillmori (48.48%), confirming natural infections and supporting vector potential for malaria transmission by Maculatus Group species in Meghalaya. Genetic differentiation was observed between An. maculatus s.s. populations from Khasi Hills Region (KHR) and Garo Hills Region (GHR), reinforced by haplotype network analysis. Blood-meal data from cattle sheds indicated: humans 15%, cattle 16%, and both 17%, revealing opportunistic and flexible feeding. The findings underscore the epidemiological importance of Maculatus Group members and the need for targeted vector control in northeast India.

triage.headline_ja: メガラヤ州、インド北東部における機会的吸血をする潜在的マラリアベクターとしてのAnopheles maculatus s.l - Scientific Reports
triage.triage_reason: マラリア原虫感染蚊の検出は重要な公衆衛生知見だが、本記事は科学論文で既知地域の研究報告であり、新規流行・大規模アウトブレイク警告ではない。ただし蚊のベクター能力確認は地域感染症対策に関連するため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019-2023年のベクター調査研究論文（Nature Scientific Reports）であり、新規アウトブレイク警告ではない。Meghalayanおよび具体的地域（Khasi Hills、Garo Hills）での蚊のベクター能力が確認されているため、地域のマラリア伝播リスク管理上の知見として重要。ただしWHO通知基準に該当するシグナルではなく、続報（実際の患者増加など）を注視する段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana's uphill battle to defeat Malaria
article.articleSummary: Ghana speeds up access to newly approved malaria vaccines for children in Accra as USAID funding winds down, threatening the country's malaria control gains. The rollout builds on years of trials showing protection in young children, but experts warn that the winding down of donor support could slow vaccine deployment, strain health systems, and erode surveillance, cold-chain logistics, and community outreach. In Ghana, malaria remains a leading cause of child illness and death, and the national Malaria Elimination Programme, led by Dr. Nana Yaw Peprah, emphasizes the need for sustained investment to translate trial progress into real-world impact. DW interviews in Accra with Adwoa Tenkoramaa Domena and DW's Eric Mawuena Egbeta highlight risks of gaps in prevention, care, and monitoring if funding does not replace USAID's support. The road ahead for Ghana's malaria fight is pivotal and uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのマラリア撲滅への険しい道のり
triage.triage_reason: ガーナでのマラリア対策（ワクチン展開）に関する報道であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の異常性・重症度が該当するが、記事は具体的な新規感染者数・死亡者数・流行の急増などの客観的なエビデンスを欠いており、むしろ政策課題・資金調達の不確実性が主題であるため、感染症イベントのシグナルというより政治的・衛生政策の議論である。情報の具体化を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナでの既知のマラリア問題とワクチン展開の進展について述べており、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。むしろUSAID資金引き上げによる予防・監視体制への脅威が主題であり、具体的な感染者急増やアウトブレイク指標が記載されていない。シグナルとしてのフルRRA開始判定には至らない段階であるが、ガーナの重要な公衆衛生課題であり続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Ambiental realiza ação contra a dengue e leptospirose nos mercados públicos de João Pessoa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Environmental Surveillance carries out an action against dengue and leptospirosis at João Pessoa's public markets.
article.articleSummary: João Pessoa’s Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS-JP), via the Environmental Surveillance Management (GVAM), launches a preventive/educational campaign against dengue and leptospirosis at three public markets. From 28 April 2026, Mercado Central will be visited by GVAM and disease-control agents; 29 April at Mercado de Oitizeiro; and 30 April at Mercado de Cruz das Armas. The effort relies on dialogue, awareness, and distribution of informational leaflets, with about 10 health-education staff supported by endemic-control agents. Aims are to inform residents, tourists, and market visitors about prevention, including proper waste disposal to reduce disease risk, since improper disposal can promote synanthropic animals and pests. Dengue is a viral febrile illness transmitted by Aedes aegypti, presenting 3–7 days of fever and body pains; leptospirosis is a bacterial infection from water/soil contaminated with rat urine, causing fever and aches; early diagnosis and antibiotics are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ジョアン・ペッソアの公共市場でデング熱とレプトスピラ症に対する対策を実施 - 環境監視局
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの単一都市における公衆衛生キャンペーン（啓発・教育活動）を報道するもので、新たな患者集団発生や異常な流行を報じるものではない。既知の風土病に対する予防的取り組みであり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、国際的な感染症危機ではない。
triage.notes: 本イベント情報はブラジルで発生していますが、対象国リストに含まれていません（WPRO対象地域外）。また記事内容は新規流行や異常事象を報じるものではなく、既知の風土病に対する自治体による定例的な予防キャンペーンの実施報告です。シグナルトリアージの対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: Pontang-panting Melawan Wabah Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Frantically Fighting the Measles Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks sweep across multiple Indonesian regions, blamed on gaps in universal vaccination. A 9‑month‑old infant in Jakarta contracted measles during Lebaran. Initial fever and irritability escalated after the return trip: fever up to 40°C, cough, runny nose, vomiting, and diarrhea, with a rash developing later. The child had not yet received the measles vaccine due to age; vaccination typically begins at nine months. Laboratory confirmation occurred at a puskesmas, after which the infant was isolated for two weeks and told to avoid contact with other children to curb transmission as the rash appears. The family suspects the source was a recently recovered nephew who hugged the baby three days after recovery. The report highlights delays in the care pathway: hours-long waits for blood tests, chest X-rays, and an isolation bed after referral from a puskesmas to a hospital. The piece notes measles waves affecting Jakarta and other areas.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の蔓延に必死で対抗
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの複数地域での麻疹アウトブレイク。予防接種の隙間が原因とされ、乳幼児の重症例（高熱40°C、咳、嘔吐、下痢、発疹）が報告されており、複数地域への拡大が既に進行中。IHR基準の異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は複数地域での麻疹波及を明示（ジャカルタ他）。ワクチン接種率の低下（9ヶ月未満児が接種対象外）が根本原因として指摘され、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高い。医療システムの遅延問題も報告。東南アジア地域への拡大リスク要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: Family Of 4 Died Of Suspected Food Poisoning After Consuming Watermelon
article.articleSummary: Mumbai reports four deaths in a single family—Abdullah (40), Nasrin (35), and daughters Zainab (13) and Ayesha (16)—in a suspected food-poisoning incident after consuming watermelon. Police say those who ate only chicken pulao did not fall ill, implicating watermelon as the probable source. Post-mortems have been conducted; the exact cause will be confirmed after histopathological analysis. Food samples, including the watermelon, have been seized for laboratory examination as part of the ongoing probe. Zainab died around 10:15 am during treatment, and Abdullah succumbed around 10:30 pm the same day. The investigation continues, with lab results and histopathology reports pending to identify the toxic or infectious agent and confirm the infection source. No additional symptoms or broader outbreak context are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ：スイカを摂取した家族4人が食中毒の疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑いによる家族4人の死亡は重症度・異常性基準を満たすが、現時点では単一家族事例で流行状況や病因確認が未了であり、フルRRA前に情報集約が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当しWPRO基準も2つ満たすが、PICKUP判定に至らない理由：(1)単一家族事例で地域的広がりの証拠がない、(2)病因が未確定（食中毒疑い段階）、(3)追加的な流行兆候なし。ただし死亡4例は顕著であり、病因確認・追加事例の有無について続報を優先度中で注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: قمة الصحة العالمية 2026 فى نيروبى تستعرض عبء الأمراض المزمنة والمعدية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Health Summit 2026 in Nairobi highlights the burden of chronic and infectious diseases - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Over 1,000 delegates from 50 countries attended 80 sessions at the Global Health Summit 2026 regional meeting in Nairobi, Kenya (27–29 April 2026), co-hosted by WHO, Aga Khan University, and Kenya’s Ministry of Health, with Africa CDC participation. Focused on strengthening health systems resilience, universal health coverage, and accelerating pragmatic solutions, the African region’s burden of chronic diseases and changing infectious disease patterns were highlighted alongside health financing gaps. Dr. Mohamed Jenabi, WHO Africa Regional Director, delivered the keynote across six high-level sessions; opening was attended by Kenyan President William Ruto. Egypt’s Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar joined the Egyptian delegation. A regional plan aligned with the 2026–2030 Strategic Plan and Vision 2035 addressed health security, digital health sovereignty, and funding. The expo featured polio vaccination VR and an AI emergency-response tool, with roughly 90 WHO staff supporting 22 sessions and four Qatar-based offices in Kenya, Ethiopia, Eritrea, and Ghana.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ナイロビ世界保健サミット、慢性疾患と感染症の負担を強調 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: 記事はポリオワクチンの展示を含む国際保健サミットの開催について述べたものであり、実際のポリオ患者の発生や流行事象ではなく、会議・イベントレポートに過ぎない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月27-29日のナイロビでの世界保健サミットに関するイベントレポートです。疾患名に『Poliomyelitis』が含まれていますが、これはワクチン啓発の展示参考としての言及であり、実際のポリオ流行事象ではありません。対象国ではケニア（対象国リストに含まれない）での開催ですが、記事サマリーで実際の感染症イベント発生は述べられていないため、verified_locationsではGhanaのみを記載（4カ国事務所の設置言及）。本件はシグナルとして識別せず。

article.articleHeadline: Cachoeiro divulga cronograma do fumacê contra dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cachoeiro Announces Dengue Fogging Schedule
article.articleSummary: Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, Brazil, announces a dengue-control fogging program (fumacê) using insecticide from April 27–30, 2026. The city will spray in targeted neighborhoods on a morning/evening schedule: Monday 27 – Vila Rica in the morning; night coverage in Ferroviários and Ibitiquara. Tuesday 28 – Aquidaban in the morning; night coverage in Novo Parque. Wednesday 29 – Jardim Itapemirim in the morning; night coverage in Coramara. Thursday 30 – Caiçara and Agostinho Simonato in the morning; night coverage in Gilson Carone. During the vehicle’s pass, residents should keep doors and windows open. They should also eliminate standing water and other potential mosquito breeding sites to reduce dengue transmission in these areas.

triage.headline_ja: カショエイロがデング熱対策の燻蒸スケジュールを発表
triage.triage_reason: 公式な媒介蚊対策事業の発表であり、新規感染症発生や異常なクラスタの報告ではない。既知の風土病に対する定例的な予防措置の告知に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の新規発生やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知のデング熱対策としての市当局による定期的な媒介蚊駆除事業（燻蒸）のスケジュール公表である。ブラジルはデング熱風土病地域であり、このような対策は通常の公衆衛生活動の一環。シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Bé 2 tuổi tử vong do viêm não mô cầu, Đắk Lắk triển khai gấp công tác truy vết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two-year-old child dies of meningococcal meningitis; Dak Lak accelerates contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old male in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, died from meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis); his 41-year-old uncle, a close contact, also tested positive. On 23 April the child had a runny nose; by 25 April he developed high fever, vomiting, and lethargy and was admitted to Thien Han General Hospital, then transferred to Tây Nguyên Regional General Hospital. He died on 26 April from fulminant septicemia due to meningococcal meningitis with pneumonia; the child reportedly had not attended daycare and had not been vaccinated against meningococcal disease. Dak Lak CDC confirmed both cases and initiated rapid contact tracing, testing, and prophylaxis for close contacts. The response, coordinated with Cu M’Gar District Health Center, Buôn Ma Thuột Health Center, and local wards, includes antibiotic prophylaxis for contacts, environmental disinfection with Chloramine B 0.5%, and targeted public messaging. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; vaccination and hygiene are advised to prevent spread. The situation is being actively monitored as an outbreak in the area.

triage.headline_ja: 2歳児がジフテリア髄膜炎で死亡、ダクラク州が濃厚接触者追跡を加速
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎による小児死亡例と家族への感染確認、予防接種なしという基本条件が揃い、当局が能動的な疫学調査と予防対策を展開中。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目該当。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎は敏感な病原体であり、小児死亡・家族感染・ワクチン未接種の組み合わせは重大なシグナル。Dak Lak州当局による能動的な検査追跡体制の確立と予防薬投与は管理可能性があることを示唆するが、同時にアウトブレイク扱いの記述から継続的な警戒が必要。地域での追加例の発生可能性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Setelah 9 Tahun, Leptospirosis Kembali Muncul di Magetan, 1 Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After 9 years, leptospirosis reappears in Magetan, one dead.
article.articleSummary: Two leptospirosis cases were reported in Magetan Regency, East Java, Indonesia, over the last two months, with one death. The fatal patient arrived at a Ponorogo hospital in advanced disease, showing swollen legs and disseminated infection. The previous Magetan case occurred in 2017 (one case). A second case involves a worker who worked in Magetan but resides in Pacitan. Leptospirosis is transmitted from animals, especially rats, via urine and contact with contaminated water or soil, commonly in unhygienic environments or during floods, entering through open wounds. Health authorities are enhancing surveillance at health facilities and urging the public to improve environmental hygiene, wear protective boots in risk areas, and seek medical evaluation promptly if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 9年ぶりにマゲタンでレプトスピラ症が再出現、1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで報告されたレプトスピラ症の事例であり、WPRO基準では複数項目（異常性、重症度、管理性）で該当する可能性があるが、症例数が限定的（2例、1死亡）で国際的な拡大リスクが明確でないため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベント発生地はインドネシア（東ジャワ州マゲタン地区）であることが確認される。9年ぶりの再出現であり異常性あり。ただし、現在の症例数は限定的（2例）で、IHR基準での該当は1項目のみ。WPRO基準では複数項目で該当するが、感染症の特性上（動物からの接触感染）、ヒト-ヒト感染による大規模流行のリスクは低い。衛生指導と監視体制の強化により対応が進行中と考えられるため、WATCH判定が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh não mô cầu gia tăng, bác sĩ cảnh báo triệu chứng dễ nhầm với cảm cúm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease on the rise, doctors warn that its symptoms are easily mistaken for the flu.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis is rising in Vietnam, with 24 cases and 4 deaths reported in the first three months of 2026. Children under 15 account for about 46% of cases. Although no concentrated outbreak yet, cases occur scattered nationwide, with a southward concentration: by mid-April 2026, 18 cases in the southern region, Ho Chi Minh City census 10. Recent cases include three suspected meningitis patients in Ca Mau, including one death; a girl aged 11 in Phu Quoc died after presenting with fever, headache, rash, cyanosis, and breathing difficulty, later confirmed as meningococcal disease type B. Neisseria meningitidis can colonize healthy people in the nasopharynx and progress rapidly to meningitis or septicemia, often within 24-48 hours. Vaccination is the most effective prevention, along with hygiene measures, masking with respiratory symptoms, avoiding shared personal items, and prompt antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts within 24 hours. Surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌疾患が増加、医師は症状がインフルエンザと間違えやすいと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準5つすべて該当。重症度が高く（死亡4件、重篤例複数）、全国散発的に発生し、迅速な対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性疾患B型が確認され、2026年第1四半期で24例、死亡4件の報告あり。全国散発的発生で南部に集中（ホーチミン市10例）。小児（15歳未満）が46%を占める。記事は医療従事者の警告と予防対策を強調している。迅速な対応と監視継続が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Wakil Gubernur Lampung Sebut Temuan Kasus Tuberkulosis Masih Jauh dari Target
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lampung Deputy Governor Says Tuberculosis Case Findings Are Still Far From the Target
article.articleSummary: TB in Lampung Province, Indonesia, remains far from target detection. Deputy Governor Jihan Nurlela says current TB case finding lags behind estimates, with only about 11–14% of estimated cases detected by early 2026. To address this, Lampung provincial government is expanding active screening, including partnering with pulmonology professional organizations to deploy diagnostic tools at strategic points such as ports and airports, marking a shift from passive to proactive case finding. Health Department data show that in 2024 to 2025 detection rates held steady at about 65 percent of an estimated 31,000 cases; however, by end March 2026 only 3,498 cases were identified out of an estimated 30,745. Despite low detection, treatment quality is reportedly adequate, including for drug-resistant TB, with high cure rates once diagnosed and treated. The public is urged to recognize symptoms such as prolonged cough, weight loss, and night sweats, and seek facility-based screening to curb transmission in Bandar Lampung and wider Lampung.

triage.headline_ja: ランプン副知事、結核症例の発見がまだ目標に達していないと述べる
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、異常性は限定的だが、検出率が低迷（11-14%）し、ランプン州政府が能動的スクリーニング拡大への対応を開始していることから、地域的な公衆衛生上の関心事として経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、IHR基準の「異常性」には該当しない。ただし、ランプン州での検出率が極めて低く（推定3万例中3,498例のみ）、政府が能動的スクリーニング強化を開始している点は地域的な公衆衛生課題として注視すべき。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: India has made gains against malaria but vigilance is key, say experts
article.articleSummary: India has made gains against malaria but vigilance is key, experts say. At a symposium marking World Malaria Day, hosted by the Atal Incubation Centre-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (AIC-CCMB), scientists urged strengthened surveillance, sharper cross-border collaboration, and targeted interventions in high-burden tribal, forested, and remote regions to keep India on track to eliminate malaria by 2030. While malaria cases and deaths have declined in recent years, experts warned of persistent threats in vulnerable areas and noted recent spikes in cases in some regions. A coordinated, evidence-driven, and inclusive approach, alongside sustained political and financial commitment, was emphasized to sustain progress and prevent resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: インドはマラリアに対して進展を遂げているが、専門家は警戒が重要であると述べている
triage.triage_reason: インドのマラリア制御は全体的に進展しているが、一部地域での最近の症例増加と、2030年までの排除目標達成に向けた継続的な監視の必要性が指摘されている。情報がやや啓発的・専門家意見中心であり、具体的な流行の深刻さや異常性の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Dayのシンポジウムに基づく専門家意見中心で、具体的な流行の深刻度や異常なスパイクの詳細が明確でない。一部地域での症例増加が示唆されているが、全体としては制御進展を強調する内容。継続的な監視の推奨と脆弱地域での長期的曝露リスク、マラリアの流行しやすい性質から WPRO基準では2項目該当。

article.articleHeadline: Piura: inspeccionan 28,000 casas para evitar reproducción de zancudo transmisor del dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piura: 28,000 houses inspected to prevent breeding of dengue-transmitting mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: 28,000 residences in Piura, Peru, across the settlements Señor de los Milagros, Susana Higuchi, Javier Heraud, José María Arguedas and San Pedro, were inspected by brigades from the Regional Health Directorate (Diresa) of Piura to prevent breeding of the dengue-transmitting mosquito. The inspections aim to curb dengue transmission in the city by targeting mosquito breeding sites. The article provides no dengue case counts or outbreak details, instead focusing on preventive household inspections. No laboratory-confirmed cases, infection sources, or import/export of cases are mentioned. As of April 27, 2026, this public health effort highlights ongoing measures to mitigate dengue risk in Piura through vector-control activities at the household level.

triage.headline_ja: ピウラ：デング熱媒介蚊の繁殖を防ぐため28,000戸の家屋を検査
triage.triage_reason: デング熱媒介蚊の予防的な家屋検査活動に関する報道であり、実際の患者発生・患者数・アウトブレーク情報が記載されていない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: ペルー（対象国外）での予防的な蚊対策活動に関する記事。フィリピンはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーはペルーのピウラのみが主題であり、フィリピンに関する実際のデング熱イベントの言及がないため除外。患者数なし、アウトブレーク情報なし、国際的拡大の兆候なし。シグナルとしての価値なし。

article.articleHeadline: Malária: Brasil registra queda no número de casos e amplia rede de enfrentamento da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: Brazil records a drop in the number of cases and expands its malaria response network.
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded its lowest malaria cases since 1979 in 2025, with a 15% drop from 2024; Plasmodium falciparum infections fell 30%, and deaths declined 28%. Expanded access to rapid diagnostic tests, especially in remote regions, accompanied ongoing tafenoquine rollout for Plasmodium vivax malaria, implemented since March 2024; a March 2026 pediatric formulation started, prioritizing Indigenous populations. Brazil is the first country to offer tafenoquine in its public health system (SUS). Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes; there is no human-to-human transmission. Symptoms include fever, chills, sweating, headache, and body pains; severe disease can cause seizures, altered consciousness, hemorrhages, respiratory distress, and shock. Treatment is free via SUS; early diagnosis and prompt treatment curb transmission. Prevention includes nets, protective clothing, screens, repellents, indoor residual spraying, insecticide-treated nets, sanitation, and housing improvements.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア：ブラジルは症例数の減少を記録し、マラリア対応ネットワークを拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるマラリア症例数の減少を報告する記事であり、公衆衛生の改善を示すポジティブなニュースである。IHR基準では異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクに該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度の増加や管理困難性は認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル（3469034）は提供された対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。記事の主題は感染症の増加ではなく、症例数の減少と対応ネットワークの拡大という公衆衛生上の成功事例であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Vacina é principal proteção antes de viajar para países com surto de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination is the main protection before traveling to countries with measles outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Health Ministry issued travel vaccination guidance for Brazilians heading to the United States, Mexico, and Canada amid ongoing measles outbreaks in those destinations. Vaccination is stressed as the main protection to reduce infection risk and prevent reintroduction of measles into Brazil, which remains free from endemic transmission. In 2025 Canada reported 5,062 measles cases (871 in 2026 so far); Mexico 6,152 in 2025 and 9,207 in 2026; the United States 2,144 in 2025 and 1,738 in 2026; all three countries have active transmission. Travelers are urged to verify and update their vaccination status before departure, following the National Vaccination Schedule; measles vaccination is free via SUS nationwide. Brazil recorded two 2026 cases: a 22-year-old woman in Rio de Janeiro who was unvaccinated and a six-month-old girl in São Paulo with recent travel to La Paz, Bolivia, prompting rapid public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: 予防接種は麻疹の流行が発生している国々への渡航前の主な防護手段
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹輸入症例が確認され、北米での複数国での大規模流行（カナダ5,062件、メキシコ9,207件、米国1,738件）が背景にある。IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクに該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度と流行しやすさの基準を満たす。公衆衛生当局による公式な旅行ガイダンス発行により、政府関心も高い。
triage.notes: 北米（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）での大規模麻疹流行が背景にあるが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはブラジルのみを記載。ブラジルでの輸入症例2件（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ）が報告されており、ボリビア渡航歴のある症例もある。ブラジルは麻疹排除達成国だが、輸入ケースのため警視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura orienta servidores sobre Doença de Chagas - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall Advises Civil Servants on Chagas Disease - News Rondônia
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease education initiative by City Hall of Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, aimed at municipal health network staff to strengthen prevention and early diagnosis. Led by the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semusa), the session covered transmission risks, symptoms, and protective measures. Chagas is caused by Trypanosoma cruzi; early symptoms include fever, malaise, loss of appetite, and hepatomegaly/splenomegaly, potentially progressing to heart and digestive complications. The principal transmission is contact with feces of the triatomine bug (barbeiro); other routes include blood transfusion, organ transplantation, mother-to-child, and laboratory accidents. Officials highlighted ongoing investment in surveillance and health education to improve care. Preventive actions include avoiding unsafe foods, maintaining clean environments, sealing entryways, and deterring animals. If barbeiro is suspected, do not kill it; secure it and contact the Division of Zoonoses and Entomology Diagnostics (DPDZE) for identification and guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がシャーガス病について職員に指導―ポルト・ベーリョ市
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病に関する教育啓発イベントであり、新規患者発生や流行の報告ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は市役所がシャーガス病に関する教育セッションを実施したというもので、新規患者報告や疾病クラスターの発生を示すイベント情報ではない。ブラジルにおけるシャーガス病は既知の風土病であり、当該記事は予防啓発活動の通常業務である。シグナル検出対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Lâm Đồng chủ động ngăn virus lở mồm long móng SAT1 xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Dong Province proactively prevents SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease virus from entering.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong Province in Vietnam, as of 27 April 2026, has issued directives to prevent foot-and-mouth disease virus serotype SAT1 from entering. The action follows SAT1 risk from China, where April 2026 reports described 219 infected cattle in Gansu and Xinjiang. SAT1 is primarily African but has recently surfaced in parts of the Middle East and West Asia, raising risk via movement of livestock and animal products into Vietnam. Lam Dong orders surveillance of cattle, strict control of transport of animals and products, and rapid reporting of suspected cases. The Department of Agriculture and Rural Development will coordinate with local authorities to monitor herds, collect samples for laboratory confirmation, and implement quarantine and control measures. Border security forces—military, border guards, police—and market authorities will crack down on illegal animal trade and cross-border movement. Public awareness campaigns urged to deter illegal crossings and trafficking of animals and animal products through borders.

triage.headline_ja: ラムドン省がSAT1口蹄疫ウイルスの侵入を積極的に防止
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1がベトナムとの国境地域で報告され、国際的に拡大するリスクが高い。中国での219頭の感染確認に続き、ベトナムが予防的対応を実施している状況は公衆衛生への潜在的深刻影響と異常性を示す。
triage.notes: SAT1口蹄疫は動物疾病だが、家畜産業への経済的影響と国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが高い。中国での確定症例（甘粛・新疆の計219頭）とベトナムの先制的対応が報告されている。記事は両国での発生と予防対応を明確に述べており、両国を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 女大生遭流浪狗圍咬「全身20傷」慘患瘋狗病　同學單車撞狗神救援 | 國際 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Female college student mauled by stray dogs, 20 injuries all over her body, tragically contracts rabies; classmate on a bicycle crashes into a dog in a miraculous rescue | International | SETN.com
article.articleSummary: Stray dog attack in Henan, China: a female student at Pingdingshan College in Pingdingshan, Henan, was mauled by several stray dogs on the night of April 19, around 10 pm, while returning to her dorm. The dog pack inflicted more than 20 wounds, with over 10 bites on her legs and injuries to her buttocks. A nearby male student on an electric bicycle intervened, colliding with the dogs to rescue her; another female student helped bring her back to the dorm. Medical assessment classified the exposure as rabies exposure level III, requiring rabies vaccination, rabies immunoglobulin, and tetanus vaccination; treatment to be covered by the school insurance. The report underscores stray dog risks in urban areas of Henan; no additional details on laboratory confirmation or onward cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 女子大学生が野良犬に襲われ「全身20傷」狂犬病を患う悲劇 同級生の自転車が犬に衝突し奇跡的に救助
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人被害事例であり、狂犬病の集団発生や異常流行の兆候がない。暴露レベルIII判定のため適切な予防処置が実施されており、管理可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 本件は河南省平頂山市での単一の野良犬咬傷事例（被害者1名）である。狂犬病曝露レベルIIIと判定されているが、適切な予防接種（狂犬病ワクチン・免疫グロブリン・破傷風ワクチン）が実施予定であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性はない。集団発生の証拠なし。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: SC tem mais de 2,5 mil casos de doenças respiratórias em 2026 e redobra atenção com influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina has more than 2,500 cases of respiratory diseases in 2026 and steps up attention to influenza.
article.articleSummary: Santa Catarina, Brazil, reports 2,596 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases through epidemiological week 16 of 2026, part of over 2,500 cases in the first four months. This year’s total shows a 15.2% decline from the same period in 2025; 138 SRAG deaths, down from 154. Florianópolis leads with 350 cases, followed by Criciúma (281), Joinville (164), São José (152), and Balneário Camboriú (126). Of the 2,596 SRAG cases, influenza caused 368, with 607 total hospitalizations and 76 ICU admissions; 24 influenza deaths. Rhinovirus accounted for 509 SRAG cases (19.61%), with 122 ICU admissions and 13 deaths; incidence 6.69%. InfoGripe notes SC diverges from other Southern states by rising influenza-associated SRAG. Public health advisories emphasize hand hygiene, avoiding contact with infected individuals, and measures to reduce transmission of influenza and SARS-CoV-2.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州は2026年に2,500件以上の呼吸器疾患症例を報告し、インフルエンザへの注視を強化
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ関連のSRAG症例の報告であり、地域的な増加傾向が認められるものの、前年同期比で15.2%の減少が見られており、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生影響は現在のところ明確ではない。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事は地域的なSRAG症例（呼吸器関連症候群）を報告しており、インフルエンザが主要な病原体となっている。前年比での減少傾向が見られるため、深刻な公衆衛生危機とは評価されない。ただしInfoGripeの指摘通り、南部州との異なる流行パターンが見られるため、今後の動向注視が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak confirmed in Bhagalpur poultry farm, containment steps begin | Patna News
article.articleSummary: As of 27 April 2026, avian influenza H5N1 has been confirmed in poultry at a regional farm in the Barari locality of Bhagalpur city, Bihar. Serum tests by the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal, confirmed H5N1 after about 3,000 chickens died in phases since the first week of April. The farm is treated as the outbreak epicentre. Containment includes culling remaining birds and destruction of eggs, with a rapid response team in PPE conducting on-site measures and intensive sanitisation. Authorities are considering closure of nearby poultry farms and culling within a 1 km radius. Confirmatory testing involved NIHSAD as well as the Regional Disease Diagnostic Laboratory in Kolkata and the Institute of Animal Health and Production in Patna. No human cases are reported; residents are urged to report sudden bird deaths or symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: バガルプール養鶏場で鳥インフルエンザ感染が確認、封じ込め対策開始 | パトナニュース
triage.triage_reason: インドでH5N1の養鶏場での確認は異常・予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準に該当するが、現時点で人での感染報告がなく、動物限定の発生のため、情報が確定するまで経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生は養鶏場限定で、現在までのところ人での感染報告がない。3,000羽の鶏が死亡したことで異常性は確認されるが、公衆衛生への直接的深刻度はまだ低い。H5N1は高病原性であり人への拡大リスク監視が必要。複数の検査機関による確認検査が実施されており、当局の対応は適切に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Tb isn't always obvious: Early symptoms that look common but can signal a serious infection
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) often lacks clear early signs, with initial symptoms like a persistent cough, evening fever, fatigue, night sweats, and unintended weight loss that can resemble flu or a cold. Dr. Monica Kumbhat M of Neuberg Diagnostics in Chennai cautions that mild early symptoms are easily ignored, leading to self-medication and delayed diagnosis, which allows TB bacteria to multiply and potentially spread in close-contact settings. TB can affect organs beyond the lungs (extrapulmonary TB), including lymph nodes, bones, and the abdomen. Seek medical evaluation if a cough lasts more than two weeks or if unexplainable weight loss, persistent fatigue, fever at night, or night sweats occur. Early diagnosis enables testing and treatment with regular, proper medication; interrupting or delaying treatment can complicate the disease and its transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 結核は必ずしも明白ではない：一般的に見える初期症状が深刻な感染を示唆できる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核とインフルエンザの症状認識に関する教育的コンテンツであり、アウトブレイク・疾病群発・異常な疾病パターンの報告ではない。新たな感染症イベントの知見を含まない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・チェンナイの医療専門家による結核の初期症状に関する一般的な医学情報提供である。特定のアウトブレイク、異常な疾病パターン、または感染症危機を報告していない。診断・治療についての教育的ガイダンスであり、シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão de combate à dengue em bairro de Joinville elimina quase duas toneladas de entulho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Control Campaign in a Joinville Neighborhood Eliminates Nearly Two Tons of Debris
article.articleSummary: Joinville, Brazil’s Jarivatuba neighborhood conducted a dengue-control mutirão that removed nearly two tons of debris to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. The effort mobilized over 80 professionals and volunteers from Environmental Surveillance, Sanitary Vigilance, Civil Protection and Security, and other municipal departments, plus community health workers. Of the debris collected in this year’s third mutirão, about 1 ton was concentrated in two residences. Teams visited 1,129 homes and 140 businesses, inspected 46 vacant lots, and checked 2,617 deposits, with 171 deposits receiving preventive treatment. During the operation, 288 repellent bottles were distributed, and insecticide was applied at three scrap yards and a recycling company to eliminate adult mosquitoes. As of 2026, Joinville reports 27 confirmed dengue cases and no deaths. The campaign also integrates education and Wolbachia-based strategies alongside ongoing vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: Joinville地区のデング熱対策キャンペーン、ほぼ2トンのごみを撤去
triage.triage_reason: 地元自治体による予防的ベクター対策キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な発生状況や国際的脅威を示さない。確認症例数は少数（27例）で、死亡なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の日常的な地方自治体レベルの予防対策活動を報道するもの。イベント発生と捉えられるような異常状況、急増、あるいは制御困難な状況は記載されていない。Joinvilleでの確認症例27例は公衆衛生上の懸念を示さない規模である。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai 'Mysterious' Deaths: Can Watermelon Cause Food Poisoning? Experts Weigh In After 4 Die in Pydhonie | 📰 LatestLY
article.articleSummary: Four members of a Mumbai family died from suspected food poisoning after a late-night meal in the Pydhonie area of South Mumbai. Abdullah Dokadia, 40; his wife Nasreen, 35; and daughters Ayesha, 16, and Zainab, 13, fell ill after sharing biryani with relatives on 25 April; they reportedly consumed watermelon between 1:00 and 1:30 AM. By 5:30 AM all four had severe vomiting and diarrhoea; Ayesha died the same morning, followed by Nasreen and Zainab, and Abdullah around 10:30 PM. Post-mortems at JJ Hospital are pending histopathology/forensic reports. Police have registered an Accidental Death Report (ADR) and sent biryani remnants and watermelon to the Forensic Science Laboratory Kalina for toxicology. Experts cite Salmonella or E. coli as possible culprits; concerns about contamination or adulteration of the fruit have been raised. Nine dinner guests reportedly remained well.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの「謎の死」：スイカは食中毒の原因になりうるか？専門家がピドニーで4人が死亡した後の意見を述べる
triage.triage_reason: 4人の死亡を含む急速な重症食中毒発生イベント。Salmonella/E. coli等複数の病原体が検査対象であり、感染症公衆衛生上の重大性と異常性を満たす。India（対象国）での発生。
triage.notes: 短時間内（数時間以内）の4人死亡は異常。主症状（重度の嘔吐・下痢）と検査対象病原体（Salmonella、E. coli、パラチフス）から感染症トリアージとして適切。ただし食中毒の原因（スイカ汚染、食事準備時の不衛生等）は仮説段階であり、確定診断待ち。警察ADR登録・法医学検査進行中。9人の夕食同席者が無症状である点は、感染の強度・範囲の限定性を示唆するが、公衆衛生対応上は引き続き監視必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Cuiabá reforça prevenção contra a raiva e leishmaniose canina | Gazeta Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá City Hall strengthens rabies and canine leishmaniasis prevention | Gazeta Digital
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, Brazil reports rising Canine Visceral Leishmaniasis (CVL) and ongoing rabies prevention. Up to March 2026 (weeks 1–11), CVL in dogs reached 118 confirmed cases, a 78.3% weekly-average increase from 2025 (6.0 to 10.7), with ELISA-confirmed positives up 51.3%. Two human visceral leishmaniasis cases have been notified this year—one confirmed in a Cuiabá resident and another under investigation. Prevention emphasizes environmental sanitation to reduce the sandfly vector; the UVZ offers free canine testing. Rabies vaccination totals 828 doses in dogs and cats through March, with annual immunization advised from 3 months of age. Health units logged 436 post-exposure rabies inquiries; 66 were severe, requiring serum and vaccine. Rabies is fatal; seek prompt care after bites or contact with suspected animals. Vaccination/access available at UVZ (8:00–17:00, weekdays) and by appointment at Hovet and Unic; avoid contact with ill/deceased animals; report cruelty.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバ市庁舎、狂犬病と犬内臓リーシュマニア症予防の強化について報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける犬の内臓リーシュマニア症の増加（118例、78.3%増）と人間での2例の報告（1例確定、1例調査中）が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の重症度・流行可能性が該当しますが、これは地域レベルの予防強化キャンペーンの記事であり、深刻な公衆衛生危機を示す情報が不足しています。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（マト・グロッソ州クイアバ市）での犬内臓リーシュマニア症と狂犬病の増加を報告しており、検出国は対象国リストに含まれます。犬の症例が118例で78.3%増加、人間の症例は2例（1例確定）に限定されており、地域的な予防活動の報告です。IHR基準では国際的拡大・渡航制限の直接的な懸念がないため該当数は1つですが、WPRO基準では異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさが3つ該当し、政府レベルの対応が見られるため、情報不足による経過観察が適切と判断されます。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bangka buka layanan RDT deteksi dini malaria pada ibu hamil - ANTARA News Bangka Belitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangka Health Office opens RDT service for early detection of malaria in pregnant women
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, is being detected early through free Rapid Diagnostic Tests (RDT) for pregnant women, launched by Sungailiat District Health Office in commemoration of World Malaria Day 2026. Data from Puskesmas Sungailiat shows two malaria cases in 2026. The program uses Mass Blood Survey (MBS) with finger-prick blood to identify pregnancies at risk and locate undetected cases, targeting malaria focus areas in Dusun Bubus and Belinyu, Bangka. Additionally, Anopheles mosquito larval surveys are conducted at former tin-mining sites (kolong) to identify receptive breeding habitats. Authorities urge environmental cleanliness to reduce transmission. They express optimism that active community participation can curb malaria even with low case numbers, emphasizing ongoing surveillance and vector monitoring as essential components of elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ保健局、妊婦のマラリア早期検出のためのRDTサービスを開始
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バンカ州）でのマラリア検出サービス開始に関する記事。2026年のケース数は少ない（2件）が、妊婦対象の早期検出プログラムと環境対策が実施されている。IHR基準の該当は限定的だが、WPROスクリーニング基準での異常性と地域的な対策状況から、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はバンカ州におけるマラリア対策の公衆衛生イニシアティブについてのもの。2026年のケース数は最小限（2件）であるが、妊婦を対象とした早期検出プログラム、ハマダラカの幼虫調査、旧スズ鉱山地域での媒介蚊繁殖地対策など、地域的な公衆衛生対応が実施されている。異常性としては妊婦特異的なリスク対応と環境的リスク要因（旧鉱山地の積水）が認識されている点が特筆される。ただし現段階では重症度や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Em meio a pico da chikungunya, secretário de Saúde de MS aguarda vacinas do Governo Federal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid a Chikungunya peak, the Mato Grosso do Sul Health Secretary awaits vaccines from the Federal Government.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul reports a chikungunya surge in April 2026, with about 7,500 cases (confirmed and suspected) across 18 municipalities, led by the state. Health Secretary Maurício Simões says vaccines are supplied by the Ministry of Health and more doses are awaiting; Itaporã and Dourados have begun vaccination. As of April 18, 2026, the year’s tally accounts for 54.3% of 2025’s 14,148 probable cases. Since 2015–2024, MS recorded 7,143 cases; 2026 numbers already approach doubling that decade total by April. Deaths from January–April 2026 reached 13, about 70.6% of 2025’s 17 fatalities. MS leads national incidence at 259.4 per 100,000, far above the national average of 15; Goiás, Rondônia, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, and Rio Grande do Norte also show high rates. Brazil tallies 19 chikungunya deaths, 13 in MS. Transmitted by Aedes aegypti, chikungunya causes high fever and intense joint pain; vaccination is limited.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱のピークの最中、マトグロッソドスル州保健局長は連邦政府からのワクチンを待機中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱の顕著な流行。2026年4月の時点で既に2025年通年の54.3%に達し、死亡者は2025年の70.6%に相当。州レベルで深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマトグロッソドスル州を中心とした2026年4月のチクングニア熱流行について報じている。7,500例以上（確認例および疑い例）、死亡13例という顕著な数字。全国的な波及も示唆されている（Goiás、Rondônia、Tocantins、Rio Grande do Norteでの高罹患率）。ワクチン供給の限界も記述されており、対応の課題が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Max Healthcare joins global consortium under Indo-European COMBAT initiative for dengue research
article.articleSummary: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd joined an international consortium under the Indo-European COMBAT initiative to advance dengue research and strengthen pandemic preparedness, announced 27 April 2026 from New Delhi. The initiative, supported by the Department of Biotechnology and the European Commission, brings together leading global and Indian institutions to develop technology-driven solutions for mosquito-borne disease management. The consortium has been awarded a landmark grant to drive research aimed at improving understanding, diagnosis, and management of dengue and related infectious diseases. With dengue posing a significant burden across tropical regions, the collaboration is expected to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions while strengthening preparedness for future pandemics through innovation and shared expertise. Max Healthcare Group Medical Director Sandeep Budhiraja said the collaboration combines clinical expertise with advanced technologies to improve early diagnosis and patient outcomes. Karolinska Institute Associate Professor Ujjwal Neogi noted the partnership leverages European scientific strength and India's clinical depth.

triage.headline_ja: Max Healthcare、デング熱研究に関するインド・ヨーロッパ共同イニシアチブCOMBAT下の国際コンソーシアムに参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱研究への国際的な学術協力と資金提供の発表であり、感染症の発生や流行イベントではなく、研究機関による研究開発イニシアチブの告知である。公衆衛生上の新規イベント・危機的状況は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は進行中の感染症イベント（患者発生・流行）ではなく、デング熱研究における学術的協力枠組みの構築に関する機関発表である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Salgının 'sıfır noktası' belirlendi! Dünyanın %9,3'ü büyük risk altında: Türkiye listede mi?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak's 'ground zero' has been identified! 9.3% of the world is at high risk: Is Turkey on the list?
article.articleSummary: Satellite- and machine-learning–based global map identifies the world’s most outbreak-prone areas, finding about 9.3% of land as extremely vulnerable. Latin America and Oceania are highlighted due to climate change and high population density. Led by Angela Fanelli of the EU Joint Research Centre and published in Science Advances, the study flags population density as the strongest driver, with urban expansion into wildlife zones triggering animal-to-human spillovers. Warming temperatures and longer seasons are reshaping disease patterns, pushing mosquito- and tick-borne illnesses into higher latitudes in the Northern Hemisphere. An ‘Outbreak Risk Index’ combines outbreak probability with response capacity; Papua New Guinea and the Republic of the Congo rank high while lacking robust health infrastructure. WHO monitors Ebola, Zika, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever, and the evolving “Disease X.” Turkey is not among the global top risk but shows regional variance: mid risk in parts of Western/Central Anatolia, higher locally in the Southeast and Mediterranean, lower along the Black Sea coast.

triage.headline_ja: アウトブレイクの『震源地』が特定された！世界の9.3%が高リスク下にある：トルコは対象か？
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤感染症（Ebola、CCHF、Zika）が言及されており、グローバルな感染症リスク評価論文に基づく報告。ただし、実際の患者発生報告ではなく、リスク予測モデルに関する学術記事であり、具体的な疾病の発生状況が不明瞭。DRC対象国だが、同国での具体的なアウトブレイク記述は明確でない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術出版物（Science Advances）に基づくグローバル感染症リスク予測モデルの報告。Ebola、CCHF、Zikaが言及されているが、これは現在進行中の具体的アウトブレイク報告ではなく、将来的なリスク評価である。DRCはハイリスク地域として言及されており対象国に該当。Papua New Guineaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Türkiyeは「トップリスク国ではない」と明記されているため、実際の発生地ではなく比較対象として言及されているのみ。情報が学術的リスク評価に偏しており、実際の患者発生状況が不明確なため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem 94% em Curitiba em 2026 - Portal Nosso Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall 94% in Curitiba in 2026 - Portal Nosso Dia
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Curitiba decline 94% in early 2026 versus the same period a year earlier, with 62 cases from January 1 to April 15, down from 999 in 2025 and far below 7,093 in 2024. The dengue incidence rate dropped to 19 per 100,000 inhabitants in 2026, from 91/100k in 2025 and 905/100k in 2024. There were no dengue-related deaths in Curitiba in 2026 up to April 15, nor in 2025; eight deaths occurred in 2024, four by mid-April. Breeding sites for Aedes aegypti totaled 519 in January–April 2026, versus 1,688 in 2025 and 2,028 in 2024, a 69% reduction year over year and 74% versus 2024. Health officials credit intersectoral actions and civil involvement. Eggs can remain viable for up to 450 days; El Niño is forecast for late 2026 and next year, so vigilance continues.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年クリチバでのデング熱患者数が94%減少
triage.triage_reason: 患者数が大幅に減少する正の公衆衛生成果を報告する記事であり、異常な疾患発生や深刻なリスク状況ではない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はクリチバ（ブラジル）においてデング熱の患者数が著しく減少（2025年比94%減）したことを報告するもので、危機的な感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、むしろ公衆衛生対策の成功事例である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Jaraguá do Sul reforça alerta sobre risco de volta do sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaraguá do Sul Health Department reinforces warning about the risk of measles returning.
article.articleSummary: Jaraguá do Sul Health Department warns of an imminent measles reintroduction risk in Brazil, linked to FIFA World Cup 2026 travel to the United States, Mexico, and Canada (June 11–July 19). The Joint Technical Note Nº 80/2026 from the Health Surveillance and Immunization Program urges vaccination for travelers and residents as countries hosting the event report active measles outbreaks. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease transmitted mainly via airborne droplets; vaccination is available through Brazil’s National Immunization Program with the MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) and the MMRV (adding varicella) vaccines, provided free. Brazil has been endemic-free for measles since 2024. In 2025, 3,952 suspected cases; 38 confirmed (10 imported, 25 import-related, 3 unknown), with 94.7% of confirmed lacking vaccination history. In 2026 (through week 10): 232 suspected, 2 confirmed. Travelers should verify vaccination status before travel and update at health units.

triage.headline_ja: ジャラグア・ド・スル保健部、麻疹の再流行リスクについての警告を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹の再導入リスクが警告されており、FIFA2026ワールドカップに関連した国際的な移動を背景とした異常な疾病イベント。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、対象国ブラジルでの発生として識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのジャラグア・ド・スルにおける麻疹再導入リスクの警告が主題。USA、Mexico、Canadaは麻疹流行国としてリスク源として言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジルは endemic-free (2024年以降)であるが、2026年ワールドカップ開催国への国民の移動と外国人の入国により、輸入例が発生する可能性が警告されている。複数の弱毒化ワクチン接種可能疾患（麻疹、おたふくかぜ、風疹、水痘）が同時に言及されている点も注意。

article.articleHeadline: Piden intensificar eliminación de criaderos ante casos de serotipo 3 de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Call to intensify elimination of mosquito breeding sites in light of dengue serotype-3 cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Paraguay shows rising activity with almost 30 laboratory-confirmed cases in the last three weeks, predominantly dengue serotype 1, alongside two imported cases of serotype 3—uncommon since 2007 when it last circulated heavily in the country. Both DENV-3 cases involved recent travel to neighboring countries where the serotype remains common. Although dengue transmission is not yet high, officials urge intensified vector control, especially elimination of mosquito breeding sites, use of repellents, and protection in the rainy season that extends into autumn, creating favorable conditions for Aedes aegypti. No dengue deaths have been reported in Paraguay this year. A public health dengue vaccine is available at health centers to reduce severe disease. Separately, 10 chikungunya cases have been confirmed since January, with surveillance described as 'super active' due to neighboring outbreaks in Bolivia and Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: デングウイルス血清型3の症例に対応して蚊の繁殖地排除の強化を要求
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで確認されたデングとチクングニアの複合イベントであり、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、WPRO基準も複数該当。地域における公衆衛生上の懸念が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な焦点はパラグアイのデング活動であり、ボリビアとブラジルは『隣国での流行』として参照されている。検証可能な対象国はブラジル（GeoNames ID: 3469034）のみ。パラグアイ（対象国リストに未含）でのデング血清型3の再出現とチクングニア確認は、雨期による蚊の活動増加と旅行関連症例による国際的な病原体の移動を示唆する異常性と流行リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 萧岗村城中村改造项目开展登革热疫情应急演练新快报2026-4-27
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xiaogang Village Urban Village Redevelopment Project Conducts Dengue Fever Epidemic Emergency Drill - New Express 2026-04-27
article.articleSummary: On April 21, 2026, the Xiaogang Village Urban Village Redevelopment Project of the China Railway Construction Engineering Group Fifth Company conducted a dengue fever emergency drill in Guangzhou. The exercise, organized with the Yun City Center for Disease Control and Prevention, Yun City Street Xiaogang Economic Joint Association, Hongyue Company, and others, aimed to rapidly interrupt the dengue transmission chain through joint prevention and control. The drill featured scenarios for reporting suspected cases, rapid disinfection, and meticulous elimination of mosquito breeding sites, with emphasis on drainage and waste bins. It enhanced practical anti-dengue skills, health-protection awareness, and cross-unit coordination. The project will continue integrating dengue prevention into daily management and will collaborate with Guangzhou New City Hospital for a dengue prevention seminar to further safeguard workers and the project environment.

triage.headline_ja: 萧岗村城中村改造项目开展登革热疫情应急演练（萧岗村都市村改造プロジェクト、デング熱流行対応訓練を実施）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国広州における登革熱の緊急対応訓練に関する内容であり、実際の流行イベントではなく、予防啓発・訓練活動の報告である。実際の患者発生数、重症度、流行拡大のリスク等の具体的な保健衛生上の脅威が記述されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は訓練・演習活動の報告であり、実際の感染症流行の報告ではない。登革熱の流行状況、患者数、死亡例等の具体的な公衆衛生上の脅威に関する情報がない。シグナルトリアージの対象外として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: 女童接触非洲大蜗牛引发严重脑炎新快报综合2026-4-27
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl's contact with Giant African snail triggers severe encephalitis - New Express Comprehensive, 2026-04-27
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, China, a 1-year-old girl developed persistent fever after contact with an African giant snail in her community and was diagnosed with Guangzhou Angiostrongyliasis (Angiostrongylus cantonensis) causing severe encephalitis. Initial fever and vomiting led to conventional encephalitis treatment with poor response, prompting transfer to Shenzhen Children's Hospital. After excluding common bacteria and viruses, laboratory confirmation identified Angiostrongylus cantonensis infection. The exposure history showed the child interacted with snails; the African giant snail is a key intermediate host, with rats as the final host, and larvae can infect humans. The illness began around September 2025; treatment lasted about six months, and she was discharged after stopping medication, though long-term follow-up is required. Similar pediatric cases were reported last year in South China. With the rainy season, snail activity increases, so parents should prevent children from contact with these snails to avoid severe parasitic brain inflammation.

triage.headline_ja: 女児がアフリカマイマイとの接触で重篤な脳炎を発症 - 新快報総合、2026年4月27日
triage.triage_reason: アンギオストロンギルス症による脳炎という神経系感染症の重症症例が報告され、小児を含む複数の症例があり、環境的リスク因子（雨季のマイマイ増加）を伴う公衆衛生的懸念がある。
triage.notes: アンギオストロンギルス症による脳炎は希少疾患であり、小児の重症症例報告は医学的に重要。記事サマリーによれば昨年も南中国で類似の小児症例が報告されており、季節的な再発リスクが存在する。ただし国際的拡大のリスクは現時点で不明。香港・マカオ記事ではないため、発生地域はChinaのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Four members of family die of suspected food poisoning in Mumbai after eating biryani, watermelon
article.articleSummary: Four members of a Mumbai family died of suspected food poisoning in the Pydhonie area after eating biryani and watermelon. Nine relatives dined together around 10:30 PM on April 25; by the early hours of April 26, four family members developed vomiting and loose motions and were treated by a family doctor before being referred to JJ Hospital. The younger daughter Aisha (16) died at about 10:15 AM on April 26; her husband, Abdullah Dokadia (40), died later that night at around 10:30 PM. The wife Nasreen Dokadia (35) and elder daughter Zainab (13) also died during treatment. Post-mortems have been conducted, but the final cause will be confirmed after histopathological reports; police say the exact cause remains unclear and under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの一家4人がビリヤニとスイカを食べた後の食中毒の疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の疑いで4人の死亡が報告されており重症度は高いが、原因が特定されていない（検査進行中）。限定的な集団発生（9人中4人）であり、現時点では国際的拡大リスクの証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 原因は未確定で、組織病理学的検査報告待ち。現在のところ単一の家族集団発生。ただし原因特定までは疾患の特性（伝播性など）が不明であるため、情報の進展を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: मुंबई फूड पॉइजनिंग: एक ही परिवार के 4 लोगों की मौत, 'आधे कटे तरबूज' से खुलेगा राज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai food poisoning: Four members of the same family have died, "half-cut watermelons" will reveal the mystery.
article.articleSummary: Mumbai’s Pydhuni area records a sudden, fatal food-poisoning cluster after a family dinner on April 25. Abdulllah Abdul Kader (40), wife Nasreen (35), and daughters Aisha (16) and Zainab (13) ate watermelon after a meal around 10:30 pm; by 1–1:30 am they developed severe abdominal pain and vomiting. Zainab died first in hospital, followed by Aisha, Nasreen, and Abdul, all within hours. A half-cut watermelon recovered at the scene is a key lead. Investigations span three agencies: FDA testing for adulterants or toxins in the fruit; JJ Hospital clinicians examining bacterial infection and tissue; and the Forensic Science Lab comparing samples and viscera to determine cause of death. Doctors note that simply eating biryani with watermelon is unlikely to explain the deaths, raising concerns about contaminated fruit or chemical adulteration; lab confirmation is pending.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ食中毒: 同一家族の4人が死亡、「半分カットされたスイカ」が謎を解く
triage.triage_reason: 短時間に4人の死亡を伴う食中毒クラスターの急速発生であり、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当。未知の毒性物質または病原体が関与する可能性があり、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 食中毒原因は未確定だが、化学物質混入またはスイカの汚染が疑われており、調査機関（FDA相当、病院検査部門、法医学研究所）が複数並行して検査中。死亡率が高く、短時間での多数死亡は異常。原因物質の特定まで追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Първи случай на коремен тиф: Варненка се зарази след обиколка на будистки храмове в Китай и Виетнам
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of typhoid fever: a woman from Varna contracted it after touring Buddhist temples in China and Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: First typhoid fever case diagnosed in Varna, Bulgaria, in a woman who recently toured China and Vietnam; the two-month trip included visits to Buddhist temples, with the infection described as severe and highly contagious. Her husband also traveled; after returning, she developed gastrointestinal symptoms and was hospitalized. Typhoid tests were negative in the husband and the wife’s specimens, and they remain under quarantine. She is in good overall condition and nearing discharge; authorities urge hygiene and safe food practices. Separately, Varna reports three measles cases in children under 12 who have only one vaccine dose. Two brothers were contacts of a Sofia girl who visited Varna and developed measles; the brothers were quarantined and later hospitalized with improving conditions. The third case is a Ukrainian-origin child with mild disease not requiring hospitalization. Transmission details for the Ukrainian case remain unclear, and there is no school/daycare exposure.

triage.headline_ja: コレラティフスの初例：ヴァルナの女性が中国とベトナムの仏教寺院ツアー後に感染
triage.triage_reason: 対象国（中国、ベトナム）での感染源は報告されておらず、患者はブルガリア在住。対象国リストに該当する患者発生がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。ただし国際旅行関連感染症のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事は患者の旅行先（中国、ベトナム）を言及するが、実際の感染症発生は対象国内ではなくブルガリアで確認されている。感染源は旅行中の食事衛生不備と推定されるが、中国・ベトナムでの集団発生等の報告はない。対象国リストでは該当患者発生がないため verified_locations は空配列。WATCH判定は、国際旅行関連感染症として今後の情報更新に注視するべき事例として評価。

article.articleHeadline: Max Healthcare Joins Indo-EU Consortium For Dengue Research - BW Healthcare World
article.articleSummary: Max Healthcare Institute joined the Indo-European COMBAT research initiative, a multinational dengue-focused collaboration funded by India's Department of Biotechnology and the European Commission. The project unites Indian and European institutions to advance dengue research through multi-omics, clinical data, and artificial intelligence, aiming to elucidate disease progression, identify biomarkers, and enable earlier detection and intervention. Led in India by Dr. Sandeep Budhiraja and Dr. Atul Thatai, with facilitation by Dr. Ujjwal Neogi (Karolinska Institute) and led domestically by BRIC National Institute of Biomedical Genomics. The initiative seeks to improve understanding, diagnostics, and disease management for dengue, a significant public health issue in India and other tropical regions. The collaboration emphasizes cross-border data sharing and capacity building to strengthen preparedness for infectious disease outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: Max Healthcare が デング熱研究のインド・EU コンソーシアムに参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の研究協力や学術イニシアティブについての報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン、または緊急の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医療機関のデング熱研究への参加を報じるプレスリリース性のニュースであり、シグナル検出対象外。現在の感染症の状況、患者数、死亡、新規の疾病発生については記載されていない。学術的コラボレーションの発表であるため、感染症危機管理・EBS活動の対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: What Is Viral Hepatitis And Why It's A Growing Public Health Concern - BW Healthcare World
