article.articleSummary: Viral hepatitis comprises five viruses—A, B, C, D, and E—with distinct transmission routes and outcomes. Hepatitis A and E are primarily food- and water-borne and typically cause acute illness; most people recover, though severe complications can occur in at-risk groups. Hepatitis B and C spread via blood and other body fluids and often become chronic, silently damaging the liver and elevating risks of cirrhosis, liver failure, and cancer. The article notes India as a country experiencing a growing public health burden due to many undiagnosed cases and late detection. Vaccines exist for Hepatitis A and B, and in some areas for E; there is no vaccine for Hepatitis C, so prevention emphasizes safe medical practices and blood screening. Sanitation and clean water are crucial for A and E. A coordinated strategy is needed to boost awareness, vaccination, screening, and access to care.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性肝炎とは何か、そしてなぜそれが増大する公衆衛生上の懸念なのか
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるウイルス性肝炎の公衆衛生上の負担について論じた記事だが、具体的な発生状況（患者数、死亡数、地域範囲）や流行の詳細が記載されておらず、主に疾患の一般的情報と管理戦略に関するコメンタリーである。情報不足のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおけるウイルス性肝炎（A、B、C型）の公衆衛生上の負担について述べているが、具体的なアウトブレイク情報（患者数、死亡数、新規患者の急増、地理的分布の詳細）が記載されていない。むしろ一般的な疾患解説と予防戦略に関する記事である。WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露と流行のしやすさに該当するが、IHR基準には該当せず、具体的な発生状況の詳細が不足しているため、WATCH段階とした。

article.articleHeadline: PKK Banten perkuat edukasi keluarga cegah stunting dan Tuberkulosis - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PKK Banten Strengthens Family Education to Prevent Stunting and Tuberculosis - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleSummary: PKK Banten strengthens family-focused education to prevent stunting and tuberculosis (TB). TP PKK Provinsi Banten Chair Tinawati Andra Soni emphasizes expanding socialization to the family unit to ensure no child experiences growth restriction. The Genting initiative (Gerakan Orang Tua Asuh Cegah Stunting) at Resort Umbul Tanjung, Cinangka, Serang Regency, combines Tata Boga (cooking skills) training with a TB awareness meeting, targeting families as the core change agent. The program aims to empower health workers and PKK cadres to reduce TB transmission and support elimination targets, with coordination from DP3AKKB and the Department of Community Empowerment and Village Development. Serang Kabupaten PKK Chair Tifa welcomes the provincial effort, hoping benefits include improved child nutrition and enhanced economic empowerment through practical skills training, sustaining health gains beyond the training period.

triage.headline_ja: PKK Banten（インドネシア女性組織）が栄養不良と結核予防の家族教育を強化 - ANTARA News Banten
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核予防キャンペーン・啓発活動に関するもので、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではなく、既存の公衆衛生施策の報道である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・バンテン州での結核予防教育キャンペーン（PKK：女性開発組織による啓発活動）に関する報道であり、新規クラスタ・アウトブレイク・異常な疾患増加の報告ではない。既存の公衆衛生施策の実施状況に関する情報のため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Коремният тиф вероятно е внесен във Варна от Виетнам или Индия - Евроком
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Typhoid fever was probably imported into Varna from Vietnam or India - Eurocom
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever (enteric fever) was likely imported into Varna, Bulgaria, from Vietnam or India. A wife in a Ukrainian family living in Varna has been diagnosed and admitted to the Infectious Diseases Clinic at St. Marina University Multi-profile Hospital. The husband, their child, and an elderly woman are not infected and remain out of hospital. The family recently returned from Vietnam and India; Regional Health Inspectorate says the infection probably originated there. The illness is linked to consumption of unverified market food or contaminated water. The patient was in serious condition on admission but is expected to recover. This represents an imported case in Varna with no current spread to other family members reported. Public health authorities are monitoring potential sources and travel-related exposure.

triage.headline_ja: チフス熱（腸チフス）はおそらくベトナムまたはインドからヴァルナに持ち込まれた - ユーロコム
triage.triage_reason: 対象国（インド、ベトナム）との関連が確認されるが、ブルガリアでの単一輸入症例であり、現地の家族内での二次感染は報告されていない。スクリーニング基準複数該当するも、社会的・政治的関心の程度が不明確。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: イベントの発生地はブルガリア（ヴァルナ）であるが、感染源はインドとベトナムとされている。記事サマリーではインドとベトナムからの輸入症例として言及されており、両国が感染源と確認されているため verified_locations に含める。現地での流行拡大の兆候は報告されていないが、公衆衛生当局による監視が継続されている。

article.articleHeadline: Antički rimski toaleti u Bugarskoj otkrivaju neočekivan patogen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ancient Roman toilets in Bulgaria reveal an unexpected pathogen.
article.articleSummary: Cryptosporidium identified in the majority of ancient fecal samples sealed in Roman latrines from Lower Moesia, Bulgaria, dated 2nd–4th century CE, revealing the earliest reliable evidence of this parasite in the Mediterranean region and challenging prior beliefs of a Central American origin. Also detected were Entamoeba histolytica and Taenia eggs, indicating amebic dysentery and consumption of undercooked beef or pork. Differences emerged between two settlements: Novae near the Danube yielded parasite-rich deposits—likely from contaminated water—while Marcianopolis showed no parasites, suggesting access to cleaner water from four natural springs and better diet. Researchers rehydrated, filtered, and microscopically scanned mineralized fecal residues, used ancient DNA analysis to distinguish parasites, and applied ELISA to confirm specific pathogens. The findings illuminate ancient parasite transmission and the evolution of infectious diseases in Europe.

triage.headline_ja: ブルガリアの古代ローマ時代のトイレから予期しない病原体が発見
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは2,000年以上前の古代遺物から検出された過去の病原体についての考古学的発見であり、現在の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。現在進行中の感染症の流行ではなく、歴史的・学術的関心事である。
triage.notes: 本記事は考古学的調査報告であり、現在の感染症イベントではない。Bluedot APIが検出したブラジルの場所（Marcianópolis）は誤検出である可能性が高い。実際の発掘地はブルガリア（対象国リストに含まれない）のため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみ含めるが、記事内容はブラジルとは関連がない。この情報は感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Depilação íntima com lâmina: médicos alertam para riscos de infecções graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intimate hair removal with a razor: doctors warn of risks of serious infections.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-27, physicians warn that intimate hair removal with razors poses health risks. Shaving all pubic hair removes the natural protective barrier and causes microtrauma, increasing risk of folliculitis and skin lesions; in rare cases it can lead to Fournier's gangrene, a serious infection. The humid bathroom environment storing razors accelerates bacterial growth, raising infection risk during subsequent depilation. Experts recommend partial hair removal to preserve protection, as complete removal can raise injury risk two- to three-fold. People with diabetes, obesity, compromised immune systems, or a history of folliculitis should ideally avoid razor depilation. If redness or irritation lasts beyond 72 hours, see a dermatologist or urologist. Safer options include electric trimmers or laser hair removal. If razor is used, follow hygiene steps: store dry, replace frequently; use warm water and shaving cream; shave with growth; apply fragrance-free moisturizer, avoid perfume, alcohol, sun exposure, and tight clothing afterward.

triage.headline_ja: 陰毛を剃刀で処理することのリスク：医師らが深刻な感染症の危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: これは感染症の流行や発生イベントではなく、剃刀使用に伴う感染症リスクについての医学的啓発記事である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人衛生慣行に伴う感染症リスクの一般的な啓発であり、特定の感染症発生・流行の報告ではない。Bluedot APIが感染症関連キーワード（folliculitis, Fournier's gangrene等）により検出したと考えられるが、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Global Health Experts Urge Urgent Action to Prevent Future Pandemics Where They Begin
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-04-27 in Bronx, NY, a Lancet paper urges governments to place spillover prevention—stopping pathogen jumps from animals to humans—at the core of pandemic preparedness. Rather than focusing mainly on surveillance, vaccines, and emergency response, the authors advocate reducing spillover risk at its source through ecosystem protection, wildlife-trade regulation, and safer human–livestock–nature interfaces. Citing diseases such as COVID-19, Ebola, and avian influenza, the study argues prevention is more effective and cost-efficient. It highlights deforestation, road expansion, and agricultural encroachment in tropical forests like the Amazon Basin as drivers heightening risk, and calls for elevating spillover prevention in international policy, national health strategies, and cross-sector governance. A One Health approach—integrating public health, conservation, agriculture, and finance—is urged, with the 2026 UN High-Level Meeting in New York seen as a pivotal moment for concrete commitments.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルヘルスの専門家が、パンデミックが始まる場所での予防措置の緊急実行を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術論文の政策提言に関する報道であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。複数疾患の言及は例示的なもので、具体的な新規症例報告やアウトブレイク情報を含まない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域としてBrazilを付与しているが、記事サマリーではBrazilでの具体的なアウトブレイクは報告されていない。記事はBronx/NYで発表された学術論文に関する報道であり、アマゾン盆地への言及は例示的な背景情報である。対象国リスト内での実際の感染症イベント発生の報告がないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: MS está entre os 10 estados com mais casos de gripe no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul is among the 10 states with the most influenza cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul is among Brazil's top 10 states for influenza, with 161 notifications from January through April and 14 deaths. Of these, 3 are H1N1, 123 H3N2, 19 influenza A (unsubtyped), and 16 influenza B. Nationally, São Paulo leads with 818 cases, followed by Ceará and Minas Gerais; MS ranks 8th with 161. In MS, the elderly (65+) are most affected, with 0–2 year-olds (26 cases) and 5–14 year-olds (27 cases). Overall, the period shows a 43.5% decline versus the same period last year (285). Vaccination in Campo Grande remains critically low, at 18% of the priority group vaccinated by April 22, 2026; a Day D mobilization occurred on April 25. Fiocruz Infogripe reports 14 of 27 states with SRAG at alert level, with RSV growth and rising influenza A activity; capitals under alert include Campo Grande and Cuiabá.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州はブラジルにおけるインフルエンザケースが最も多い10州の中に含まれている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全国での季節性インフルエンザの活動報告であり、死亡例（14名）とワクチン接種率の低さが確認されるが、単一国内での疾患であることと具体的な異常性の記載が限定的なため、情報の推移観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本事象はブラジル国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行報告である。死亡例14名、複数州での警戒レベル引き上げ、ワクチン接種率18%と低い点が重症度と長期曝露リスク判定の根拠。ただしIHR国際的拡大基準は満たさず、国内の公衆衛生課題として位置づけられる。追加情報（死亡率、新規感染者数推移）があればリスク評価の精緻化が可能。

article.articleHeadline: Child dies, 18 hospitalised following 'food poisoning' in Jharkhand's Giridih
article.articleSummary: Giridih district, Jharkhand, reported a suspected food-poisoning outbreak linked to a Golgappa and Chaat cart vendor who visited the village Saturday evening. A large number of villagers consumed the items, with illness onset by Saturday night. More than 20 people, including women and children, were brought to Sadar for treatment on Sunday morning. Civil surgeon Oraon said food poisoning was detected among the patients, with the condition of others described as stable. A child died and 18 people were hospitalised. Police have initiated an investigation and the cart vendor is being searched. The incident highlights food-borne illness risk from street-vendor foods and the ongoing public health response in Giridih.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルカンド州ギリディでの集団食中毒事件：1児が死亡、18人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な地域での食中毒事件であり、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは低い。ただし死亡例と複数の入院者が発生しており、病因確定までは経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 疾患は『Unknown Illness』と分類されているが、サマリーでは『suspected food poisoning』と記述されている。確定診断未了。単一の露出源（屋台ベンダー）による限定的なアウトブレイクと判断されるため、現段階ではWATCH判定。病原体特定と2次感染の有無確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया से बचाव की जानकारी दी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria prevention information provided
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day was marked at Utkrimit High School, Shahabuti, in Senha block, with an awareness program led by Community Health Center staff. Medical personnel educated students and teachers about malaria prevention, explaining transmission via mosquito bites, unhygienic conditions, and consumption of contaminated water. Preventive measures emphasized included keeping areas around homes clean, using mosquito nets at night, and eating fresh food. A malaria-themed quiz was held, awarding top performers: Anuj Kumar Jaiswal (first), Krishna Mahli (second), Munni Kumari (third). Present were health workers Gandur Urav, Anuj Sinha, Principal Anita Khalkho, and Saro Urav, among others. The event also noted that training on digital census had begun.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア予防に関する情報提供
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは世界マラリアデーの啓発活動であり、新規感染症事例の報告ではない。予防教育と意識啓発が主目的で、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響やアウトブレイク信号を示していない。
triage.notes: 記事はジャールカンド州セナ地区での世界マラリアデーの啓発プログラムを報告しているが、マラリアの新規事例や集団発生の報告ではなく、予防教育イベントの記述である。公衆衛生上のシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Instan a extremar cuidados tras confirmar dos casos de DEN-3 en Paraguay
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urge people to take extra precautions after confirming two DENV-3 cases in Paraguay.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue virus serotype 3 (DENV-3) cases confirmed in Paraguay, with one imported from Brazil; both infections occurred in the last two weeks amid very low dengue circulation. Dr. Andrea Ojeda, head of the General Directorate of Health Surveillance, urged the public to intensify precautions and eliminate mosquito breeding sites as climate conditions may favor vector proliferation. DENV-3 is circulating regionally; the serotype is not described as more severe, but health authorities warn a potential outbreak if transmission intensifies. Paraguay previously saw DENV-3 circulation from 2002–2004, with a reappearance in 2025 after nine years of absence. The report notes imported cases and regional dynamics, underscoring vigilance and vector control to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: パラグアイでDEN-3の2症例確認後、予防措置の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱DENV-3の新たな確認事例が報告され、地域流行の可能性、輸入症例を含む国際的リスク、ベクター対策の必要性が示されている。IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク（Yes）、WPRO基準で異常性（9年ぶりの再出現）、流行リスク（蚊の増殖可能性）が該当し、シグナルピックアップ基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではパラグアイでDENV-3が確認され、ブラジルから輸入された1症例が報告されている。パラグアイは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジル（3469034）は対象国として該当。ただし、パラグアイからの輸入症例がブラジル経由であることが確認されるため、ブラジルを含める。Zambia（895949）は本記事と無関係であるため除外すべきだが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にパラグアイのみが記載されており、対象国リスト外のため、実質的には対象監視国の該当なしとなる。記事の主題はパラグアイ中心だが、対象国ではないため verified_locations は空配列とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Curitiba registra queda de 94% dos casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curitiba records a 94% drop in dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Curitiba, the capital of Paraná, Brazil, reported 62 dengue cases from January 1 to April 15, 2026, with no dengue deaths in that period. This represents a 94% decrease compared with the interior of Paraná, which recorded 999 cases in the same period in 2025, and a 99% decline from 7,093 cases in the corresponding period of 2024. No dengue deaths were reported in Curitiba in 2025 up to April 15, while in 2024 there were eight dengue deaths in total, four by April 15. Data are from Curitiba’s Municipal Health Secretariat. The trend indicates markedly reduced dengue transmission in Curitiba relative to prior years and to the interior.

triage.headline_ja: クリチバでのデング熱患者数が94%減少
triage.triage_reason: 記事は減少傾向を報告するもので、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、または流行性を示さない。むしろ感染制御の成功を示唆している。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのクリチバにおけるデング熱の症例数減少を報告するもので、むしろ公衆衛生の改善を示す内容。シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: IMA alerta população para evitar contato com aves marinhas durante período migratório
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IMA warns the public to avoid contact with seabirds during the migratory period.
article.articleSummary: During the seabird migratory season (April–September) in Alagoas, Brazil, the Institute of the Environment (IMA/AL) warns the public to avoid contact with debilitated, disoriented, abnormal behavior, or dead seabirds on beaches and coastal areas. Recently, people attempting to help by offering water, touching, or handling birds have created risks to human health and potential spread of infectious agents. Birds use the Alagoas coast as a resting spot after long migrations and may appear exhausted, injured, or ill, requiring specialized veterinary attention. Do not touch, pick up, or handle birds; even if you previously contacted the animal, report to authorities for proper guidance. There has been no registered avian influenza H5N1 in Alagoas this year, but surveillance continues. Contact IMA/AL Fauna Management Office at (82) 98867-6515 or Biota Conservation Institute at (82) 99115-2944. The agency supports an emergency plan for prevention, rapid response, and wildlife and public protection.

triage.headline_ja: IMA、渡航期間中のウミドリとの接触回避を国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアラゴアス州でH5N1鳥インフルエンザの公衆衛生警告が発出されているが、同地域では今年登録された症例がなく、情報不足のため段階的な監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はH5N1の予防警告であり、アラゴアス州では今年確認症例なし。ただしウミドリの渡航期間（4-9月）における長期曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念、および公式な公衆衛生警告の発出により、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。情報が限定的であるため、継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: മൂവാറ്റുപുഴയിൽ 13 പേരെ കടിച്ച നായയ്ക്ക് പേ വിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ട സാഹചര്യമില്ലെന്ന് ഡോക്ടർമാർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Muvattupuzha, the dog that bit 13 people has tested positive for rabies; doctors say there is no need to panic.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a Muvattupuzha dog that bit 13 people in Ernakulam district, Kerala. The dog, which bit 13 individuals, tested positive for rabies in a post-mortem examination. Authorities say there is no need to panic because all the bite victims had already received the first dose of the rabies vaccine. Following the dog’s death, the Muvattupuzha municipality held an emergency meeting to assess the situation and determine next steps. The report highlights ongoing post-exposure vaccination for exposed individuals and prompts review of exposure sources and public health measures. The incident is the latest in Ernakulam, prompting public health scrutiny as of 2026-04-27.

triage.headline_ja: ムバットゥプーザで13人を咬んだ犬が狂犬病陽性と確認。医者は「パニックになる必要はない」と述べている
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な地域での単一の動物由来狂犬病事例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的な拡大リスクは低い。ただし、複数の咬傷被害者が存在し、予防接種対応が進行中のため、継続的な経過観察が妥当である。
triage.notes: インド・ケーララ州ムバットゥプーザ地域での単一の動物（野良犬）からの狂犬病確認事例。13名の咬傷被害者全員が既に第1回目のワクチン接種を完了しており、その後の継続的なワクチン接種が実施されている。地元自治体が対応を進めており、地域的な公衆衛生措置が取られている。国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクは現在のところ認識されない。

article.articleHeadline: VIDEO SAKSI KATA Anjing Rabies Sangat Brutal dan Menyerang Siapa Saja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: Witness Says Rabid Dogs Are Very Brutal and Attack Anyone.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreaks linked to stray dogs have been reported in Bireuen Regency, Aceh, Indonesia. Rabid dogs exhibit drastic behavioral changes, becoming highly aggressive, foaming at the mouth, having a hoarse bark, and avoiding sunlight. The first incident occurred in Buket Teukuh, Juang District, with three victims. Subsequent cases were reported in Balee Panah and Pante, Seuneubok Peuraden, and Seulembah in Jeumpa District. A man named Iskandar was attacked by a stray dog and shared his experience with Serambi News on April 21, 2026, in the program Saksi Kata. The report notes multiple locations and ongoing concerns but does not mention laboratory confirmation or infection sources, focusing on eyewitness accounts and local awareness of the rabies risk in these areas.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：目撃者が言う 狂犬病犬は非常に凶暴で誰にでも襲いかかると
