triage.notes: 記事サマリーはビルウエン県アチェ州インドネシアでの狂犬病アウトブレイクについて明確に述べており、複数の被害者（少なくとも3名）と複数地域での報告がある。ただし、ラボ確認や公式な感染源情報は記載されていない。野良犬が媒体として特定されており、ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく動物からの感染という特性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Biryani, watermelon under probe after 4 deaths in Mumbai
article.articleSummary: Mumbai, India: Four members of a family died in a suspected food-poisoning event in the Pydhonie area. The victims are a 40-year-old man, his 35-year-old wife, and their two daughters, aged 16 and 13. Nine relatives had dinner together on the night of April 25 around 10:30 pm; the four who died returned home and reportedly ate watermelon around 1:00–1:30 am on April 26. By early morning, from 5:30 to 6:00 am, the family began experiencing severe vomiting and diarrhoea and were taken to JJ Hospital after initial treatment by a family doctor. Post-mortem examinations have been conducted, but the final cause of death will be confirmed only after histopathological reports are received. The investigation is ongoing; laboratory confirmation of a specific pathogen has yet to be reported.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでの4人死亡後、ビリヤニとスイカが調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の食中毒疑い事案で死亡例4件と重症度は懸念されるが、現段階では病原体確認がなく、地域限定的（単一家族）で国際的拡大リスクが明確でない。続報と病原体確認を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑い事案で4人の死亡が報告されている。現段階では病原体が特定されておらず、ヒストパシオロジー検査報告待ちの状態。事案は単一家族に限定されており、コミュニティ内での流行兆候は報告されていない。病原体確認後の再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à malária ganha reforço com ampliação de testes e novos tratamentos - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against malaria gets a boost with expanded testing and new treatments - News Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day (April 25), Porto Velho, Brazil, reinforced malaria control focusing on early diagnosis and proper treatment. From January 1 to April 24, 2026, the city recorded 1,001 malaria cases, a 10% rise from the same period in 2025, based on more than 15,000 diagnostic tests this year. Plasmodium vivax accounts for 912 cases, Plasmodium falciparum 86, and three mixed infections. Highest concentrations are in Santa Helena, Bairro Novo, and Terra Santa. The network expanded radical cure with tafenoquine; 516 patients received the drug in 2026, with G6PD testing for safety. Symptoms include fever, chills, and body pains. Care is available at UPAs Sul, Leste, and Cepem. Malaria services operate at 30 health posts across districts including Nova Califórnia and União Bandeirante. Semusa advises repellents, bed nets, and yard cleanliness to reduce vector breeding; Mayor Léo Moraes calls for continued action in Amazon-endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアとの戦いは検査拡大と新しい治療法で強化される - News Rondônia
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ポルトベーロ市でマラリア症例が10%増加している地域的な公衆衛生上の関心事項であるが、IHR基準を満たす国際的危機的要件が明確でなく、情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ポルトベーロ市では前年同期比10%のマラリア症例増加を記録。アマゾン地域の流行地域での継続的な対策が必要とされているが、致死的な重症例や国際的拡大の報告はない。地域的な公衆衛生対応は機能しており、市当局による検査拡大と新規治療薬（タフェノキン）導入など管理対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Servidores recebem orientações sobre a Doença de Chagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public servants receive guidance on Chagas disease.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil: Semusa-led educational talk strengthens Chagas disease prevention among municipal workers. Doença de Chagas is caused by Trypanosoma cruzi; early symptoms include fever, malaise, loss of appetite, and hepatosplenomegaly, potentially persisting up to 12 weeks; advanced disease can involve palpitations, dyspnea, edema, chest pain, and abdominal symptoms. Transmission is mainly vectorial via the triatomine kissing bug (barbeiro), with transfusion, organ transplant, vertical, and accidental laboratory exposure also possible. Emphasis on laboratory-based early diagnosis and treatment. Preventive measures include avoiding unsafe foods such as açaí and unverified sugarcane juice; keeping homes clean, sealing cracks, and limiting animals that may feed the vector. If an insect is found, do not kill it; use gloves or a sealed bag and contact DPDZE via WhatsApp 69 98473-8041 with a photo, or deliver to Avenida Mamoré 1120, Cascalheira, or request home collection. Leadership stresses ongoing vigilance and education.

triage.headline_ja: 公務員がシャーガス病予防についての指導を受ける
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病はブラジルで蔓延している既知の地方病であり、本記事は啓発・教育イベントに関するもので、新規の異常な流行や重症化の報告ではない。情報が限定的なため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル北部ロンドニア州ポルト・ベーリョでの公務員向け啓発講座に関するもの。シャーガス病はブラジルにおいて既知の風土病であり、新規感染症発生ではない。政府による予防啓発活動を示しているが、新たな流行の増加や管理不能な状況を示唆する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: How to safely eat watermelons: Lessons to learn after family of 4 dies in Mumbai due to suspected food poisoning from watermelon
article.articleSummary: Watermelon-linked suspected food poisoning killed a Mumbai family of four: Abdullah Abdul Kadar (40), his wife Nasreen (35), and daughters Aayesha (16) and Zainab (13). The four reportedly ate watermelon after dinner on April 25; Zainab died at 10:15 am, and Abdullah Kadar about 10:30 pm that day, with the other two succumbing later. A post-mortem has been conducted and histopathology results are pending; investigators have registered an accidental death case and are continuing the probe. The incident underscores how melons can carry pathogens at multiple stages—from field to handling—especially if the rind is damaged. Pathogens linked to such cases include Salmonella, E. coli, norovirus, and Listeria, with symptoms ranging from stomach pain to vomiting. Preventive steps include avoiding damaged melons, washing the rind before cutting, using a clean knife and board, refrigerating cut fruit at ≤4°C, and buying from reliable sellers; the investigation is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでスイカによる食中毒で家族4人が死亡：安全なスイカの食べ方に関する教訓
triage.triage_reason: 複数の病原体（ノロウイルス、パラチフス、リステリア、チフス、大腸菌）に関連した食中毒イベントで、4人の死亡が確認されており、公衆衛生上の影響が重大かつ異常である。対象国インドでの発生であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ムンバイの家族4人（40歳、35歳、16歳、13歳）がスイカを食べた後に死亡し、複数の病原体が検出されている食中毒事例。死後検査が行われており、組織病理学的結果待ち。公衆衛生調査が進行中。インド内での食品安全に関する重要な事例として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados tem nova morte suspeita por chikungunya e mais de 2,4 mil casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados reports a new suspected chikungunya-related death and more than 2,400 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports a new suspected death as of 27 April 2026. The city now records eight total chikungunya deaths, with three suspected; the newest is a 50-year-old white man who delayed seeking care. Two other deaths under investigation are an 84-year-old white man and a 12-year-old Indigenous boy. Dourados also reports 2,468 confirmed cases and 2,705 suspected under investigation, from a total 5,173 probable cases (down from 5,218). Vaccination against arboviruses is set to begin in Dourados on Monday, following the state's receipt of 20,000 doses on 16 April. In Mato Grosso do Sul overall, chikungunya has surpassed 7,700 cases (confirmed and suspected) and 13 deaths, representing about 70.6% of the state's 2025 chikungunya fatalities (17).

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスで新たなチクングニア疑い死亡例が報告され、2,400件以上の確認症例が記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマットグロッソド南州でチクングニアの重篤な流行が進行中。死亡例（確認8件、疑い例を含む）、高い症例数（5,173件の可能性がある症例）、ワクチン接種開始という対応が進行中。IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生への影響およびWPRO基準の重症度・管理可能性に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマットグロッソド南州ドゥラードスにおけるチクングニア流行を報告。死亡例が8件（確認）で、最新の死亡例は4月27日に報告された。州全体では7,700件超の症例と13死亡が記録されている。ワクチン接種がすでに開始予定となっており、地域当局の対応が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: Feriados de Outono e viagens com pets: MSD Saúde Animal alerta para o risco de carrapatos e pulgas fora de casa - Portal Pet News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autumn holidays and trips with pets: MSD Animal Health warns about the risk of ticks and fleas outdoors - Portal Pet News.
article.articleSummary: Autumn holidays in Brazil boost short trips with pets, increasing exposure of dogs and cats to fleas and ticks in unfamiliar outdoor environments. Parasites during travel can transmit serious diseases, notably ehrlichiosis and babesiosis, and a single hitchhiking tick or flea can reinfest a home after returning. Ticks are resilient, hiding in car trunks or transport crates for weeks. Five key recommendations: (1) update the pet’s protection against fleas and ticks before travel; (2) conduct a thorough post-trip check, focusing on tick-prone areas like between toes, behind ears, under the abdomen; (3) hygienize the transport and vehicle to prevent reinfestation; (4) ensure collective protection in shared accommodations, as unprotected pets can serve as reservoirs; (5) opt for long-acting solutions such as MSD’s Bravecto line, including BRAVECTO 365, to maintain coverage during travel and stay and minimize parasite carriage home.

triage.headline_ja: 秋の休暇とペットとの旅行：MSD動物保健がダニとノミの屋外リスク警告 - ポータルペットニュース
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生上の発生イベントではなく、MSDの製品啓発・予防キャンペーン記事である。実際の感染症患者の増加報告や異常事態の発生ではなく、季節的なリスク周知と予防製品の推奨であり、IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでのペット旅行時期（秋の休暇）におけるダニとノミのリスクに関する啓発・予防メッセージである。エーリキア症とバベシア症は提及されるが、実際の症例報告や感染症の異常発生ではなく、動物医薬品企業による季節的な公衆衛生キャンペーンである。感染症シグナルとしてはピックアップの対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya avança e MS lidera casos no país - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya spreads and Mato Grosso do Sul leads in cases nationwide - Boca do Povo News.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya continues its rapid spread in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reaching about 7,500 cases (confirmed and suspected) as the 2026 peak unfolds, accounting for more than half of all 2025 records. The state has recorded 13 deaths this year, predominantly among the elderly and children, and exhibits the highest disease incidence in the country. Vaccination depends on new vaccine doses from the Ministry of Health; Itaporã and Dourados have begun administering the currently available doses. Secretary Maurício Simões says teams are being trained and that the worst of the growth curve may have passed, though the outbreak remains a warning. The fast progression also raises concerns for the agricultural sector, impacting rural workers. Authorities urge vigilance and seeking medical care for symptoms for diagnosis and treatment via the SUS.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアが拡大、マットグロッソドスル州が国内の症例数でリード
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州におけるチクングニアの急速な拡大イベント。7,500例以上の患者発生、13名の死亡、急速な流行曲線、予防接種の需要増加など、複数の重度の影響指標が認められ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の両方で複数該当。フルのRapid Risk Assessmentに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルのマットグロッソドスル州におけるチクングニアの急速な蔓延を主題としている。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域情報（Itaporã、Mato Grosso do Sul、Brazil）は正確。ただしIHR国際拡大基準および渡航・貿易制限リスク基準については、現時点で記事に明記されていないため「不明」と評価した。農業部門への影響言及あり。2026年の流行ピークであることが記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Após pico, levantamento aponta tendência de queda de casos de chikungunya em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the peak, a survey points to a downward trend in chikungunya cases in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul shows a downward trend after peaking in week 12 at 1,195 notifications; by week 17, 46 cases were reported, with week 16 at 857; week 10 rose from 359 to 800. As of 2026-04-27, the State Health Secretariat notes high test-positivity but falling case numbers; cautions about chronic disease progression and persistent pain requiring long-term care. In Dourados, where a state of emergency was declared, 15 dedicated chikungunya clinical beds were provided; occupancy never exceeded 10. Preventive measures must continue; vaccination depends on the Ministry of Health as the vaccine is still experimental, and current vaccination coverage data are unavailable. No municipal funding requests related to chikungunya have been reported. Health authorities are training professionals in management of chronic cases.

triage.headline_ja: ピーク後、マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でのチクングニア症例の減少傾向を示す調査
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの症例数は第12週のピーク（1,195件）から第17週には46件へと急速に減少しており、流行終息局面にある。重大な国際的拡大リスク、管理可能性の課題、または異常な事象は認められない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示す発生地域はBrazil（3469034）であるが、対象国リストにBrazilは含まれていない（対象国：Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）。記事内容はマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州（ブラジル国内）での症例減少トレンドの報告であり、流行の後退段階を示している。ワクチン接種は試験段階であるとの記載があるが、現在の緊急的なリスクを示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Epicentro da doença em MS, Dourados inicia vacinação contra a chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epicenter of the disease in Mato Grosso do Sul, Dourados begins vaccination against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: On 27 April 2026, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, began a chikungunya vaccination campaign in UBSs and the PAM, aiming to immunize at least 27% of the target population (~43,000 people). The vaccine, developed by Valneva with Instituto Butantan, is a single-dose shot for adults 18–59 without comorbidities; exclusions include pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, recent transplants, autoimmune diseases, certain chronic conditions, fever, or recent vaccination. Vaccination hours are 7–11 and 13–17 at most units; Seleta and Santo André extend 18–22, with some posts open 12–22 on weekends/holidays. A drive-thru vaccination is planned for Friday, 1 May, 8–12. MS received 46,500 doses; 43,500 to Dourados, 3,000 to Itaporã. Mato Grosso do Sul leads chikungunya nationwide in 2026 (259.4 cases/100,000; ~17× national average of 15), with 19 deaths in Brazil, 13 in MS (8 in Dourados, 2 Jardim, 1 Bonito, 1 Fátima do Sul).

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州の流行中心地ドウラードス、チクングニア熱のワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニア熱が異常な高い発生率で拡大中（全国平均の17倍）で、13名の死亡者が報告されている。州レベルでの緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始という事象から、重症度・異常性・管理可能性の複数基準に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ブラジル（特にマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）で2026年にチクングニア熱が異常な流行状況を呈している。全国平均比17倍の発生率、19名の死亡者（MS州13名）が報告されており、当局による緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始という対応が行われている。記事サマリーはポルトガル語原文から抽出。

article.articleHeadline: ViroClube promove palestra sobre o negligenciamento da malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virology Club Hosts Lecture on the Neglect of Malaria
article.articleSummary: On 27 April 2026, the Virology Club presents a lecture by Marycelin Baba of the University of Maiduguri, Nigeria, a leading expert in medical virology. Baba, who helped identify West Nile virus in patients initially treated for common malaria, uses the talk to address what she calls the neglect of malaria research relative to arboviruses such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The lecture emphasizes diagnostic and surveillance gaps, highlighting how malaria-like symptoms can obscure viral infections and hinder timely treatment. It advocates renewed scientific attention to malaria biology and public health strategies, integrating lessons from arbovirus research to improve detection and management of malaria. The report emphasizes the ongoing discussion within the Jornal da USP community.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス部会がマラリアの軽視に関する講演会を開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は大学での学術講演会に関する報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクやクラスターを報告するものではない。診断・サーベイランスギャップに関する議論は重要だが、具体的な症例数、死亡、国際的な拡大リスク等の情報がなく、公衆衛生上の直接的な緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州リベイラン・プレト市の大学（Jornal da USP）における学術講演会の告知であり、ナイジェリアの専門家による講演内容の紹介。実際の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、患者増加、死亡等）を報告していない。マラリア研究の軽視とサーベイランスギャップについての指摘は重要だが、シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: No Dia Mundial de Luta contra a Malária, governo de RO destaca avanços no controle da doença no estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On World Malaria Day, the government of Rondônia highlights advances in malaria control in the state.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day (April 25), the government of Rondônia, Brazil, highlights advances in malaria control across the state, with emphasis on Porto Velho. Agevisa/RO coordinates integrated actions, including epidemiological surveillance, professional capacity-building, and expanded access to diagnosis and treatment. A key advance is tafenoquine, a single-dose antimalarial that reduces relapses and interrupts transmission, strengthening population protection. Pedro Magalhães, head of Environmental Surveillance at Agevisa/RO, notes results reflect coordinated work among state, municipalities, and the federal government. The strategy prioritizes early diagnosis, timely treatment, and targeted interventions in areas with higher transmission, contributing to a reduction in cases. The report underscores ongoing efforts to improve prevention, diagnostics, and care, without reporting specific case counts in the update.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア対策世界デーに、ロンドニア州政府が州内の疾病管理の進展を強調
triage.triage_reason: マラリア対策の進展を報告するポジティブなニュースであり、新規の発生やアウトブレイクではない。具体的な症例数、死亡、入院の報告がなく、異常性や予期しない事象も認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア対策の進展と政策成功を報告する公式発表であり、感染症の新規検知またはアウトブレイクシグナルではない。世界マラリアデーのキャンペーン関連記事として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Hay casos de Leishmaniasis en el área urbana de Santa Cruz y estas son las 7 cosas que debés saber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are cases of Leishmaniasis in the urban area of Santa Cruz, and these are the 7 things you should know.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis cases have been confirmed in the urban Santa Cruz area, notably Cotoca and Plan Tres Mil, with at least 14 confirmed canine cases in Cotoca. Transmission occurs via sandflies carrying Leishmania donovani; there is no human-to-human spread. In humans, the illness most commonly causes cutaneous leishmaniasis—skin ulcers on the arms, legs, or face that can progress to mucosal involvement; visceral and mucocutaneous forms occur less frequently. The sandfly vector favors rural, forested areas; in Santa Cruz transmission is concentrated near the Brazil border (Germán Busch province and the Chiquitania). Incubation is prolonged, and lesions may appear long after a bite. Treatment is long and requires hospitalization, using pentavalent antimonials for 20 days, e.g., at Hospital de Jorochito. Bolivia’s Ministry of Health estimates about 2,100 new cases annually, mostly cutaneous.

triage.headline_ja: サンタクルスの市街地にリーシュマニア症の患者がおり、知っておくべき7つのこと
triage.triage_reason: リーシュマニア症は予想外に市街地で確認されており、犬での感染が複数確認されているが、人間への深刻な影響の証拠や国際的拡大の差し迫ったリスクは現時点で明確でない。追加情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はボリビアのサンタクルス地域におけるリーシュマニア症のアウトブレイクであるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ（ブラジルとの国境近くでの伝播が言及されている）。ボリビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみ。市街地での犬での症例確認は異常であり、サンドフライ媒介による長期曝露リスク、流行性の可能性があるため、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当。ただし人間への深刻な影響の現在の証拠が限定的であり、詳細な続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Guaíba registra o menor número de casos de dengue em sete anos; Brasil tem queda de 75%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guaíba records the lowest number of dengue cases in seven years; Brazil posts a 75% decline.
article.articleSummary: Lowest dengue activity in Guaíba, Brazil, with only 1 confirmed case Jan–Apr 2026, down from 14 in the same period 2025; through epidemiological week 14, Guaíba had 20 discarded and four under investigation. In 2024, Guaíba recorded 97 dengue cases, the worst in Rio Grande do Sul and Brazil; 2025 had 84; 2023, 23; 2022, 19; the previous year, 1. Rio Grande do Sul's first dengue death in 2026 occurred on April 23—an 83-year-old woman with comorbidities from Jacutinga—highlighting ongoing transmission. Statewide, RS reports 596 confirmed dengue cases and 1 death in 2026; up to week 15 in 2025 RS had 20,573 cases and 13 deaths; in 2024: 209,669 cases, 281 deaths; in 2025: 52,794 cases, 53 deaths. Brazil's dengue cases in early 2026 fell 75% versus 2025; improvement attributed to coordinated actions, expanded ovitrap use (1,600 municipalities, targeting 2,000), and SUS vaccination since 2024 for ages 10–14.

triage.headline_ja: ガイーバがデング熱の7年来最低の件数を記録。ブラジルは75%の減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の件数が過去7年で最低水準に低下しており、これは改善傾向（positive trend）を示している。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。社会的・政治的関心も健全な疾病管理の成功例であり、危機シグナルとしては不該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルのデング熱は2026年初期で2025年比75%減少。記事はガイーバ地域で2026年1月〜4月に確認例1件と過去最低を記録しており、公衆衛生対策の成功を報告している。これは周辺監視による健全な報告であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Município recebe selo nacional por boas práticas no combate à malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipality receives national seal for best practices in malaria control.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil – Porto Velho, the state capital, is among five Rondônia municipalities awarded the Bronze Seal of Good Practices toward Malaria Elimination by the Ministry of Health, presented during ExpoEpi 2026 in Brasília. The other recipients are Candeias do Jamari, Guajará-Mirim, Itapuã do Oeste, and Cujubim. The recognition supports Brazil’s national plan to eliminate malaria by 2035. The Bronze Seal signals initial milestones: reduced malaria case numbers, expanded diagnostic access, and rapid treatment initiation. In practice, health teams perform rapid diagnostic tests, begin treatment upon confirmation, and monitor each patient, alongside vector-control measures and population guidance. The initiative highlights frontline actions in Porto Velho and surrounding municipalities to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 自治体がマラリア対策における優れた実践に対して全国表彰を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア対策における成功事例の表彰で、新規の公衆衛生危機を示すシグナルではなく、ブラジルの進捗報告である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規感染症イベントではなく、ブラジルにおけるマラリア対策の成功を表彰する報道。発生地域がRondônia州（ポルトベーリョ等）に複数列挙されているが、これはマラリア排除への取り組みが成功している事例を示しており、拡大する危機的シグナルではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Magisterial inquiry ordered into rabies death case in WGH
article.articleSummary: An 11-year-old girl, Netera Sangma, from Dadenggre in West Garo Hills died while reportedly denied treatment for a suspected rabies case. She was referred from Dadenggre CHC to Tura Civil Hospital, then to Holy Cross Hospital, both of which allegedly refused admission citing lack of beds. She died in an ambulance while returning home. West Garo Hills Deputy Commissioner Vibhor Aggarwal has ordered a magisterial inquiry after Dadenggre MLA Rupa M. Marak sought action. The complaint, filed by social activist Greneth Sangma with the district DC, alleges medical negligence and seeks accountability of the Tura Civil Hospital and Holy Cross Hospital for denying care. The activist framed the incident as a violation of Article 21 (Right to Life).

triage.headline_ja: WGH（ウェスト・ガロ・ヒルズ）のペストケース死亡事件に対する司法審査を命令
triage.triage_reason: インド・メガラヤ州での単一のペスト死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは現在のところ低い。ただし医療アクセス問題に関連した社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: 単一事例の死亡であり、感染症クラスターや流行の兆候は記事に見当たらない。ウェスト・ガロ・ヒルズ地区での医療施設の入院受け入れ問題や医療アクセス格差が基本的な問題であり、ペスト自体の公衆衛生リスクではない。社会的・政治的関心は高い（司法審査命令、人権問題として提起）が、感染症危機管理の観点からの継続監視対象とはならない可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue crescem e acendem alerta  - O Diário Interativo Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Cases Rise and Trigger an Alert.
article.articleSummary: Dengue notifications reach 1,270 in the municipality from January 1 to April 27, 2026; 124 confirmed, 1,047 discarded, and 99 awaiting laboratory results. No dengue-related deaths have been reported. One patient is hospitalized—a 27-year-old man at Santa Casa. Monthly counts up to April 24 show 1,252 notifications, with March leading at 514, followed by April (350), February (212), and January (176). Among confirmed dengue cases, March shows the highest number (59), with April at 33, January 18, February 14. Other arboviruses present: chikungunya with 48 notifications and 2 positives (9 under investigation); Zika virus with 4 notifications, all discarded. The data indicate an ongoing dengue outbreak alert in the municipality, with the majority of tests pending and a single hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱感染者が増加し警告が発令される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でデング熱、チクングニア、ジカ熱の複数のアルボウイルス感染症が同時発生。デング熱は4ヶ月間で1,270件の通知があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確で、地域での流行状況を示す異常事象である。IHR基準2項目以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のブラジル自治体（市）でのデング熱の局所的な流行を報告。複数のアルボウイルス（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ熱）が同時に発生しており、124件の確認事例があり、未検査の1,047件が検査待ち。入院患者が1名報告されている。3月が514件の通知でピークとなっており、明らかな季節的流行パターンが示唆される。公式な「警告」（alerta）が発令されていることから地域当局による認識がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pedalando Contra a Dengue reúne moradores e reforça prevenção em Sidrolândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pedaling Against Dengue Brings Together Residents and Reinforces Prevention in Sidrolândia.
article.articleSummary: 500 residents participated in Pedalando Contra a Dengue in Sidrolândia, Brazil, on Sunday to curb Aedes aegypti, the transmitter of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The event, organized by the City Hall in partnership with Rádio Pindorama Jota FM and with support from the Câmara Municipal, began at 7:30 a.m. in front of the São Bento gym and rode through neighborhoods to Brizolão, where 20 bicycles and other prizes were raffled. The Busão da Alegria accompanied the route to engage children and families and emphasized keeping yards clean and eliminating standing water to prevent mosquito breeding. Mayor Rodrigo Basso, First Lady Valéria Basso, Vice Mayor Chris Fiúza, and Health Secretary Vanessa Prado attended along with Vigilância em Saúde teams. City leaders highlighted preventive, community-driven action and the need to sustain efforts against dengue.

triage.headline_ja: ペダリング・アゲインスト・デング：シドロランディアで住民が集結し予防活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防啓発イベントの報道であり、疾患の発生件数の増加、重症者の増加、または医療システムの危機を示す具体的な証拠がない。IHR基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジル・シドロランディアで実施された予防啓発キャンペーンであり、デング、チクングニア、ジカウイルスの媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の対策に焦点を当てた地域活動の報道である。疾患の流行状況を示す具体的な患者数、死亡数、医療逼迫の報告がないため、シグナルとしては識別されない。

article.articleHeadline: População de Dourados (MS) começa a receber vacina contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Population of Dourados (MS) begins to receive Chikungunya vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination begins in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, amid an outbreak that led the city to declare a health emergency. The campaign targets residents aged 18–59, with a drive-thru dose on May 1, 2026, from 8:00 to 12:00 at the City Hall courtyard. The aim is to immunize about 43,000 people (roughly 27% of the target population). The Ministry of Health’s Arboviroses Monitoring Panel reports 2,621 chikungunya cases in 2026 in Dourados, with eight deaths and one under review. Nearly 60% of cases affect Indigenous people; 21.3% White; 18% Black or mixed-race. The vaccine cannot be given to those who had chikungunya in the last 30 days, those with a severe febrile state, or those who recently received other vaccines (attenuated last 28 days; inactivated last 14 days). Anvisa approved it in April 2025; about 20 municipalities in six states are included in the rollout.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードス市（マットグロッソ・ド・スル州）の住民がチクングニヤワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニヤ集団発生に対するワクチン接種キャンペーンが展開中。2026年に2,621例の発症と8例の死亡が報告されており、重症度が高く、健康上の緊急事態宣言も出されている。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく、本トリアージはAMRO（アメリカ地域）のシグナルです。記事サマリーから確認された要素：(1)進行中の集団発生（2,621例、8死亡）、(2)健康上の緊急事態の宣言、(3)公式なワクチン接種キャンペーン展開、(4)特に先住民族で高い罹患率（60%）。スクリーニング基準において重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさの3項目が該当し、政府と公衆の関心も高いため、PICKUP判定としました。

article.articleHeadline: Dr Boreham's Crucible: Friendlier markets lead the way for Firebrick's respiratory virus killer | Stockhead
article.articleSummary: Nasodine, Firebrick Pharma’s antiseptic nasal spray based on povidone-iodine (PVP-I), aims to kill known respiratory viruses including Covid-19, RSV, and seasonal/pandemic coronaviruses. In 2020 Firebrick sought TGA approval, but the regulator reportedly did not want a product that could reduce vaccine uptake; after an Administrative Appeals Tribunal challenge, the effort was abandoned. Now Firebrick pivots to offshore markets, targeting Singapore, the Philippines, Indonesia and the US; Singapore’s Health Sciences Authority has deemed Nasodine an antiseptic, not requiring full approval. The Philippines, via Pharma Nutria, has filed for OTC approval, and Fiji markets the product. Nasodine combines povidone and iodine (PVP-I); patents cover use and formulation, though PVP-I has been off-patent since 1976. Administer at first signs of a cold; early use may speed relief.

triage.headline_ja: ドクター・ボアハムの坩堝：ファイアブリック社の呼吸器ウイルス対策製品がアジア太平洋地域での展開を進める
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はファイアブリック・ファーマの医薬品製品（Nasodine）の商業展開に関する記事であり、感染症の流行・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。公衆衛生上の新規イベント、疾病の異常な発生、深刻な患者転帰等の記載がなく、感染症管理シグナルの対象外である。
triage.notes: 本記事は医薬品製品の規制承認・市場展開に関する商業ニュースであり、感染症イベント報告ではない。言及されているCOVID-19およびRSVは製品の対象疾患として述べられているのみであり、新規の疾病発生またはアウトブレイクの報告ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bronquiolite, que causou internação da filha de Maíra Cardi, matou 44 pessoas em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bronchiolitis, which caused Maíra Cardi's daughter's hospitalization, killed 44 people in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Brazil, 2026: bronchiolitis driven by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prompts 3,488 RSV-related severe acute respiratory illness hospitalizations through April 18, with 2,827 under 2 years and 44 deaths (26 under 2). This year’s toll compares to 2025 Jan–Apr: 5,816 hospitalizations and 33 deaths (19 under 2). RSV accounts for about 75% of bronchiolitis cases and ~40% of pneumonias in children under 2. Six‑month‑old Eloah was hospitalized for bronchiolitis. Symptoms include persistent cough, high fever, wheeze, dyspnea, poor feeding, dehydration; cyanosis indicates severity. There is no virus-specific therapy; management is supportive (oxygen, hydration; bronchodilators used in some cases). Vaccination: SUS offers nirsevimabe for eligible preterm infants up to 23 months with comorbidities; Abrysvo vaccine for pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation to protect newborns at birth. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: bronchiolitis, which caused Maíra Cardi's daughter's hospitalization, killed 44 people in 2026
triage.triage_reason: RSV関連の重症下気道炎により2026年4月までに44人の死亡（2歳未満が26人）と3,488人の入院が報告されており、IHR基準の公衆衛生への深刻な影響と重症度の観点から、またWPRO基準の重症度（死亡・入院多数）および長期曝露（乳幼児への継続的な曝露）に該当する。社会的関心も著名人の子どもの入院報道により高い。
triage.notes: RSVは2歳未満の乳幼児に対して重症化リスクが高く、死亡率・入院率が高い。記事にはワクチン対策（SUS提供のnirsevimab、Abrysvo）の言及があり、公衆衛生対応が進行中。2025年同時期（1-4月）との比較では入院数は減少（5,816→3,488）だが死亡数は増加（33→44）しており、重症度の増加に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta para risco de contaminação por Sarampo durante a Copa do Mundo - Super Rádio Tupi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of risk of measles transmission during the World Cup - Super Rádio Tupi
article.articleSummary: Measles risk: Brazil's Health Ministry warns of possible reintroduction and spread during June's World Cup, hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico, where outbreaks are ongoing. Notice highlights high measles transmissibility in the Americas, with many Brazilians traveling to host nations. It urges vaccination for travelers and residents, given active outbreaks in host countries. Pediatric infectious disease expert Denise Cotrim says measles is highly contagious, with about a 90% attack rate; in a room of 10 unvaccinated people, 9–10 may become infected. Vaccination coverage above 95% creates herd immunity, reducing outbreak risk, including when travellers arrive. Travelers should check MMR vaccine doses; on returning with fever and red rash, seek healthcare promptly. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease spread via airborne droplets. Brazil has been free of endemic transmission since 2024; two imported cases this year: São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; the latter a 22-year-old hotel employee.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が2026年ワールドカップ中の麻疹感染リスクについて警告 - スーパーラジオ図比
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年以降風土病的感染がないが、今年2件の輸入例（São Paulo、Rio de Janeiro）が報告された。ワールドカップ開催国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）での流行と、大量の渡航者がブラジルへの麻疹再侵入のリスクを高める。麻疹は極めて伝染力が強く（非接種者での攻撃率約90%）、ワールドカップという大規模集会イベントでの拡大リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: População de Dourados (MS) começa a receber vacina contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Population of Dourados (MS) begins to receive Chikungunya vaccine
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-27, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, began vaccinating residents against chikungunya. About 60% of past cases in the municipality occurred among Indigenous people, 21.3% among White residents, and 18% among Black and Pardo (mixed-race) individuals. The chikungunya vaccine cannot be given to: pregnant or lactating individuals; those on high-dose immunosuppressants; congenital immunodeficiency; cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy or radiotherapy; solid organ transplant recipients; bone marrow transplant recipients within two years; people with HIV/AIDS; autoimmune diseases such as lupus or rheumatoid arthritis; and individuals with at least two chronic conditions (including diabetes, hypertension, heart failure, arrhythmias, chronic lung or kidney disease, obesity, chronic liver disease, and cancer in treatment or remission). It also excludes those who had chikungunya in the last 30 days; those with severe fever; those who recently received a live-attenuated vaccine (within 28 days); and those who received an inactivated-virus vaccine (within 14 days). The rollout is expected to be slower since recipients must be evaluated by a health professional before dosing.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラドス市（MS州）の住民がチクングニアワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアワクチンの接種キャンペーン実施に関する記事であり、新規感染症イベントではなく、公衆衛生対応措置の報告である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はチクングニアワクチンキャンペーンの実施報告であり、新規感染症イベント（発生・流行）ではない。過去の感染統計と予防接種対象者の制限基準に関する情報提供が主である。シグナルトリアージの対象外として判定。

article.articleHeadline: Em Dourados, Aldeia Bororó ganha unidade móvel para reforçar combate à chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Dourados, Bororó Indigenous Village gains a mobile health unit to reinforce the fight against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak response strengthens health access in Bororó Indigenous Village, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, with a mobile Primary Health Care Unit inaugurated on April 25, 2026, for a 90-day deployment. The unit acts as a fixed point inside the village, supported by Multidisciplinary Indigenous Health Teams, expanding access to consultations, exams, and vaccination during the epidemic. The initiative accompanies the start of a vaccination campaign and reinforces local care within the territory, backed by the Hospital Universitário da Universidade Federal da Grande Dourados (HU-UFGD) and the SUS network. The mobile unit offers medical consultations, laboratory specimen collection including chikungunya screening, routine immunizations, rapid STI tests, glucose testing, prenatal and pediatric follow-up, nutritional surveillance, and chronic disease management (diabetes, hypertension). The crew comprises one doctor, one nurse, three nursing technicians, and one nutritionist.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアラードスのボロロ先住民村、チクングニア対策強化のための移動保健ユニットを設置
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア流行は確認されるが、本記事は保健対応・医療施設の強化に関する施策報道であり、新規感染者数、死亡例、または流行拡大の加速を示す疫学的データがない。シグナルの段階を超えた情報不足により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の流行地域における保健体制整備の報道。ドゥアラードス（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）はブラジルの対象国リストに含まれるため Brazil として verified_locations に記載。流行の重症度や患者数に関する具体的な情報が欠落しており、純粋な対応強化の記事となっている。チクングニアの長期曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行促進性（epidemic_prone）は確認されるが、IHR基準には該当せず、WPRO基準でも情報不足のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Instan a mantener medidas preventivas contra el Mpox en las Américas - Noticias Prensa Latina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urges maintenance of preventive measures against Mpox in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) prevention urged across the Americas. In 2025 (EW 1–53), 16 countries reported 5,774 laboratory-confirmed Mpox cases and 9 deaths; Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, United States, Guatemala, Honduras, Jamaica, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, and Peru accounted for the burden. The OPS notes almost all cases are clade IIb, with sustained transmission mainly via sexual contact as the principal driver, concentrated in five countries—United States, Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile (about 91% of regional cases in 2025). In 2026 (EW 1–12), ten countries recorded 801 confirmed cases and 1 death: Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, United States, Mexico, Peru. Globally, Jan 2022–Mar 31, 2026: 181,164 cases and 492 deaths in 144 WHO Member States; Jan–Feb 2026: 2,794 cases and 8 deaths. Over the past year, monthly cases declined, largely due to reduced reporting in Africa and the Americas.

triage.headline_ja: 米州地域でのMpox（サル痘）に対する予防措置の維持を強調
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。多国間での継続的な感染確認とクレード IIb による性的接触を通じた持続的な伝播が報告されており、シグナルとして適切にピックアップする。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに多数の非対象国が含まれているが、記事サマリーに基づいて検証した結果、対象国リスト内では Brazil のみが実際のイベント発生地として確認された。米州全体での疫学的状況報告であるが、WPRO 対象国では Brazil が主要な感染国として特定されている（2025年の地域症例の約91%を占める5カ国中の1つ）。Mpox Clade IIb の持続的伝播と性的接触による主要な流行リスクが認識されており、公衆衛生的重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Diario HOY | Confirman dos casos positivos de DENV-3 en Paraguay y activan alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HOY Daily | Two positive DENV-3 cases in Paraguay and an alert has been activated.
article.articleSummary: Two imported cases of dengue serotype DENV-3 have been detected in Paraguay, in individuals who recently arrived from abroad, including one from Brazil. This marks the reappearance of DENV-3 after months with no reported cases, prompting an official alert for a potential outbreak during the autumn–winter season. Health surveillance director Dr. Andrea Ojeda notes that while DENV-3 is not the most dangerous serotype, it had not circulated recently, leaving the population more susceptible. The alert highlights climate conditions—recent rains and the El Niño pattern—that favor Aedes mosquito proliferation. Public health measures include eliminating mosquito breeding sites such as used tires, disposable household items, buckets, cans, and bottles. The director also stressed the importance of dengue vaccination to prevent complications if infected.

triage.headline_ja: ホイ日報 | パラグアイでDENV-3の陽性例2件が確認され、アラートが発動
triage.triage_reason: デングウイルスの再出現とアウトブレイク警告により、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ）で複数該当するが、患者数が限定的（2件、輸入例）であり、国際的拡大リスクはまだ明確でないため。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではパラグアイでDENV-3の輸入例（ブラジルからの輸入含む）が2件確認されたと述べられている。対象国リストに対象外のパラグアイが含まれるため、verified_locationsにはブラジルのみを含める。DENV-3の再出現と秋冬季のアウトブレイク警告、El Niño・降雨によるネッタイシマカ増殖環境が懸念要因であるが、現在の患者数は限定的である。パラグアイが対象国外であるため、ブラジルに関連する動きも引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vale do Paraíba: mortes por gripe crescem 766% em 2026 | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba Valley: Deaths from influenza rise 766% in 2026 | G1
article.articleSummary: Influenza deaths rise sharply in Vale do Paraíba, Brazil, in 2026, with infections up 122.2% and deaths up 766.6% in the Taubaté Regional Health Department (DRS Taubaté) area. ICU admissions increased from 10 to 41, and the case fatality rate climbed from 5.5% to 21.6%. In the first 15 epidemiological weeks of 2026, 120 cases and 26 deaths were recorded, compared with 54 cases and 3 deaths in the same period of 2025. The surge occurs as Brazil anticipates an early influenza season; by April 17, 2026, there were 4,181 SARI (influenza-associated) cases and 259 deaths nationwide. Health authorities promote influenza vaccination, available at Basic Health Units, to prevent severe illness, hospitalizations, and deaths. People with symptoms should seek medical care.

triage.headline_ja: パライーバ渓谷：2026年インフルエンザによる死亡が766%増加 | G1
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザによる死亡が著しく増加（766.6%）し、致命率が大幅に上昇（5.5%→21.6%）しており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」と「異常性」に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度と流行傾向が確認される。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の特定地域（パライーバ州タウバテ保健局）でインフルエンザの異常な増加が報告されている。全国的な流行の傾向も確認されており（4月17日時点で4,181件のSARI症例、259死亡）、季節外の早期流行である点が注目される。ただしブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とすべきだが、イベント情報の発生地域にBrazilが明示されており、記事サマリー全体がブラジルの状況を主題としているため、Brazil (3469034) を対象国外の警告例として含めた。実際の運用では対象国外のため別扱いとなる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de raiva bovina são confimados em cidades de MT; Indea acompanha | Rdnews - melhor portal de notícias de Mato Grosso | principais notícias de Cuiabá e Várzea Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bovine rabies cases confirmed in cities in Mato Grosso; Indea monitors.
article.articleSummary: Two bovine rabies cases confirmed in Campo Verde and Alta Floresta, Mato Grosso, Brazil, last Thursday (April 23, 2026). The Mato Grosso Institute of Agropecuary Defense (Indea) says cases are under control and monitored by veterinary and regulatory staff at local units. Following laboratory confirmation, affected properties have been notified and emergency vaccination of the herds has begun. Teams are surveying areas near outbreaks to detect new cases, advise rural producers, reinforce vaccination, and raise awareness of symptoms and risks. Rabies in cattle is transmitted by hematophagous bat bites. Core symptoms include isolation, hypersalivation, and ataxia. Vaccination is the most effective prevention; there is no cure once infection is established. If rabies is suspected, farmers should report to Indea, isolate sick animals, and avoid handling the animals’ mouths due to high lethality and human transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ州の都市で牛狂犬病の症例が確認される。インデアが監視中。
triage.triage_reason: 牛の狂犬病発生は獣医学的に重要だが、ヒト感染の実際の報告がなく、地方当局が制御・監視下にあり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。国際的な拡大リスクも限定的。
triage.notes: 牛狂犬病(獣医学的な動物疾病)の発生報告。ヒト感染リスクは理論的に存在するが、現在のところヒト患者報告はなく、地方獣医当局(Indea)により制御・監視下にある。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Campina Grande divulga primeiro levantamento para Aedes aegypti de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campina Grande Health Department releases first Aedes aegypti survey for 2026.
article.articleSummary: Campina Grande, Brazil, releases the first Aedes aegypti LIRAa survey for 2026, reporting an overall infestation index of 4.7% (high risk) for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Between March 23–27, 9,130 properties in 63 neighborhoods were inspected; 33 localities are high risk. The highest indices were Malvinas 9.4%, Velame 9.1%, Palmeira Imperial 9.1%, and Bairro das Cidades 9.1%. Lowest at 1.6% were José Pinheiro, Mirante, Monte Castelo, and Ronaldo Cunha Lima, all still medium risk. The municipality notes the rainy period facilitates water accumulation and breeding. Measures include daily inspections, elimination of breeding sites, and health-education outreach by endemic combat agents and the health-education team. Next LIRAa is planned for September, per Ministry of Health guidance reducing to two surveys per year. IIP thresholds: low <1.0%, medium 1.0–3.9%, high ≥4.0%.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナグランデ保健局、2026年の最初のエジプトシマカ調査を公開
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのカンピナグランデ市でのエジプトシマカ（媒介蚊）のサーベイランス報告。デング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニアの媒介蚊密度が4.7%（高リスク）と報告されているが、現在のところ新規患者発生の報告がなく、監視活動の強化段階。
triage.notes: 本記事は媒介蚊（ベクター）のサーベイランス調査結果の報告であり、実際の患者発生事例ではない。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」（雨期による水溜りと繁殖環境の継続）と「流行しやすさ」（3つの蚊媒介ウイルスの高リスク環境）に該当するため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。今後の患者発生報告やアウトブレイク兆候の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Centre flags lapses in submission of malaria blood slide samples from Maha, seeks compliance
article.articleSummary: India's Maharashtra state faces lapses in submitting malaria blood slides for quality checks, prompting a 16 April memo from the public health department directing strict compliance with microscopy quality guidelines. A letter dated 1 April 2026 from the regional office of health and family welfare requires district malaria officers to follow National Centre for Vector-borne Diseases Control norms: send 1% of negative slides and 50% of positive slides to the regional office for rechecking. Officials note submissions have not met these proportions, weakening the quality assurance mechanism essential for accurate microscopy-based malaria diagnosis. District malaria officers must attach complete slide documentation, including total examined samples and a positive/negative breakdown, and ensure monthly rechecking samples reach laboratories. Public health experts emphasize such checks to prevent misdiagnosis and support India's malaria elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: インド保健省がマハラシュトラ州のマラリア血液塗抹標本の提出遅延に警告、コンプライアンスを要請
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの診断品質管理の遵守不足は深刻な公衆衛生上の問題だが、現時点では確認された患者数の急増や異常な死亡率が報告されておらず、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントは疾患の新規発生ではなく、既存のマラリア診断プロセスにおける品質管理体制の遵守不足に関する行政指摘。実際の患者数増加や流行拡大の直接的な報告ではないため、トリアージはWATCHとした。マハラシュトラ州は対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の主題は India における公衆衛生上の対応であるため India を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: T7News | Farma Conde amplia oferta de testes de dengue em clínicas próprias dentro das lojas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: T7News | Farma Conde Expands Its Dengue Test Offerings in Its Own Clinics Located Inside the Stores
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreaks in São Paulo state, Brazil, prompt Farma Conde to expand rapid dengue testing in its Condeclin clinics housed inside more than 100 store locations. The network now broadens access to pharmacy-based services and quick NS1 antigen tests, with results in 15-20 minutes, authorized by Anvisa. The finger-prick test is aimed primarily for patients within the first five days of symptoms and is carried out by network pharmacists. In Taubaté, Vale do Paraíba, the municipality has declared an epidemic, reporting one death and 772 cases, amid warnings across critical cities including São José do Rio Preto, Taubaté, Barretos, Marília, São João da Boa Vista, Campinas, and the Baixada Santista region. Farma Conde emphasizes rapid diagnosis to enable early care. Claudia Conde, founder, notes the initiative strengthens public health response by expanding accessible, efficient testing.

triage.headline_ja: T7News | ファルマ・コンデがチェーン内のクリニックでデング熱検査を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）のサンパウロ州および複数都市でのデング熱流行の報告であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」が該当。また複数都市での流行、1死亡・772症例の報告があり、WPRO基準で「重症度」「流行しやすさ」が該当。
triage.notes: デング熱の流行がサンパウロ州の複数都市（タウバテ、サンタナ・デ・パルナイバ、バレ・ド・パライバ地域など）で報告されており、流行宣言がされている。複数の地理的位置が指定されているが、いずれもブラジル国内のため verified_locations はブラジルのみ。ファルマ・コンデの検査体制拡大はこれら流行への公衆衛生対応を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue tipo 3 já responde por 80% dos casos em Pernambuco no início da sazonalidade das arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue serotype 3 now accounts for 80% of cases in Pernambuco, Brazil, at the start of the arboviral season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue serotype 3 now accounts for about 80% of dengue cases in Pernambuco, Brazil, at the start of the arboviral season. The state reports 7,230 probable dengue cases with 1,854 laboratory-confirmed; 145 severe cases and seven deaths under investigation. The burden is greatest among young adults 20–29, with notable peaks in children 5–9 and adolescents. Although not yet at epidemic peak, transmission is rising as rainfall creates ideal Aedes aegypti breeding conditions. Vector surveillance (LIRAa) shows 35 municipalities at outbreak risk, 102 at alert, and 46 satisfactory, indicating widespread vector circulation. Dengue serotype 3 is considered highly virulent and increases susceptibility to severe disease. Historical context notes that introduction of dengue 3 has been linked to major epidemics in Brazil (2000–2002). Separately, Pernambuco reports 718 probable chikungunya cases with 60 laboratory confirmations, with higher concentration among women 15–29 years.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱セロタイプ3がペルナンブコ州でアルボウイルス季節初期に症例の80%を占める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのペルナンブコ州でデング熱セロタイプ3の急速な拡大が報告され、IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスク）。また過去のセロタイプ3導入時には2000-2002年に大流行を引き起こした歴史があり、リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: セロタイプ3は高病原性であり、重症化リスクが高い。過去の導入時に大流行を引き起こした歴史がある。チクングニアの同時発生も報告されており、ウイルス性ベクター媒介疾患の複合的な脅威状況。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch bệnh tay chân miệng diễn biến phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease Outbreak Grows More Complex.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) has surpassed 34,000 cases nationwide by mid-April 2026, with 8 deaths. In Hanoi, year-to-date HFMD exceeds 2,300 cases across 126 wards/communes, 95% of whom are under 5. Hospitals report rising admissions and many severe cases with neurological complications linked to EV71. HFMD circulates nationwide year-round, peaking March–May and September–October; annual counts range from tens of thousands to about 100,000. The National Pediatric Hospital has treated over 700 HFMD patients this year. EV71 is identified as the principal driver of severe neuro-cardiopulmonary outcomes. Hanoi has targeted kindergartens and home-based groups as high-risk, launching environmental hygiene campaigns—disinfecting classrooms, toys, and playgrounds—and weekly surveillance via health stations. Parents should monitor fever, mouth ulcers, and rashes and keep ill children at home to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の流行が複雑な展開を見せている
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病が全国で34,000件を超え8名の死亡が報告されており、ハノイでは神経学的合併症を伴う重症例が多発している。IHR基準で3項目、WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目に該当し、シグナルの閾値を超える。
triage.notes: EV71は手足口病の神経学的合併症（脳炎、脊髄炎など）の主要な原因であることが明記されている。ハノイでは既に700名以上が国立小児病院で治療されており、5歳未満の幼児が95%を占める。年間を通じて循環するが3～5月と9～10月にピークを示す既知の季節性疾患のため、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」は該当せず。しかし重症度・神経学的合併症の高さ、継続的な曝露リスク、流行しやすさから、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目が該当し、管理対応（幼稚園のターゲット化、衛生キャンペーン、週間サーベイランス）が進められている点から管理可能性の懸念も認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Teror Gigitan Anjing Liar Buat Resah Warga Banyuning Buleleng Bali, Belasan Orang Jadi Korban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stray Dog Bite Terror Unsettles Residents of Banyuning, Buleleng, Bali; Dozens of People Have Become Victims.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-related fear grips Banyuning, Buleleng, Bali after bites by stray dogs. As of April 24, 2026, 18 residents—children to adults—were bitten, mostly on the legs, prompting treatment at Puskesmas and hospitals with rabies vaccine (VAR). In a separate incident on April 26, an 11-year-old boy was bitten in BTN Grahadi Teras, Banyuning around 14:00 WITA; the second dog was described as black and different from the first. Authorities launched field surveys; brain samples from the first dog were taken to Balai Besar Veteriner (BBVet) Denpasar for testing. Vaccination campaigns against rabies-transmitting animals are being conducted by the Banyuning DPKPP (Agriculture, Food Security and Fisheries Office) in coordination with local officials to curb the outbreak and prevent further bites.

triage.headline_ja: 野良犬の咬傷がバリ州ブレレン県バニューニン地区の住民を脅かす、数十人が被害者に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける狂犬病関連の咬傷事件であり、18名以上の被害者（子どもから成人）が確認され、予防接種と当局の対応が実施されている。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行性・対応の複数基準に該当するためシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 狂犬病ウイルス確認のための検査がBBalai Besar Veteriner Denpasarで進行中。地方自治体による予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。記事はインドネシア語原文であるが、内容は明確に同国バリ州での複数咬傷事件を主題としている。

article.articleHeadline: Gaps in malaria prevention persist despite declining cases in Ashanti Region - GHS warns
article.articleSummary: Ashanti Region, Ghana, reports malaria control progress but persistent preventive gaps risk elimination. On World Malaria Day 2026, GHS Regional Director Dr. Fred Adomako-Boateng said IPTp coverage rose from 49.2% in 2023 to 58.44% in 2025 but remains below national targets. He urged stronger community involvement, consistent use of insecticide-treated nets, and improved sanitation to cut mosquito breeding. He warned against self-medication and reinforced the test-before-treat policy since not all fevers are malaria. Across 2023–2025, malaria admissions declined: children under five 27,846 to 21,343; people aged five years and older 70,311 to 57,886. Malaria-attributable admissions fell from 24.1% to 15.67%. Testing for suspected cases rose from 97% to 99%, and severe malaria cases with fatalities remained very low, especially among under-fives. Sustained commitment from individuals, households and communities is needed to move toward a malaria-free future.

triage.headline_ja: アシャンティ地域でのマラリア予防の課題が継続、症例減少にもかかわらず—ガーナ保健局が警告
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例は2023年から2025年にかけて減少傾向を示しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な危機を示していない。記事は主にマラリア制御の進展と残存する予防ギャップについての警告であり、異常な流行や国際的な拡大リスクは認識されていない。
triage.notes: ガーナ保健局によるマラリア制御進展の定期報告。症例数、入院数、死亡率は全て改善傾向を示しており、シグナルとしての懸念はない。記事の主旨はマラリア消滅に向けた継続的な取り組みの必要性の啓発であり、危機管理上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Exposure Can Lead to Brain Spasms That Triggers Explosive Headaches and Even Life-Threatening Brain Bleeding - Thailand Medical News
article.articleSummary: COVID-19–associated reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (RCVS) can cause thunderclap headaches and brain hemorrhage. A 44-year-old woman developed an abrupt 'worst-ever' headache 10 days after COVID-19 diagnosis, with confusion, dizziness, photophobia, and phonophobia. Imaging showed subarachnoid hemorrhage and hydrocephalus; angiography revealed multifocal vasospasm ('string of beads') in both circulations, no aneurysms. There were no common triggers: no decongestants, antidepressants, hormones, migraines, trauma, or heavy exertion. COVID-19 may trigger RCVS via ACE2 disruption and possibly coughing-induced intracranial pressure changes. Diagnosis used clinical criteria with an RCVS2 score of seven. Treatment focused on relieving intracranial pressure and pain. Nine-month follow-up showed reversal of vasospasm; at 40 months she recovered with no lasting deficits. The case was published in Case Reports in Neurological Medicine and reported by Thailand Medical News.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19曝露は脳血管攣縮を引き起こし、激しい頭痛および生命を脅かす脳出血につながる可能性がある - タイ医学ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は COVID-19 に関連する稀な神経合併症（RCVS）の単一症例報告である。新規の流行シグナルを示しておらず、既知の COVID-19 の神経学的合併症に関する医学的報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事は COVID-19 に関連する可逆性脳血管攣縮症候群（RCVS）の単一症例報告であり、医学的知見は有意義だが、公衆衛生危機のシグナルではない。COVID-19 の既知の神経合併症に関する教育的報告として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: 女童小区玩耍接触非洲大蜗致脑炎 警惕“隐形杀手”
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young girl in the neighborhood contracts encephalitis after contact with a giant African snail while playing; beware the "invisible killer".
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-28, a one-year-old girl in Shenzhen, China, contracted Angiostrongylus cantonensis (rat lungworm) infection after contact with an African giant snail in her neighborhood, triggering severe encephalitis. She initially had persistent high fever and vomiting; local hospitals diagnosed meningitis/encephalitis but standard therapy failed. At Shenzhen Children's Hospital, after ruling out common bacteria and viruses, doctors confirmed Angiostrongylus cantonensis as the cause. A history revealed the father had let the child play where many African giant snails were active. She underwent about six months of treatment and is now off medication but requires long-term follow-up. Health authorities warn that Shenzhen’s rainy season brings more snail activity, urging parents to prevent children from contact with these hosts, calling it an 'invisible killer.'

triage.headline_ja: 幼い女児が近所で遊んでアフリカオオヒキガエルとの接触後に脳炎を発症 「隠れた殺し屋」に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 中国深圳でアニサキス線虫による髄膜脳炎の確定患者1例が報告され、WPROスクリーニング基準で「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。また社会的関心も高く、公開健康警告が発せられている。
triage.notes: アニサキス線虫感染による脳炎は中国での報告例が稀であり、雨季における媒介宿主（アフリカオオヒキガエル）の活動増加に伴う拡大リスクが懸念される。地域保健当局が公式警告を発出しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。ただし国際的な拡大可能性は現時点では低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: На 28 април 1932 г. започва използването на ваксина против жълта треска
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On April 28, 1932, the use of the yellow fever vaccine began.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccine development began in 1932, marking the start of large-scale use of early vaccines. Initial vaccines were produced by weakening the virus, providing immunity but with drawbacks including encephalitis risk and large serum requirements. In 1937 Max Theiler developed the 17D strain—a safer, more effective vaccine. By 1938 mass vaccination of Brazil employed 17D, establishing it as the global standard. The 1951 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine rewarded Theiler for this discovery. Contemporary vaccination confers lifelong protection for over 99% of recipients with a single dose. Yellow fever is a mosquito-borne acute viral illness; vaccination is the sole preventive measure regulated by the International Health Regulations (2005), which require vaccination documentation for travel to endemic areas. Western Africa saw mass vaccination around 1934, helping drive global adoption in subsequent years.

triage.headline_ja: 1932年4月28日、黄熱病ワクチンの使用が開始された
triage.triage_reason: 記事は1932年の歴史的なワクチン開発の話題であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクではない。現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は1932年のワクチン開発の歴史的事実に関するもので、現在の感染症イベントではない。Bluedotの地域タグ（Brazil）は歴史的背景情報であり、現在の発生を示していない。したがってverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: 南方多省已进入蚊媒传染病流行风险期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many southern provinces have entered the epidemic risk period for mosquito-borne infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Southern China is entering the mosquito-borne infectious disease risk period as warmer weather and more rainfall drive Aedes aegypti-transmitted illnesses such as dengue fever and chikungunya into higher activity. Guangdong province’s Center for Disease Control and Prevention notes that Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, described as semi-domestic, breed in small clear water in containers such as plant pot trays, water features, and discarded tires, with outdoor resting in shrubs and indoor dark, damp corners; peak biting activity at dawn and dusk. The global burden from mosquito-borne diseases remains high, with the WHO attributing over 700,000 indirect deaths annually. Besides dengue and chikungunya, vectors can spread Zika, Japanese encephalitis, malaria, and yellow fever. In Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, authorities are coordinating joint prevention and control, deploying experts to high-risk cities, and conducting Aedes density surveillance across 111 counties to locate high-risk breeding sites and bolster mosquito control and bite prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 南方多省がすでに蚊媒介感染症の流行リスク期に入った
triage.triage_reason: 中国南部における蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア等）の季節的流行リスク警告。異常/予想外性および流行しやすさの基準に該当するが、現在のところ具体的な患者報告や重症例の情報が記事サマリーに含まれていない。
triage.notes: 広東省および広西チワン族自治区での蚊媒介感染症の季節的流行警告。複数の蚊媒介疾患（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ、日本脳炎、マラリア、黄熱病）が列挙されているが、記事サマリーに具体的な患者数や死亡例の報告がない。当局による予防措置が積極的に展開されており、社会的・政治的関心は高いが、現段階では確認された発生事例の詳細が不明なため、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil tem alta de casos de síndrome respiratória grave - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reports a rise in severe respiratory syndrome cases - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a rise in SRAG, severe acute respiratory syndrome, across regions, per Fiocruz and InfoGripe. In Brazil, SRAG cases increasing in different states; surveillance ongoing. SRAG defined as influenza-like illness with tachypnea or hypoxemia; can require hospitalization, vulnerable groups include elderly, children under one, and people with comorbidities (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, obesity, chronic lung disease, neuromuscular or kidney diseases). Causative agents include Influenza A and B, SARS-CoV-2, rhinovirus, and Respiratory Syncytial Virus. Concurrent circulation, especially in colder periods, drives higher case numbers. Emphasis on prevention and early diagnosis; vaccination campaigns and strengthening care networks. Vaccination against influenza and COVID-19 highlighted as key strategies to reduce severe cases and admissions. Adjunct measures: hand hygiene, masking in crowded settings, avoid close contact with symptomatic individuals. Ongoing active surveillance and public awareness needed during periods of higher viral circulation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが重症呼吸器症候群（SRAG）患者の増加を報告 - ジョルナル・オ・スル
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器系病原体（インフルエンザA、COVID-19、RSV）の同時流行によるSRAG患者の増加が報告されているが、死亡数や国際拡大のリスク、管理不能性に関する具体的情報が不足しているため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内で複数地域にわたるSRAG患者の増加が報告されており、Fiocruzおよび情報監視システム(InfoGripe)による監視が継続中。易感染性の高齢者・1歳未満の子どもなど脆弱グループへの影響があり、入院の可能性がある。ただし、致死率や国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生体制の対応能力に関する具体的データが記事に記載されていない。季節的変動に伴う一時的な増加の可能性も考慮される。

article.articleHeadline: 188 Kasus Baru HIV Ditemukan di Karawang Awal 2026, Didominasi Kelompok LSL dan Usia Produktif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 188 New HIV Cases Found in Karawang in Early 2026, Predominantly Among MSM and Those of Productive Age
article.articleSummary: 188 new HIV cases were detected in Karawang, West Java, from January to March 2026, bringing cumulative infections to 4,733 since 2000 through March 2026. Most cases affect productive adults aged 20–49 (119 individuals). The largest risk group is men who have sex with men (MSM), with 76 cases, linked to unprotected sex within and across sexes. There is an observed rise among adolescents aged 15–19, with 2025 reporting 38 cases and 10 new cases in January–March 2026 among students. Authorities note low uptake of early testing and urge continued education and targeted outreach. HIV testing is free at 50 Puskesmas and most hospitals; antiretroviral therapy (ART) is available at RSUD Karawang, RSUD Jatisari, and RS Citra Sari Husada, with 45 Puskesmas ready to provide ART via PDP. Karawang ranks third in West Java for HIV cases, signaling expanded outreach per BPS.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年初期カラワン地区で188件の新規HIV感染症を検出、MSM（男性同性愛者）と生産年代が主流
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア国内の既知の流行地区（カラワン）における既知病原体（HIV）の事例報告。公衆衛生上の懸念があるが、新たな異常事象というよりは既存の流行管理の観点からの更新情報と解釈される。情報不足により完全な国際的懸念の評価が困難。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性流行疾患であり、カラワン地区は西ジャワ州内で第3位のHIV感染地区として認識されている。記事は定期的な疫学監視に基づく事例報告と位置付けられる。ただし、青年層（15-19歳）での感染増加傾向が注目される点。国際的拡大リスクは現時点で報告されていない。当地での医療対応（ART提供施設の整備）は相応に進んでいるが、早期検査受診率の低さが課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện viêm não mô cầu, Đắk Lắk khẩn trương truy vết người tiếp xúc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis detected; Dak Lak urgently traces contacts.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis detected in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, with two laboratory-confirmed cases as of April 27, 2026. A 2-year-old child from Quảng Phú Commune developed fever, vomiting, and septic shock, was hospitalized, and died from meningococcal meningitis. The child’s uncle, N.Đ.Q, presented with cough and fatigue and tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis, now isolated and being treated at the same hospital. CDC Đắk Lắk has initiated isolation, contact tracing, prophylaxis for close contacts, and environmental cleaning. The exposure is linked to a daycare, with nasal congestion detected on April 23 and high fever by April 25. Authorities urge vaccination against meningococcal disease, good hygiene, and prompt medical evaluation for suspected cases. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and close contact; timely treatment is essential to prevent sepsis and death.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が検出される、ダクラク省が緊急で接触者追跡を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：死亡例あり、異常/予想外：散発的発生、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク）。WPRO基準3項目該当（重症度：死亡例、異常/予想外：地域での新規発生、流行しやすさ：呼吸器飛沫感染）。社会的関心あり。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: ダクラク省での髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の散発的発生。2歳児の死亡例あり、叔父が二次感染。保育施設が感染源と推定。当局が接触者追跡・隔離・予防投与を実施中。呼吸器飛沫感染リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: 少年患怪病3個月　確診骨结核
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teenager with a mysterious illness for three months diagnosed with bone tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Bone tuberculosis diagnosed in a 15-year-old boy in Wuhan, Hubei, China, after three months of high fever, red rash, and heel pain. Despite several hospitals, diagnosis remained elusive until admission to Tianyou Hospital (affiliated with Wuhan University of Science and Technology). A non-tender heel 'cold abscess', night fevers, and weight loss prompted metagenomic sequencing, confirming skeletal tuberculosis. The patient also had concurrent bacterial and viral infections and drug allergies. A combined treatment regimen including anti-tuberculosis therapy, anti-infectives, liver protection, and allergy management was started. After two months, fever, rash, and heel pain disappeared; liver function and inflammatory markers improved; MRI showed lesion absorption; he was discharged and returned to school. Bone TB in children can resemble growing pains or juvenile arthritis; persistent local pain, swelling, night sweats, or weight loss, or poor response after 1–2 weeks, warrants early precise testing; most patients recover with timely standard therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 少年患怪病3個月　確診骨结核
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児骨結核症例報告であり、集団発生の兆候なし。国際的な拡大リスクやIHR基準の該当がない。
triage.notes: 個別症例報告（15歳男児の骨結核）。標準的な抗結核療法により治癒し、集団発生の可能性なし。結核はWHO重点疾患であるが、本記事は診断・治療の個案紹介に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の新規リスク信号ではない。

article.articleHeadline: COE confirma mais uma morte suspeita por Chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COE confirms another suspected death due to Chikungunya in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with the Center for Public Health Emergency Operations (COE) confirming another suspected death and three deaths under investigation; eight deaths are confirmed. The new suspected death is a 50-year-old man who developed symptoms on 19 April and died on 27 April at the UPA. Also under investigation are a 12-year-old Indigenous child and an 84-year-old white patient. As of 27 April, 42 chikungunya hospitalizations are reported across Dourados. The municipality records 6,986 notifications, 5,173 probable, 2,468 confirmed; 1,813 discarded, 2,705 under investigation. Indigenous Reserve reports 3,045 notifications, 2,406 probable, 1,461 confirmed, 639 discarded, 945 under investigation. The epidemic curve indicates ongoing transmission with a high positivity rate (58–69%), especially in urban areas, highlighting sustained transmission and need for vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: COEがドゥラード市のチクングニアによるさらなる疑い死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのドゥラード市におけるチクングニア熱の集団発生で、確認済み死亡8件、調査中3件を含む複数の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性」の2基準に該当。大規模な患者数（6,986通知、確認2,468例）と持続的な伝播を示す高い陽性率（58-69%）により、RRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、このイベント自体はラテンアメリカでのチクングニア熱の地域流行として識別される。記事に示された大規模な通知数、確認済み死亡、持続的な伝播パターンにより、WPRO基準の全5項目に該当。国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクは記事内に明記されていないため「不明」と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 副流感病毒阳性率连续上升，这类咳嗽要当心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parainfluenza virus positivity rate continues to rise; beware this type of cough.
article.articleSummary: HPIV positivity in China has risen for four weeks in Week 15, 2026, with children under 5 most affected, per China CDC sentinel acute respiratory infection data. HPIV comprises four serotypes; HPIV-3 is the most prevalent and often causes severe lower respiratory illness in infants. Symptoms include fever and cough; a barking, croup-like cough with hoarseness may occur. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral for HPIV; influenza antivirals are ineffective against HPIV, and antibiotics are not recommended for HPIV infections. Management is supportive: mild cases can stay at home; antipyretics for fever above 38.5°C; maintain hydration; nebulization for wheeze if advised by a physician. Urgent care is warranted for progressive hoarseness, worsening barking cough, inspiratory retractions or stridor, rapid breathing, irritability or lethargy, cyanosis, fever lasting more than 3 days, or night-time breathing difficulty. Reported by Dr. Tian Man of Nanjing Children's Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 副流感病毒陽性率が連続上昇、このタイプの咳に要注意
triage.triage_reason: 中国におけるHPIV（副流感ウイルス）の陽性率が4週間連続上昇し、5歳未満児が最も影響を受けているが、国際的拡大の具体的なリスク情報が明記されておらず、疾患管理可能性については不明な点が多い。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準4つ該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い（中国CDCデータ、小児科医報告）。ただし、国際的拡大の具体的リスク、外部支援の必要性が不明確なため、WATCH段階。続報で国際的な広がりや対応の困難さが明らかになれば、PICKUPに格上げされるべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Dak Lak steps up meningococcal disease response after fatal case
article.articleSummary: In Dak Lak, central Vietnam, health authorities escalate meningococcal disease response after a fatal case in a two-year-old who presented with mild respiratory symptoms before rapid deterioration consistent with septicemia and meningitis; the child’s uncle tested positive and is under isolation. Epidemiological investigations, contact tracing, sample collection, and preventive antibiotics are underway, with disinfection in affected areas to curb transmission. Since January 2026, Vietnam has recorded 24 meningococcal cases and 4 deaths, up about 50% from the same period last year, with sporadic detections across multiple localities. Recent fatalities in southern and central regions raise concerns about rising transmission risk. Meningococcal disease is caused by Neisseria meningitidis and spreads via respiratory droplets in close contact; progression can be rapid, with death possible within 24 hours and an 8–15% fatality rate. Authorities urge vaccination, handwashing, covering coughs, avoiding shared items, and good ventilation. Alerts include cases in Kien Giang, Lam Dong, Vinh Long, Can Tho, and Hanoi, with at least one fatality.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク州、致死的症例後に髄膜炎菌疾患対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで髄膜炎菌疾患による死亡例が複数報告され、前年同期比で50%増加。複数地域への拡大、急速な進行・高い致死率、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の複数該当が確認される。
triage.notes: 2026年1月以降、ベトナムで髄膜炎菌疾患24例、死亡4例を記録。前年同期比で約50%増加。ハノイ、ラムドン、キエンザン、ビンロン、カントーなど複数地域で報告。2歳児が急速に重症化し死亡、叔父が感染確認。接触者追跡、サンプル収集、予防的抗生物質投与、消毒対応が実施中。髄膜炎菌は飛沫感染で、24時間以内に死亡の可能性あり、致死率8-15%。公式な国際支援要請は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: SRAG causada por Influenza A estabiliza na Bahia; cobertura vacinal de grupos prioritários é de 11% - Bahia Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SARI caused by Influenza A stabilizes in Bahia; vaccination coverage of priority groups is 11% - Bahia Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A–associated severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARI) has stabilized in Bahia, Brazil, according to Fiocruz’s April bulletin, at the start of a vaccination campaign targeting priority groups with coverage at 11%. While Bahia shows halted growth or a decline in SARI cases linked to Influenza A, similar signals are seen in five Northeast states—Maranhão, Ceará, Piauí, Rio Grande do Norte, and Pernambuco. Despite stabilization, influenza-related activity remains high in the region. Nationwide, influenza was present in 43.7% of deaths where a virus was involved. Authorities urge accelerating vaccination to protect the population, noting immunization as the main prevention to reduce severe disease, hospitalizations, and deaths. Nanci Silva, professor at Escola Bahiana de Medicina, emphasizes that vaccination efforts should keep pace with the syndrome’s activity.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型によるSARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）がバイア州で安定化、優先グループのワクチン接種率は11% - バイアノティシアス
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA型によるSARIの複数州での検出と地域的流行が確認されているが、記事では「安定化」「成長が停止または減少」と述べられており、深刻な拡大傾向は見られない。ワクチン接種率の低さは懸念材料だが、現時点では情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのバイア州および東北部5州（マラニャン州、セアラ州、ピアウイ州、リオグランデドノルテ州、ペルナンブーコ州）でのインフルエンザA型に関連するSARIについて報道している。「安定化」と記載されているため、現在の局面は悪化ではなく、むしろ沈静化の兆候を示唆。ワクチン接種率の著しい低さ（11%）は公式な懸念として表現されているが、現在のところ国際的な拡大リスクまでは示されていない。今後のワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗と地域内での症例動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: @南昌人 五月注意防范这些疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nanchang Residents: In May, Take Precautions Against These Diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 28 April 2026, Nanchang, Jiangxi Province, warns residents to guard against dengue fever, chikungunya fever, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), other infectious diarrhea, and rabies as May heat and rainfall rise. Dengue and chikungunya are mosquito-borne; dengue typically starts with abrupt fever up to 40°C and may include rash; chikungunya presents high fever (≥39°C), notable joint pain in small joints, rash, and muscle ache. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, avoiding grass and shrubs, wearing long sleeves and pants, using repellents, and sleeping under bed nets; seek prompt testing if symptoms occur. SFTS is tick-borne; fever around 38°C or higher with fatigue and body aches, higher risk in hills/forests. If bitten, remove ticks with clean tweezers, disinfect, and monitor for two weeks. Rabies onset includes prodrome and can progress to hydrophobia and death; wash wounds for 15 minutes and seek vaccination; dogs should be vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: 南昌住民へ：5月にこれらの疾病の予防に注意してください
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、チクングニア）と人獣共通感染症（SFTS、狂犬病）について、当局から予防警告が発出されている。ただし、具体的な患者数、死亡者、国際的な拡大リスク、または流行の規模についての情報が不足しており、現時点ではWATCH段階の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は南昌市当局による季節性の予防啓発であり、アウトブレイク通知というより公衆衛生警告の性質が強い。デング熱とチクングニアは蚊媒介で流行しやすく、SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）と狂犬病は人獣共通感染症である。5月の気温上昇と降雨増加に伴う感染症増加リスクについての警告だが、具体的な患者数、重症度、致死率などの実際のデータが記事に含まれていないため、現段階では確定的なシグナルピックアップの判断は保留。続報で患者数や死亡例の報告があれば即座にPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia registra alta nas hospitalizações de crianças menores de 2 anos por VSR, causador da bronquiolite - Bahia Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia reports an increase in hospitalizations of children under 2 years old due to RSV, the causative agent of bronchiolitis - Bahia Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil, reports rising hospitalizations among children under 2 due to Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), the leading cause of bronchiolitis. The trend mirrors a nationwide rise in severe pediatric respiratory infections. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe shows increases in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) among young children across four of five regions, including the Northeast. RSV accounts for about 75% of bronchiolitis cases and is a primary driver of pediatric hospitalizations. Bronchiolitis involves inflammation of the bronchioles, tiny airways under 1 mm in diameter. Guilhardo Fontes, a pulmonologist and director of Public Health at the Bahia Medical Association, notes that children under 2 and older adults are most affected, though RSV can also affect seniors. In December, the Health Ministry expanded prevention in SUS to vaccinate pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation to transfer antibodies to the fetus, protecting newborns in early life.

triage.headline_ja: バイア州、RSV（細気管支炎の原因）による2歳未満の小児入院数の増加を記録
triage.triage_reason: RSVによる小児入院数の増加という公衆衛生的懸念があるが、ブラジルは対象国外であり、verified_locationsが空配列となるため、PICKUP基準を満たさない。ただしスクリーニング基準で複数該当し、継続監視の価値がある。
triage.notes: イベント発生地はブラジル（バイア州）であり、対象国リストに含まれていない。RSVは季節性呼吸器疾患であり、通常の公衆衛生上の懸念である。ブラジルの保健当局は既に対応中（妊婦ワクチン接種プログラム実施）であり、国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 直面行业质疑！非洲猪瘟防治专利与金桥奖权威解析
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing industry skepticism! Authoritative analysis of African swine fever prevention and control patents and the Golden Bridge Award.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) prevention and control technologies are presented as independent yet complementary to official on-site policies. South Africa has authorized patent ZA202109483B for a "green composition for the prevention and control of ASF." China accesses CN202511288324.4, a domestically localized version titled "A green composition and its preparation method and application" currently in substantive examination. The Golden Bridge Award project, "A green composition and its application" (certificate TQT2024-X-223), is verifiable via the China Technology Market Association and aligns with national tech award standards. The framework, termed the Great World Anti-ASF Handbook, consolidates a 345-core technology: 3 core technologies, 4 defense layers, protecting 5 physiological systems. It outlines ASF virus invasion through five body systems, a four-layer defense, and an internal purification logic aiming for 14 days to block invasion and 60 days to purge intracellular virus. Two standardized on-site schemes are proposed: daily prevention (five principles) and suspected-ASF control/purification (four principles), harmonizing with official guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: 業界の懸念に直面！アフリカ豚熱防止・制御特許とゴールデンブリッジ賞の権威的解析
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）の防止・制御技術に関する特許出願と賞の解析に関する学術・商業的な内容であり、実際の感染症発生イベント（疾患の新規発症、症例報告、流行拡大）ではない。動物衛生上の新規シグナルとは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事の主体はASF防止技術の特許出願および賞の学術的解析であり、現在進行中の感染症イベント（症例発生、流行拡大）の報道ではない。Bluedot APIの「発生地域」には南アフリカとChinaが含まれているが、記事サマリーは技術・特許の議論が中心であり、実際の動物感染症の発生・蔓延に関する情報は含まれていない。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: Aceh Diambang Darurat Rabies, Tahun 2025, Dua Orang Meninggal Digigit Anjing - Serambinews.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aceh on the Brink of a Rabies Emergency, 2025, Two People Die After Being Bitten by Dogs - Serambinews.com
article.articleSummary: Aceh is approaching a rabies emergency as bites from rabies-transmitting animals in 2025 reached 1,830, with two fatalities from dog bites in Aceh Singkil and Aceh Tengah. 2024 saw 1,527 bites with no deaths; by early 2026, hundreds more have been reported. High-risk districts include Bireuen (highest rabies-transmitting-bite cases), Aceh Timur, Aceh Tengah, Bener Meriah, and Aceh Utara, with dog bites most common in Aceh Tengah, then Aceh Tenggara and Aceh Singkil. Officials warn the situation could trigger a KLB if not addressed, urging intensified vaccination of pets (dogs, cats, and monkeys), stronger control of roaming animals, and public education. A KLB may be declared if human or animal cases occur in previously rabies-free areas, if there is a significant regional uptick, or more bites requiring vaccine. In Bireuen, bite victims are treated within 24 hours—wound cleaning, rabies vaccination, and referrals as needed.

triage.headline_ja: アチェ州、2025年狂犬病緊急事態が迫る、犬咬傷で2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・アチェ州で狂犬病による死亡例（2件）が報告され、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響が深刻」「予想外の急増」の2つに該当。WPRO基準でも「異常/予想外」「重症度（死亡あり）」「流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性ではなく、動物咬傷による継続的なばく露）」に該当し、フルRRA実施の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年のデータを参照しながら2026年4月配信。2025年の咬傷件数1,830件は2024年の1,527件から大幅増加。アチェ州内での複数地域での死亡例、高リスク地区の複数箇所への広がり、および公式による『KLB（クラスター化した患者増加）』宣言の可能性言及から、シグナルとして認識される。インドネシアは対象国に含まれる。
